K.K. $= \frac{1}{\sec^2 A} + \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A} = \cos^2 A + \sin^2 A$
$\left[ \therefore \cos^2 A = \frac{1}{\sec^2 A}, \operatorname{cosec}^2 A = \frac{1}{\sin^2 A} \right]$
$= 1 \left[ \therefore \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1 \right]$
$= \text{K.K.}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{\sec^2 A} + \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A} = 1$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{1}{\cos^2 A} - \frac{1}{\cot^2 A} = 1$
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{1}{\cos^2 A} - \frac{1}{\cot^2 A}$
$= \left(\frac{1}{\cos A}\right)^2 - \left(\frac{1}{\cot A}\right)^2 = \sec^2 A - \tan^2 A$
$\left[\therefore \frac{1}{\cos A} = \sec A \text{ na } \frac{1}{\cot A} = \tan A\right]$
$= 1 \quad [\therefore \sec^2 A - \tan^2 A = 1]$
$= \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{\cos^2 A} - \frac{1}{\cot^2 A} = 1$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{\sin A}{\operatorname{cosec} A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sec A} = 1$
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{\sin A}{\operatorname{cosec} A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sec A} = \frac{\sin A}{\frac{1}{\sin A}} + \frac{\cos A}{\frac{1}{\cos A}}$
$= \left(\sin A \times \frac{\sin A}{1}\right) + \left(\cos A \times \frac{\cos A}{1}\right)$
$= \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A$
$= 1 \quad [\therefore \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1]$
$= \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{\sin A}{\operatorname{cosec} A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sec A} = 1$ (Imethibishwa)
Exact Answer: sin A / cosec A + cos A / sec A = 1

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{\sec A}{\cos A} - \frac{\tan A}{\cot A} = 1$.
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{\sec A}{\cos A} - \frac{\tan A}{\cot A}$
$= \sec A \times \frac{1}{\cos A} - \tan A \times \frac{1}{\cot A}$
$= \sec A \cdot \sec A - \tan A \cdot \tan A$
$= \sec^2 A - \tan^2 A$
$= 1 \quad [\therefore \sec^2 A - \tan^2 A = 1]$
$= \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{\sec A}{\cos A} - \frac{\tan A}{\cot A} = 1$. (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{\tan A}{1 - \cot A} + \frac{\cot A}{1 - \tan A} = \sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A + 1$
Solution:
K.K. $= \frac{\tan A}{1 - \cot A} + \frac{\cot A}{1 - \tan A}$
$= \frac{\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}}{1 - \frac{\cos A}{\sin A}} + \frac{\frac{\cos A}{\sin A}}{1 - \frac{\sin A}{\cos A}}$
$\left[\therefore \cot A = \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} \text{ na } \tan A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A}\right]$
$= \frac{\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}}{\frac{\sin A - \cos A}{\sin A}} + \frac{\frac{\cos A}{\sin A}}{\frac{\cos A - \sin A}{\cos A}}$
$= \left(\frac{\sin A}{\cos A} \times \frac{\sin A}{\sin A - \cos A}\right) + \left(\frac{\cos A}{\sin A} \times \frac{\cos A}{\cos A - \sin A}\right)$
$= \frac{\sin^2 A}{\cos A(\sin A - \cos A)} + \frac{\cos^2 A}{\sin A(\cos A - \sin A)}$
$= \frac{\sin^2 A}{\cos A(\sin A - \cos A)} - \frac{\cos^2 A}{\sin A(\sin A - \cos A)}$
$= \frac{\sin^3 A - \cos^3 A}{\sin A \cos A (\sin A - \cos A)}$
$= \frac{(\sin A - \cos A)(\sin^2 A + \sin A \cos A + \cos^2 A)}{\sin A \cos A (\sin A - \cos A)}$
$[\text{formula } a^3 - b^3 = (a - b)(a^2 + ab + b^2)]$
$= \frac{\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A + \sin A \cos A}{\sin A \cos A}$
$= \frac{1 + \sin A \cos A}{\sin A \cos A} \quad [\therefore \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1]$
$= \frac{1}{\sin A \cos A} + \frac{\sin A \cos A}{\sin A \cos A}$
$= \frac{1}{\sin A} \times \frac{1}{\cos A} + 1$
$= \operatorname{cosec} A \cdot \sec A + 1$
$= \sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A + 1 = \text{K.P.}$
$\therefore \frac{\tan A}{1 - \cot A} + \frac{\cot A}{1 - \tan A} = \sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A + 1$ (Imethibitishwa)
Exact Answer: tan A / 1 - cot A + cot A / 1 - tan A = sec A . cosec A + 1

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{1}{1 + \tan^2 A} + \frac{1}{1 + \cot^2 A} = 1$
Solution:
K.K. $= \frac{1}{1 + \tan^2 A} + \frac{1}{1 + \cot^2 A}$
$= \frac{1}{1 + \frac{\sin^2 A}{\cos^2 A}} + \frac{1}{1 + \frac{\cos^2 A}{\sin^2 A}}$
$= \frac{1}{\frac{\cos^2 A + \sin^2 A}{\cos^2 A}} + \frac{1}{\frac{\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A}{\sin^2 A}}$
$= \frac{1}{\frac{1}{\cos^2 A}} + \frac{1}{\frac{1}{\sin^2 A}} \quad [\therefore \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1]$
$= \cos^2 A + \sin^2 A$
$= 1 \quad [\therefore \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1]$
$= \text{K.K.}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{1 + \tan^2 A} + \frac{1}{1 + \cot^2 A} = 1$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{\cos A}{1 - \tan A} + \frac{\sin A}{1 - \cot A} = \sin A + \cos A$
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{\cos A}{1 - \tan A} + \frac{\sin A}{1 - \cot A}$
$= \frac{\cos A}{1 - \frac{\sin A}{\cos A}} + \frac{\sin A}{1 - \frac{\cos A}{\sin A}}$
$= \frac{\cos A}{\frac{\cos A - \sin A}{\cos A}} + \frac{\sin A}{\frac{\sin A - \cos A}{\sin A}}$
$= \frac{\cos^2 A}{\cos A - \sin A} + \frac{\sin^2 A}{\sin A - \cos A}$
$= \frac{\cos^2 A}{\cos A - \sin A} - \frac{\sin^2 A}{\cos A - \sin A}$
$= \frac{\cos^2 A - \sin^2 A}{\cos A - \sin A} = \frac{(\cos A + \sin A)(\cos A - \sin A)}{(\cos A - \sin A)}$
$[\therefore a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)]$
$= \cos A + \sin A = \sin A + \cos A = \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{\cos A}{1 - \tan A} + \frac{\sin A}{1 - \cot A} = \sin A + \cos A$ (Imethibitishwa)
Exact Answer: $\frac{\cos A}{1 - \tan A} + \frac{\sin A}{1 - \cot A} = \sin A + \cos A$

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\tan A \sqrt{1 - \sin^2 A} = \sin A$
Solution:
L.S. $= \tan A \sqrt{1 - \sin^2 A}$
$= \tan A \sqrt{\cos^2 A} [\therefore \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1]$
$= \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} \cdot \cos A = \sin A = \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \tan A \sqrt{1 - \sin^2 A} = \sin A$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{\sec A + \tan A}{\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A} = \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A}{\sec A - \tan A}$
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{\sec A + \tan A}{\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A}$
$= \frac{(\sec A + \tan A) \times (\sec A - \tan A)}{(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A) \times (\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A)} \times \frac{(\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A)}{(\sec A - \tan A)}$
[kuzidisha namba na denominator na $(\sec A - \tan A) (\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A)$]
$= \frac{(\sec A)^2 - (\tan A)^2}{(\operatorname{cosec} A)^2 - (\cot A)^2} \times \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A}{\sec A - \tan A}$
$= \frac{\sec^2 A - \tan^2 A}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \cot^2 A} \times \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A}{\sec A - \tan A}$
$= \frac{1}{1} \times \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A}{\sec A - \tan A}$
$[\therefore \sec^2 A - \tan^2 A = 1 \text{ na } \operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \cot^2 A = 1]$
$= \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A}{\sec A - \tan A}$
$= \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{\sec A + \tan A}{\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A} = \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A}{\sec A - \tan A}$ (Imethibitishwa)
Exact Answer: $\frac{\sec A + \tan A}{\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A} = \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A}{\sec A - \tan A}$

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{\operatorname{cosec} A}{\operatorname{cosec} A - 1} + \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A}{\operatorname{cosec} A + 1} = 2\sec^2 A$
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A}{\operatorname{cosec} A - 1} + \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A}{\operatorname{cosec} A + 1}$
$= \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A(\operatorname{cosec} A + 1) + \operatorname{cosec} A(\operatorname{cosec} A - 1)}{(\operatorname{cosec} A - 1)(\operatorname{cosec} A + 1)}$
$= \frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A + \operatorname{cosec} A + \operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \operatorname{cosec} A}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - 1}$
$= \frac{2\operatorname{cosec}^2 A}{\cot^2 A} \quad [\therefore \operatorname{cosec}^2 A - 1 = \cot^2 A]$
$= \frac{2 \frac{1}{\sin^2 A}}{\frac{\cos^2 A}{\sin^2 A}} = \frac{2}{\sin^2 A} \times \frac{\sin^2 A}{\cos^2 A}$
$= 2 \times \frac{1}{\cos^2 A} = 2\sec^2 A = \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A}{\operatorname{cosec} A - 1} + \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A}{\operatorname{cosec} A + 1} = 2\sec^2 A$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{1}{1 + \sin A} + \frac{1}{1 - \sin A} = 2\sec^2 A$.
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{1}{1 + \sin A} + \frac{1}{1 - \sin A}$
$= \frac{(1 - \sin A) + (1 + \sin A)}{(1 + \sin A)(1 - \sin A)}$
$= \frac{1 - \sin A + 1 + \sin A}{1 - \sin^2 A}$
$= \frac{2}{\cos^2 A} \quad [\therefore 1 - \sin^2 A = \cos^2 A]$
$= 2 \frac{1}{\cos^2 A}$
$= 2\sec^2 A \quad [\therefore \sec A = \frac{1}{\cos A}]$
$= \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{1 + \sin A} + \frac{1}{1 - \sin A} = 2\sec^2 A$ (Imehakikishwa)

Question: Onyesha kwamba: $\frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec} A - 1} - \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec} A + 1} = 2\tan^2 A$.
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec} A - 1} - \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec} A + 1}$
$= \frac{(\operatorname{cosec} A + 1) - (\operatorname{cosec} A - 1)}{(\operatorname{cosec} A - 1)(\operatorname{cosec} A + 1)}$
$= \frac{\operatorname{cosec} A + 1 - \operatorname{cosec} A + 1}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - 1}$
$= \frac{2}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - 1}$
$= \frac{2}{\cot^2 A} \quad [\therefore \operatorname{cosec}^2 A - 1 = \cot^2 A]$
$= 2 \times \frac{1}{\cot^2 A}$
$= 2\tan^2 A \quad [\therefore \frac{1}{\cot A} = \tan A]$
$= \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec} A - 1} - \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec} A + 1} = 2\tan^2 A$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{\sin A}{1 - \cos A} + \frac{1 - \cos A}{\sin A} = 2 \operatorname{cosec} A$
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{\sin A}{1 - \cos A} + \frac{1 - \cos A}{\sin A}$
$= \frac{\sin^2 A + (1 - \cos A)^2}{\sin A(1 - \cos A)}$
$= \frac{\sin^2 A + 1 - 2 \cos A + \cos^2 A}{\sin A(1 - \cos A)}$
$= \frac{(\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A) + 1 - 2\cos A}{\sin A(1 - \cos A)}$
$= \frac{1 + 1 - 2\cos A}{\sin A(1 - \cos A)} \quad [\therefore \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1]$
$= \frac{2 - 2\cos A}{\sin A(1 - \cos A)} = \frac{2(1 - \cos A)}{\sin A(1 - \cos A)}$
$= \frac{2}{\sin A} = 2 \times \frac{1}{\sin A} = 2 \operatorname{cosec} A$
$\left[ \therefore \sin A = \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec} A} \right]$
$= \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{\sin A}{1 - \cos A} + \frac{1 - \cos A}{\sin A} = 2 \operatorname{cosec} A$. (Kimeonyeshwa)

Question: Onyesha kwamba: $\frac{\tan A}{\sec A + 1} - \frac{\sec A - 1}{\tan A} = 0$
Solution:
K.K. $= \frac{\tan A}{\sec A + 1} - \frac{\sec A - 1}{\tan A}$
$= \frac{\tan A \cdot \tan A - (\sec A - 1)(\sec A + 1)}{(\sec A + 1)\tan A}$
$= \frac{\tan^2 A - (\sec^2 A - 1)}{(\sec A + 1)\tan A}$
$= \frac{\tan^2 A - \tan^2 A}{(\sec A + 1)\tan A} \quad [\therefore \sec^2 A - 1 = \tan^2 A]$
$= \frac{0}{(\sec A + 1)\tan A} = 0 = \text{N.K.}$
$\therefore \frac{\tan A}{\sec A + 1} - \frac{\sec A - 1}{\tan A} = 0$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Onyesha kwamba: $(\tan \theta + \sec \theta)^2 = \frac{1 + \sin \theta}{1 - \sin \theta}$
Solution:
L.S. $= (\tan \theta + \sec \theta)^2$
$= \left(\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} + \frac{1}{\cos \theta}\right)^2$
$\left[\therefore \tan \theta = \frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} \text{ na } \sec \theta = \frac{1}{\cos \theta}\right]$
$= \left(\frac{1 + \sin \theta}{\cos \theta}\right)^2 = \frac{(1 + \sin \theta)^2}{\cos^2 \theta} = \frac{(1 + \sin \theta)^2}{1 - \sin^2 \theta}$
$[\therefore \sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta = 1, \therefore \cos^2 \theta = 1 - \sin^2 \theta]$
$= \frac{(1 + \sin \theta)^2}{(1 + \sin \theta)(1 - \sin \theta)}$
[kwa kutumia fomula $a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)$ kwa kipeo]
$= \frac{(1 + \sin \theta)(1 + \sin \theta)}{(1 + \sin \theta)(1 - \sin \theta)} = \frac{1 + \sin \theta}{1 - \sin \theta} = \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore (\tan \theta + \sec \theta)^2 = \frac{1 + \sin \theta}{1 - \sin \theta}$ (Imethibishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\frac{\cot A + \tan B}{\cot B + \tan A} = \cot A \cdot \tan B$
Solution:
L.S. $= \frac{\cot A + \tan B}{\cot B + \tan A} = \frac{\cot A + \tan B}{\frac{1}{\tan B} + \frac{1}{\cot A}}$
$= \frac{\cot A + \tan B}{\frac{\cot A + \tan B}{\cot A \cdot \tan B}}$
$= \frac{(\cot A + \tan B)}{(\cot A + \tan B)} \times \cot A \cdot \tan B$
$= \cot A \cdot \tan B = \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \frac{\cot A + \tan B}{\cot B + \tan A} = \cot A \cdot \tan B$. (Imethibitishwa)
Exact Answer: $\cot A + \tan B / \cot B + \tan A = \cot A \cdot \tan B$

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\sqrt{\frac{1 - \sin A}{1 + \sin A}} = \sec A - \tan A$
Solution:
L.S. $= \sqrt{\frac{1 - \sin A}{1 + \sin A}}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{1 - \sin A}}{\sqrt{1 + \sin A}} \times \frac{\sqrt{1 - \sin A}}{\sqrt{1 - \sin A}}$
[kuzidisha namba na denominator na $\sqrt{1 - \sin A}$]
$= \frac{(\sqrt{1 - \sin A})^2}{\sqrt{(1 + \sin A)(1 - \sin A)}}$
$= \frac{1 - \sin A}{\sqrt{1 - \sin^2 A}} = \frac{1 - \sin A}{\sqrt{\cos^2 A}}$
$[\therefore \sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1, \therefore 1 - \sin^2 A = \cos^2 A]$
$= \frac{1 - \sin A}{\cos A}$
$= \frac{1}{\cos A} - \frac{\sin A}{\cos A}$
$= \sec A - \tan A$
$\left[\therefore \frac{1}{\cos A} = \sec A \text{ na } \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} = \tan A \right]$
$= \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \sqrt{\frac{1 - \sin A}{1 + \sin A}} = \sec A - \tan A$. (Kumedhihirishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba: $\sqrt{\frac{\sec A + 1}{\sec A - 1}} = \cot A + \operatorname{cosec} A$.
Solution:
L.S. $= \sqrt{\frac{\sec A + 1}{\sec A - 1}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{\sec A + 1}{\sec A - 1}} \times \frac{\sqrt{\sec A + 1}}{\sqrt{\sec A + 1}}$
[kuzidisha kote kihesabuji na kitabanishi kwa $\sqrt{\sec A + 1}$]
$= \frac{(\sqrt{\sec A + 1})^2}{\sqrt{(\sec A - 1)(\sec A + 1)}}$
$= \frac{\sec A + 1}{\sqrt{\sec^2 A - 1}} = \frac{\sec A + 1}{\sqrt{\tan^2 A}}$
$[\therefore \sec^2 A - \tan^2 A = 1, \therefore \sec^2 A - 1 = \tan^2 A]$
$= \frac{\sec A + 1}{\tan A} = \frac{\sec A}{\tan A} + \frac{1}{\tan A}$
$= \frac{\frac{1}{\cos A}}{\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}} + \cot A$
$\left[\therefore \tan A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} \text{ na } \cot A = \frac{1}{\tan A}\right]$
$= \frac{1}{\cos A} \times \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} + \cot A$
$= \frac{1}{\sin A} + \cot A = \operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A$
$= \cot A + \operatorname{cosec} A = \text{R.S.}$
$\therefore \sqrt{\frac{\sec A + 1}{\sec A - 1}} = \cot A + \operatorname{cosec} A$. (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Ikiwa $\cos A + \sin A = \sqrt{2}\cos A$, thibitisha kwamba,
$\cos A - \sin A = \sqrt{2}\sin A$
Solution:
Kutokana na, $\cos A + \sin A = \sqrt{2}\cos A \quad \ldots \ldots (\text{i})$
au, $\sqrt{2}\cos A + \sqrt{2}\sin A = \sqrt{2}\cdot\sqrt{2}\cos A$
[kuzidisha pande zote mbili kwa $\sqrt{2}$]
au, $\cos A + \sin A + \sqrt{2}\sin A = 2\cos A$
[kuchukua nafasi ya thamani ya $\sqrt{2}\cos A$, kutoka(i)]
au, $\sqrt{2}\sin A = 2\cos A - \cos A - \sin A$
au, $\sqrt{2}\sin A = \cos A - \sin A$
$\therefore \cos A - \sin A = \sqrt{2}\sin A$ (Imethibitishwa)
Mbadala: Kutokana na, $\cos A + \sin A = \sqrt{2}\cos A$
au, $\sin A = \sqrt{2}\cos A - \cos A$
au, $(\sqrt{2} - 1)\cos A = \sin A$
au, $\cos A = \frac{\sin A}{\sqrt{2} - 1}$
au, $\cos A = \frac{\sin A}{\sqrt{2} - 1} \times \frac{\sqrt{2} + 1}{\sqrt{2} + 1}$
[kuzidisha nambari na kipeo cha upande wa kulia kwa $(\sqrt{2} + 1)$]
au, $\cos A = \frac{\sqrt{2} \sin A + \sin A}{2 - 1}$
au, $\cos A = \sqrt{2}\sin A + \sin A$
$\therefore \cos A - \sin A = \sqrt{2}\sin A$. (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Ikiwa $\tan A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$, tafuta thamani ya $\frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \sec^2 A}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A + \sec^2 A}$
Solution:
Kutokana na, $\tan A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
au, $\frac{\sin A}{\cos A} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
au, $\frac{\sin^2 A}{\cos^2 A} = \frac{1}{3}$ [kuzidisha pande zote kwa nguvu ya 2]
au, $\sin^2 A \frac{1}{\cos^2 A} = \frac{1}{3}$
au, $\frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A} \sec^2 A = \frac{1}{3}$
au, $\frac{\sec^2 A}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A} = \frac{1}{3}$
au, $\frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A}{\sec^2 A} = \frac{3}{1}$ [kwa kutumia invertendo]
au, $\frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A + \sec^2 A}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \sec^2 A} = \frac{3 + 1}{3 - 1}$
[kwa kutumia componendo na dividendo]
au, $\frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \sec^2 A}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A + \sec^2 A} = \frac{3 - 1}{3 + 1}$ [kwa kutumia invertendo]
au, $\frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \sec^2 A}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A + \sec^2 A} = \frac{2}{4}$
au, $\frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \sec^2 A}{\operatorname{cosec}^2 A + \sec^2 A} = \frac{1}{2}$
Jibu. $\frac{1}{2}$

Question: Ikiwa $\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{4}{3}$, basi, ni thamani gani ya $\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A$?
Solution:
Kutoka, $\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{4}{3} \quad \ldots \ldots (\text{i})$
Tunajua, $\operatorname{cosec}^2 A = 1 + \cot^2 A$
au, $\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \cot^2 A = 1$
au, $(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)(\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A) = 1$
au, $(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A) \times \frac{4}{3} = 1$; [kutoka (i)]
$\therefore \operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A = \frac{3}{4}$
Jibu. $\frac{3}{4}$

Question: Ikiwa $\cot A = \frac{b}{a}$, tafuta thamani ya $\frac{a \sin A - b \cos A}{a \sin A + b \cos A}$
Solution:
Kutokana na, $\cot A = \frac{b}{a}$
au, $\frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{a}$
au, $\frac{\sin A}{\cos A} = \frac{a}{b}$
au, $\frac{a \sin A}{b \cos A} = \frac{a^2}{b^2}$
au, $\frac{a \sin A + b \cos A}{a \sin A - b \cos A} = \frac{a^2 + b^2}{a^2 - b^2}$
[Kwa njia ya componendo na dividendo]
$\therefore \frac{a \sin A - b \cos A}{a \sin A + b \cos A} = \frac{a^2 - b^2}{a^2 + b^2}$ [Kwa njia ya invertendo]
Jibu. $\frac{a^2 - b^2}{a^2 + b^2}$

Question: Kama $\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{1}{x}$, Tafuta thamani ya $\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A$.
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba, $\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{1}{x}$
Tunajua, $\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \cot^2 A = 1$
au, $(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)(\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A) = 1$
au, $(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A) \times \frac{1}{x} = 1$
$\therefore \operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A = x$ (Jibu.)

Question: Kama $\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{1}{x}$, onyesha kwamba, $\sec A = \frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1}$
Solution:
Tunapata kutoka 'a',
$\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{1}{x}$
au, $\frac{1}{\sin A} - \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{1}{x}$
au, $\frac{1 - \cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{1}{x}$
au, $\frac{(1 - \cos A)^2}{\sin^2 A} = \frac{1}{x^2}$
au, $\frac{1 - 2\cos A + \cos^2 A}{\sin^2 A} = \frac{1}{x^2}$
au, $\frac{1 + 2\cos A + \cos^2 A}{\sin^2 A} = \frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1}$  (Kumbuka: Hatua hii ilikuwa na kosa. Mlinganyo sahihi ni kama ifuatavyo, baada ya kuongezea 1 pande zote mbili au kutumia utambulisho wa upande wa kulia.)
au, $\frac{1 - \cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{1}{x}$
Tunajua kuwa $\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1$, kwa hivyo $\sin^2 A = 1 - \cos^2 A$.
Kuweka hii katika mlinganyo wetu:
$\frac{(1 - \cos A)^2}{1 - \cos^2 A} = \frac{1}{x^2}$
$\frac{(1 - \cos A)(1 - \cos A)}{(1 - \cos A)(1 + \cos A)} = \frac{1}{x^2}$
$\frac{1 - \cos A}{1 + \cos A} = \frac{1}{x^2}$
Kuzidisha pande zote mbili kwa $x^2$:
$x^2 \frac{1 - \cos A}{1 + \cos A} = 1$
$x^2 (1 - \cos A) = 1 + \cos A$
$x^2 - x^2 \cos A = 1 + \cos A$
$x^2 - 1 = \cos A + x^2 \cos A$
$x^2 - 1 = \cos A (1 + x^2)$
$\cos A = \frac{x^2 - 1}{x^2 + 1}$

Kisha, $\sec A = \frac{1}{\cos A} = \frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1}$
$\therefore \sec A = \frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1}$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa $\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{1}{x}$, kulingana na taarifa iliyotolewa, thibitisha kwamba $\tan A + \cot A = \sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A$.
Solution:
Tunapata kutoka kwa 'b'
$\sec A = \frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1}$
au, $\frac{\text{hypotenuse}}{\text{adjacent side}} = \frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1}$
$\therefore \text{Opposite side} = \sqrt{(x^2 + 1)^2 - (x^2 - 1)^2} = \sqrt{4x^2} = 2x$
Opposite side
$\tan A = \frac{\text{Opposite side}}{\text{Adjacent side}} = \frac{2x}{x^2 - 1}$
na $\cot A = \frac{\text{Adjacent side}}{\text{Opposite side}} = \frac{x^2 - 1}{2x}$

$\therefore \operatorname{cosec} A = \frac{x^2 + 1}{2x}$
L.H.S. $= \tan A + \cot A = \frac{2x}{x^2 - 1} + \frac{x^2 - 1}{2x}$
$= \frac{4x^2 + (x^2 - 1)^2}{2x(x^2 - 1)} = \frac{4x^2 + x^4 - 2x^2 + 1}{2x(x^2 - 1)}$
$= \frac{x^4 + 2x^2 + 1}{2x(x^2 - 1)}$

R.H.S. $= \sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A = \frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1} \times \frac{x^2 + 1}{2x}$
$= \frac{(x^2 + 1)(x^2 + 1)}{2x(x^2 - 1)}$
$= \frac{x^4 + 2x^2 + 1}{2x(x^2 - 1)}$
$\therefore \tan A + \cot A = \sec A \operatorname{cosec} A$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Tambua thamani ya: $\frac{1 - \cot^2 60^\circ}{1 + \cot^2 60^\circ}$
Solution:
$\frac{1 - \cot^2 60^\circ}{1 + \cot^2 60^\circ}$
$= \frac{1 - \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2}{1 + \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2} \quad \left[\therefore \cot 60^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right]$
$= \frac{1 - \frac{1}{3}}{1 + \frac{1}{3}}$
$= \frac{\frac{3 - 1}{3}}{\frac{3 + 1}{3}}$
$= \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{3}{4} = \frac{1}{2}$

Question: Tambua thamani ya: $\tan 45^\circ \cdot \sin^2 60^\circ \cdot \tan 30^\circ \cdot \tan 60^\circ$
Solution:
Dau lililotolewa $= \tan 45^\circ \cdot \sin^2 60^\circ \cdot \tan 30^\circ \cdot \tan 60^\circ$
$= 1 \cdot \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \cdot \sqrt{3}$
$= 1 \cdot \frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \cdot \sqrt{3}$
$= \frac{3}{4}$ (Jibu.)

Question: Bainisha thamani ya: $\frac{1 - \cos^2 60^\circ}{1 + \cos^2 60^\circ} + \sec^2 60^\circ$
Tambua thamani: $\cos 45^\circ \cdot \cot^2 60^\circ \cdot \operatorname{cosec}^2 30^\circ$
Solution:
Dau lililotolewa $= \cos 45^\circ \cdot \cot^2 60^\circ \cdot \operatorname{cosec}^2 30^\circ$
$= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cdot \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2 \cdot (2)^2 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cdot \frac{1}{3} \cdot 4 = \frac{4}{3\sqrt{2}}$
$= \frac{4}{3\sqrt{2}} \times \frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{4\sqrt{2}}{3 \times 2} = \frac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}$

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\cos^2 30^\circ - \sin^2 30^\circ = \cos 60^\circ$
Solution:
L.H.S.$= \cos^2 30^\circ - \sin^2 30^\circ$
$= \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2 - \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2$
$\left[\because \cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}, \sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\right]$
$= \frac{3}{4} - \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3-1}{4} = \frac{2}{4} = \frac{1}{2}$

R.H.S.$= \cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore \cos^2 30^\circ - \sin^2 30^\circ = \cos 60^\circ$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\sin 60^\circ \cos 30^\circ + \cos 60^\circ \sin 30^\circ = \sin 90^\circ$
Solution:
L.H.S.$= \sin 60^\circ \cos 30^\circ + \cos 60^\circ \sin 30^\circ$
$= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2}$
$= \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{4}{4} = 1$

R.H.S.$= \sin 90^\circ = 1$
$\therefore \sin 60^\circ \cos 30^\circ + \cos 60^\circ \sin 30^\circ = \sin 90^\circ$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\cos 60^\circ \cos 30^\circ + \sin 60^\circ \sin 30^\circ = \cos 30^\circ$
Solution:
Kushoto L.H.S.$= \cos 60^\circ \cos 30^\circ + \sin 60^\circ \sin 30^\circ$
$= \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$

Hivyo basi, Kulia R.H.S.$= \cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
Hivyo basi, $\cos 60^\circ \cos 30^\circ + \sin 60^\circ \sin 30^\circ = \cos 30^\circ$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\sin 3A = \cos 3A$, wakati $A = 15^\circ$.
Solution:
Kufahamika, $A = 15^\circ$
Upande wa Kushoto (L.H.S.) $= \sin 3A = \sin (3 \times 15^\circ)$
$= \sin 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \left[\therefore \sin 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right]$

Upande wa Kulia (R.H.S.) $= \cos 3A = \cos (3 \times 15^\circ)$
$= \cos 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \left[\therefore \cos 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right]$

$\therefore \sin 3A = \cos 3A$ (Umeonyeshwa)

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\sin 2A = \frac{2 \tan A}{1 + \tan^2 A}$, wakati $A = 45^\circ$.
Solution:
Kutokana na, $A = 45^\circ$
K.Sh.K.$= \sin 2A = \sin (2 \times 45^\circ) = \sin 90^\circ$
$= 1 [\because \sin 90^\circ = 1]$

K.Ny.K.$= \frac{2 \tan A}{1 + \tan^2 A} = \frac{2 \tan 45^\circ}{1 + (\tan 45^\circ)^2}$
$= \frac{2 \times 1}{1 + 1^2} [\because \tan 45^\circ = 1]$
$= \frac{2}{2} = 1$

$\therefore \sin 2A = \frac{2 \tan A}{1 + \tan^2 A}$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\tan 2A = \frac{2\tan A}{1 - \tan^2 A}$, wakati $A = 30^\circ$.
Solution:
Kutokana na, $A = 30^\circ$
Upande wa Kushoto (L.H.S.)$= \tan 2A = \tan (2 \times 30^\circ)$
$= \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3} [\therefore \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}]$

Upande wa Kulia (R.H.S.)$= \frac{2\tan A}{1 - \tan^2 A} = \frac{2\tan 30^\circ}{1 - (\tan 30^\circ)^2}$
$= \frac{2 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}{1 - \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2} = \frac{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}}{1 - \frac{1}{3}} = \frac{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}}{\frac{3-1}{3}} = \frac{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}}{\frac{2}{3}} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \times \frac{3}{2} = \sqrt{3}$

$\therefore \tan 2A = \frac{2\tan A}{1 - \tan^2 A}$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa $2\cos (A + B) = 1 = 2\sin (A - B)$ na A, B ni pembe kali, onyesha kwamba, $A = 45^\circ$, $B = 15^\circ$.
Solution:
Kutokana na, $2\cos (A + B) = 1$
au, $\cos (A + B) = \frac{1}{2}$
au, $\cos (A + B) = \cos 60^\circ \left[\because \cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\right]$
$\therefore A + B = 60^\circ \text{.......... (i)}$
na $2 \sin (A - B) = 1$
au, $\sin (A - B) = \frac{1}{2}$
au, $\sin (A - B) = \sin 30^\circ \left[\because \sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\right]$
$\therefore A - B = 30^\circ \text{.......... (ii)}$
Kwa kuongeza milinganyo (i) na (ii) tunapata,
$2A = 90^\circ$
$\therefore A = 45^\circ$
Tena, kwa kutoa milinganyo (ii) kutoka (i) tunapata,
$2B = 30^\circ$
$\therefore B = 15^\circ$
$\therefore A = 45^\circ$ na $B = 15^\circ$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa $\cos (A - B) = 1$, $2\sin(A + B) = \sqrt{3}$ na A, B ni pembe kali, bainisha maadili ya A na B.
Solution:
Kitu ambacho kimetolewa, $\cos (A - B) = 1$
au, $\cos(A - B) = \cos 0^\circ [\because \cos 0^\circ = 1]$
$\therefore A - B = 0^\circ \text{.......... (i)}$
na $2 \sin (A + B) = \sqrt{3}$
au, $\sin (A + B) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
au, $\sin (A + B) = \sin 60^\circ$
$\therefore A + B = 60^\circ \text{.......... (ii)}$
Tukiongeza hesabu (i) na (ii) tunapata,
$2A = 60^\circ$
$\therefore A = 30^\circ$
Tena, tukitoa hesabu (ii) kutoka (i) tunapata,
$2B = 60^\circ$
$\therefore B = 30^\circ$
$\therefore$ Maadili yanayohitajika, $A = 30^\circ$ na $B = 30^\circ$ (Jibu.)

Question: Tatua: $\frac{\cos A - \sin A}{\cos A + \sin A} = \frac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{\sqrt{3} + 1}$
Solution:
Kutokana na mlinganyo, $\frac{\cos A - \sin A}{\cos A + \sin A} = \frac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{\sqrt{3} + 1}$
au, $\frac{\cos A - \sin A + \cos A + \sin A}{\cos A - \sin A - (\cos A + \sin A)} = \frac{\sqrt{3} - 1 + \sqrt{3} + 1}{\sqrt{3} - 1 - (\sqrt{3} + 1)}$ [kwa kutumia componendo na dividendo]
au, $\frac{2 \cos A}{-2 \sin A} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{-2}$
au, $\frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \sqrt{3}$ [kuzidisha pande zote kwa $(-1)$]
au, $\cot A = \cot 30^\circ [\because \cot 30^\circ = \sqrt{3}]$
$\therefore A = 30^\circ$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika ni, $A = 30^\circ$ (Jibu.)

Question: Ikiwa $A$ na $B$ ni pembe kali na $\cot (A + B) = 1$, $\cot(A - B) = \sqrt{3}$, bainisha thamani za A na B.
Solution:
Kutoka, $\cot(A + B) = 1$
au, $\cot (A + B) = \cot 45^\circ [\because \cot 45^\circ = 1]$
$\therefore A + B = 45^\circ \text{.......... (i)}$
na $\cot (A - B) = \sqrt{3}$
au, $\cot (A - B) = \cot 30^\circ [\because \cot 30^\circ = \sqrt{3}]$
$\therefore A - B = 30^\circ \text{.......... (ii)}$
Tukiongeza hesabu (i) na (ii) tunapata,
$2A = 75^\circ$
au, $A = \frac{75^\circ}{2}$
$\therefore A = 37\frac{1}{2}^\circ$
Tena, tukitoa hesabu (ii) kutoka (i) tunapata,
$2B = 15^\circ$
au, $B = \frac{15^\circ}{2} \quad \therefore B = 7\frac{1}{2}^\circ$
$\therefore$ Thamani zinazohitajika ni, $A = 37\frac{1}{2}^\circ$ na $B = 7\frac{1}{2}^\circ$ (Jibu.)

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\cos 3A = 4 \cos^3 A - 3 \cos A$ wakati $A = 30^\circ$.
Solution:
Kutokana na, $A = 30^\circ$.
Upande wa Kushoto (L.H.S.)$= \cos 3A = \cos (3 \times 30^\circ)$
$= \cos 90^\circ = 0$
Upande wa Kulia (R.H.S.)$= 4 \cos^3 A - 3 \cos A = 4(\cos 30^\circ)^3 - 3\cos 30^\circ$
$= 4 \times \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^3 - 3 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 4 \times \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{8} - \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$= \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} - \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} = 0$
$\therefore \cos 3A = 4 \cos^3 A - 3 \cos A$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Tatua: $\sin \theta + \cos \theta = 1$, wakati $0^\circ \leq \theta \leq 90^\circ$.
Solution:
Nukta, $\sin \theta + \cos \theta = 1$
au, $(\sin \theta + \cos\theta)^2 = (1)^2$ [kupa pande zote mbili mraba]
au, $\sin^2 \theta + 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta +\cos^2\theta = 1$
au, $1 + 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = 1$
au, $2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = 0$
au, $\sin \theta \cos \theta = 0$
Ikiwa, $\sin \theta = 0$ au, $\cos \theta = 0$
au, $\sin \theta = \sin 0^\circ$ au, $\cos \theta = \cos 90^\circ$
$\therefore \theta = 0^\circ$ $\therefore \theta = 90^\circ$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika ni $\theta = 0^\circ$ au $90^\circ$ (Jibu.)

Question: Tatua: $\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = 2 - 5 \cos \theta$, wakati ambapo $\theta$ ni pembe **sisi**
Solution:
Kutokana na fomula iliyotolewa,
$\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = 2 - 5 \cos\theta$
au, $\cos^2\theta - (1 - \cos^2\theta) = 2 - 5 \cos\theta$ [\because \sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta]$
au, $\cos^2\theta - 1 + \cos^2\theta = 2 - 5 \cos\theta$
au, $2 \cos^2\theta - 1 = 2 - 5 \cos\theta$
au, $2\cos^2\theta + 5\cos\theta - 1 - 2 = 0$
au, $2\cos^2\theta + 5\cos\theta - 3 = 0$
au, $2 \cos^2\theta + 6\cos\theta - \cos\theta - 3 = 0$
au, $2\cos\theta (\cos\theta + 3) - 1(\cos\theta + 3) = 0$
au, $(\cos\theta + 3) (2 \cos\theta - 1) = 0$
Ikiwa, $\cos\theta + 3 = 0$ au, $2 \cos\theta - 1 = 0$
au, $\cos\theta = -3$ au, $2 \cos\theta = 1$
[Lakini, $\cos\theta \neq -3$, au, $\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
Kwa sababu, $-1 \leq \cos\theta \leq 1$] au, $\cos\theta = \cos 60^\circ [\because \cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}]$
$\therefore \theta = 60^\circ$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika ni, $\theta = 60^\circ$ (Jibu)

Question: Tatua: $2 \sin^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta - 3 = 0$, ambapo $\theta$ ni pembe kali.
Solution:
Nukta ya msingi, $2 \sin^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta - 3 = 0$
au, $2(1 - \cos^2\theta) + 3 \cos\theta - 3 = 0 [\because \sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta]$
au, $2 - 2 \cos^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta - 3 = 0$
au, $-2 \cos^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta - 1 = 0$
au, $2 \cos^2\theta - 3 \cos\theta + 1 = 0$ [kuzidisha pande zote mbili kwa $(-1)$]
au, $2 \cos^2\theta - 2 \cos\theta - \cos\theta + 1 = 0$
au, $2 \cos\theta (\cos\theta - 1) - 1 (\cos\theta - 1) = 0$
au, $(\cos\theta - 1) (2\cos\theta - 1) = 0$
Iwapo, $\cos\theta - 1 = 0$ au, $2 \cos\theta - 1 = 0$
au, $\cos\theta = 1$ au, $2 \cos\theta = 1$
au, $\cos\theta = \cos 0^\circ$ au,$\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore \theta = 0^\circ$ au, $\cos\theta = \cos 60^\circ$
$\therefore \theta = 60^\circ$
$\because \theta \neq 0^\circ$ [Haiukubaliki, kwa sababu $\theta$ ni pembe mkali]
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika ni, $\theta = 60^\circ$ (Jibu.)

Question: Tatua: $\tan^2\theta - (1 + \sqrt{3}) \tan\theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
Solution:
Kutokana na dhana, $\tan^2\theta - (1 + \sqrt{3}) \tan\theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
au, $\tan^2\theta - \tan\theta - \sqrt{3} \tan\theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
au, $\tan\theta (\tan\theta - 1) - \sqrt{3} (\tan\theta - 1) = 0$
au, $(\tan\theta - 1) (\tan\theta - \sqrt{3}) = 0$
Ikiwa $\tan\theta - 1 = 0$ au, $\tan\theta - \sqrt{3} = 0$
au, $\tan\theta = 1$ au, $\tan\theta = \sqrt{3}$
au, $\tan\theta = \tan 45^\circ$ au, $\tan\theta = \tan 60^\circ$
$\therefore \theta = 45^\circ$ $\therefore \theta = 60^\circ$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika ni, $\theta = 45^\circ$ au, $60^\circ$. (Jibu.)

Question: Tatua: $3\cot^2 60^\circ + \frac{1}{4} \operatorname{cosec}^2 30^\circ + 5\sin^2 45^\circ - 4\cos^2 60^\circ$
Solution:
Maneno yaliyopewa: $3\cot^2 60^\circ + \frac{1}{4} \operatorname{cosec}^2 30^\circ + 5\sin^2 45^\circ - 4 \cos^2 60^\circ$
$= 3.\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2 + \frac{1}{4}. (2)^2 + 5. \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^2 - 4.\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2$
$= 3.\frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{4}. 4 + 5.\frac{1}{2} - 4.\frac{1}{4}$
$= 1 + 1 + \frac{5}{2} - 1$
$= 1 + \frac{5}{2} = \frac{2+5}{2} = \frac{7}{2}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Kama $\angle B = 90^\circ$, $AB = 5 \text{ cm}$, $BC = 12 \text{ cm}$ katika $\triangle ABC$,
tatua urefu wa $AC$.
Solution:
Kulingana na nadharia ya Pythagoras,
$AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2}$
$= \sqrt{5^2 + (12)^2}$
$= \sqrt{25 + 144}$
$= \sqrt{169} = 13$
$\therefore AC = 13 \text{ cm}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Kama $\angle B = 90^\circ$, $AB = 5 \text{ cm}$, $BC = 12 \text{ cm}$ katika $\triangle ABC$,
na kama $\angle C = \theta$, tafuta thamani ya $\sin\theta + \cos\theta$.
Solution:
Kulingana na nadharia ya Pythagoras,
$AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2}$
$= \sqrt{5^2 + (12)^2}$
$= \sqrt{25 + 144}$
$= \sqrt{169} = 13$
$\therefore AC = 13 \text{ cm}$
Sasa, $\sin\theta = \frac{AB}{AC} = \frac{5}{13}$
na $\cos\theta = \frac{BC}{AC} = \frac{12}{13}$
$\therefore \sin\theta + \cos\theta = \frac{5}{13} + \frac{12}{13} = \frac{5 + 12}{13} = \frac{17}{13}$
$\therefore \sin\theta + \cos\theta = \frac{17}{13}$ (Jibu.)

Question: Kama $\angle B = 90^\circ$, $AB = 5 \text{ cm}$, $BC = 12 \text{ cm}$ katika $\triangle ABC$, tumia nadharia hii kuonyesha kwamba, $\sec^2 A + \operatorname{cosec}^2 A = \sec^2 A \cdot \operatorname{cosec}^2 A$.
Solution:
Kulingana na nadharia ya Pythagoras,
$AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2}$
$= \sqrt{5^2 + (12)^2}$
$= \sqrt{25 + 144}$
$= \sqrt{169} = 13$
$\therefore AC = 13 \text{ cm}$
Sasa, U.H.K. $= \sec^2 A + \operatorname{cosec}^2 A$
$= \left(\frac{AC}{AB}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{AC}{BC}\right)^2$
$= \left(\frac{13}{5}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{13}{12}\right)^2$
$= \frac{169}{25} + \frac{169}{144}$
$= \frac{24336 + 4225}{3600}$
$= \frac{28561}{3600}$
U.H.K. $= \sec^2 A \cdot \operatorname{cosec}^2 A$
$= \left(\frac{AC}{AB}\right)^2 \cdot \left(\frac{AC}{BC}\right)^2$
$= \left(\frac{13}{5}\right)^2 \cdot \left(\frac{13}{12}\right)^2$
$= \frac{169}{25} \cdot \frac{169}{144}$
$= \frac{28561}{3600}$
$\therefore \sec^2 A + \operatorname{cosec}^2 A = \sec^2 A \cdot \operatorname{cosec}^2 A$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question:
Hebu $\sin\theta = \text{p}$, $\cos\theta = \text{q}$, $\tan\theta = \text{r}$, ambapo $\theta$ ni pembe **mkali**.
Ikiwa $\text{r} = \sqrt{\left(3\right)^{-1}}$, **tafuta** thamani ya $\theta$.
Solution:
Ikizingatiwa kwamba, $\tan\theta = \text{r}$
Hapa, $\text{r} = \sqrt{\left(3\right)^{-1}}$
au, $\tan\theta = \sqrt{\left(3\right)^{-1}}$
au, $\tan\theta = \sqrt{\frac{1}{3}}$
au, $\tan\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
au, $\tan\theta = \tan30^{\circ}$
$\therefore\theta = 30^{\circ}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Hebu $\sin\theta = \text{p}$, $\cos\theta = \text{q}$, $\tan\theta = \text{r}$, ambapo $\theta$ ni pembe yenye mkali.
Ikiwa $\text{p} + \text{q} = \sqrt{2}$, thibitisha kwamba $\theta = 45^{\circ}$
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba,
$\sin\theta = \text{p}, \cos\theta = \text{q} \text{ na } \text{p} + \text{q} = \sqrt{2}$
au, $\sin\theta + \cos\theta = \sqrt{2}$
au, $\sin\theta = \sqrt{2} - \cos\theta$
au, $\sin^{2}\theta = \left(\sqrt{2} - \cos\theta\right)^{2}$
au, $1 - \cos^{2}\theta = 2 - 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta + \cos^{2}\theta$
au, $1 - \cos^{2}\theta - 2 + 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta - \cos^{2}\theta = 0$
au, $- 2 \cos^{2}\theta + 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta - 1 = 0$
au, $2\cos^{2}\theta - 2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta + 1 = 0$
au, $\left(\sqrt{2}\cos\theta - 1\right)^{2} = 0$
au, $\sqrt{2}\cos\theta - 1 = 0$
au, $\sqrt{2}\cos\theta = 1$
au, $\cos\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$
au, $\cos\theta = \cos45^{\circ}$
$\therefore \theta = 45^{\circ}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Hebu $\sin\theta = \text{p}$, $\cos\theta = \text{q}$, $\tan\theta = \text{r}$, ambapo $\theta$ ni pembe kali.
Ikiwa $7\text{p}^{2} + 3\text{q}^{2} = 4$, onyesha kwamba, $\tan\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba,
$\sin\theta = \text{p},$
$\cos\theta = \text{q}$
sasa, $7\text{p}^{2} + 3\text{q}^{2} = 4$
au, $7\sin^{2}\theta + 3\cos^{2}\theta = 4$
au, $7\sin^{2}\theta + 3(1 - \sin^{2}\theta) = 4$
au, $7 \sin^{2}\theta + 3 - 3\sin^{2}\theta = 4$
au, $4 \sin^{2}\theta + 3 = 4$
au, $4 \sin^{2}\theta = 4 - 3$
au, $4 \sin^{2}\theta = 1$
au, $\sin^{2}\theta = \frac{1}{4}$
au, $\sin\theta = \sqrt{\frac{1}{4}}$
au, $\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
au, $\sin\theta = \sin30^{\circ}$
$\therefore \theta = 30^{\circ}$
$\text{L.H.S.} = \tan\theta = \tan30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
$= \text{R.H.S.}$
$\therefore \tan\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa pembe ya mwinuko wa kilele cha kitu chenye urefu fulani ni $30^\circ$ kutoka mahali fulani ardhini, na kile kitu kina urefu wa mita $26$, basi tafuta umbali kutoka mahali hapo ardhini hadi chini ya kitu hicho.
Solution:
Hebu,
Umbali wa ndege kutoka kwa Mchimbaji ni
$BC = x$ m,
Urefu wa Mchimbaji $AC = 26$ m
Na pembe ya mwinuko wa kilele cha Mchimbaji katika nukta B ni $\angle ABC = 30^\circ$
Kutoka $\triangle ABC$ tunapata,
$\tan \angle ABC = \frac{AC}{BC}$
au, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{26}{x}$
au, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{26}{x}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
au, $x = 26 \times \sqrt{3}$
$\therefore x = 45.033$ (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Umbali wa ndege kutoka kwa Mchimbaji ni $45.033$ m (takriban.) (Jibu.)

Question: Ikiwa umbali kutoka kilele cha mti hadi nukta yoyote ardhini ni mita $20$, na pembe ya mwinuko kutoka nukta hiyo hadi kilele cha mti ni $60^\circ$, tafuta kimo cha mti.
Solution:
Hebu,
Urefu wa mti $AC = h$ m,
Umbali kutoka chini ya mti C hadi sehemu yoyote B ni $BC = 20$ m
Katika sehemu B, pembe ya mwinuko wa mti ni $\angle ABC = 60^\circ$
Sasa, kutoka $\triangle ABC$,
$\tan \angle ABC = \frac{AC}{BC}$
au, $\tan 60^\circ = \frac{h}{20}$
au, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{20}$ [Kwa kuwa, $\tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$]
au, $h = 20\sqrt{3}$
$\therefore h = 34.641$ (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Urefu wa mti ni $34.641$ m (takriban.) (Jibu.)

Question: Hebu tutumie ngazi yenye urefu wa mita $18$ ambayo hugusa juu ya ukuta, ikiunda pembe ya $45^\circ$ na ardhi. Kokotoa kimo cha ukuta.
Solution:
Hebu,
sehemu ya kugusa juu ya ukuta iwe B na urefu wa ukuta $AB = h$ m.
Kwa hiyo, urefu wa ngazi,
$OB = 18$ m na $\angle AOB = 45^\circ$
Sasa, kutoka $\triangle AOB$ tunapata,
$\sin \angle AOB = \frac{AB}{OB}$
au, $\sin 45^\circ = \frac{AB}{OB}$
 au, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{h}{18}$ [$\because \sin 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$]
$\therefore h = \frac{18}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{18\sqrt{2}}{2} = 12.728$
Urefu wa ukuta = $12.728$ m (takriban.) (Jibu.)

Question: Ikiwa pembe ya mshuko kutoka kilele cha nyumba hadi sehemu ya ardhi iliyo mita $20$ kutoka mguu wa nyumba ni $30^\circ$, basi, tafuta kimo cha nyumba.
Solution:
Hebu, kimo cha nyumba $AB = h$ m, pembe ya kushuka kutoka A kwenda nukta C kwenye ardhi ni $\angle CAD = 30^\circ$ na $AC = 20$ m.
$\therefore \angle CAD = \angle ACB = 30^\circ$ (DA $\parallel$ BC, kwani ni pembe za ndani zinazopishana)
Sasa, kutoka pembetatu $\triangle ABC$,
$\sin \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{AC}$
au, $\sin 30^\circ = \frac{h}{20}$
au, $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{h}{20}$ [$\because \sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}$]
au, $2h = 20$
au, $h = \frac{20}{2} \therefore h = 10$
$\therefore$ Kimo cha nyumba ni $10$ m. (Jibu.)

Question: Japo la mwinuko wa mnara kutoka kwa kiwango chochote ardhini ni $60^\circ$. Tukisogea nyuma mita $25$, japo la mwinuko huwa $30^\circ$, tafuta kimo cha mnara.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa mnara, $AB = h$ m na pembe ya mwinuko ni $\angle ACB = 60^\circ$. Baada ya kurudi nyuma $CD = 25$ m kutoka sehemu C, pembe ya mwinuko inakuwa $\angle ADB = 30^\circ$.
Hebu, $BC = x$ m.
$\therefore BD = BC + CD = (x + 25)$ m
Sasa, kutoka $\triangle ABC$ tunapata,
$\tan 60^\circ = \frac{AB}{BC}$
au, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}$ [$\because \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$]
$\therefore x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ .......... (i)
Tena, kutoka $\triangle ABD$ tunapata,
$\tan \angle ADB = \frac{AB}{BD}$
au, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{x+25}$
au, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x+25}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
au, $\sqrt{3}h = x + 25$
au, $\sqrt{3}h = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 25$ [kwa msaada wa hesabu (i)]
au, $\sqrt{3}h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = 25$
au, $\frac{3h - h}{\sqrt{3}} = 25$
au, $\frac{2h}{\sqrt{3}} = 25$
au, $2h = 25\sqrt{3}$
au, $h = \frac{25\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore h = 21.651$ (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Urefu wa mnara ni $21.651$ m (takriban.) (Jibu.)

Question: Pembe ya mwinuko ya mnara hubadilika kutoka $45^\circ$ hadi $60^\circ$ kwa kusogea mita $60$ kuelekea mnara. Pata kimo cha mnara.
Solution:
Acha, kimo cha mnara kiwe $AB = h$ m na pembe ya mwinuko $\angle ADB = 45^\circ$. Baada ya kuhamia $CD = 60$ m kutoka mahali D, pembe ya mwinuko inakuwa $\angle ACB = 60^\circ$.
Acha, $BC = x$ m
$\therefore BD = BC + CD = (x+60)$ m.
Sasa, kutoka $\triangle ABC$ tunapata,
$\tan 60^\circ = \frac{AB}{BC}$
au, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}$ [$\because \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$]
$\therefore x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ ............ (i)
Tena, kutoka $\triangle ABD$ tunapata,
$\tan \angle ADB = \frac{AB}{BD}$
au, $\tan 45^\circ = \frac{h}{x+60}$
au, $1 = \frac{h}{x+60}$ [$\because \tan 45^\circ = 1$]
au, $h = x+60$
au, $h = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 60$ [kwa msaada wa hesabu (i)]
au, $h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = 60$
au, $\frac{\sqrt{3}h - h}{\sqrt{3}} = 60$
au, $\sqrt{3}h - h = 60\sqrt{3}$
au, $(\sqrt{3}-1)h = 60\sqrt{3}$
au, $h = \frac{60\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}-1}$
$= \frac{60\sqrt{3}(\sqrt{3}+1)}{(\sqrt{3}-1)(\sqrt{3}+1)} = \frac{60(3+\sqrt{3})}{(\sqrt{3})^2-(1)^2}$
$= \frac{60(3+\sqrt{3})}{2}$
$= 30(3+\sqrt{3})$
$h = 141.962$ (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Kimo cha mnara ni $141.962$ m (takriban.). (Jibu.)

Question: Mtu aliyesimama mahali fulani kwenye kingo ya mto aliona kwamba pembe ya mwinuko ya mnara uliopo moja kwa moja kinyume chake kwenye kingo nyingine ulikuwa $60^\circ$. Aliposonga nyuma meta $32$, aliona kwamba pembe ya mwinuko ya mnara ilikuwa $30^\circ$. Tafuta kimo cha mnara na upana wa mto.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa mnara uwe $AB = h$ m na pembe ya mwinuko wa mnara ni $\angle ACB$.
Baada ya kuhamia $CD = 32$ m kutoka mahali C pembe ya mwinuko inakuwa $\angle ADB = 30^\circ$.
Hebu, upana wa mto, $BC = x$ m.
$\therefore BD = BC + CD = (x+32)$ m
Sasa, kutoka $\triangle ABC$ tunapata,
$\tan \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{BC}$
au, $\tan 60^\circ = \frac{h}{x}$
au, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}$ [$\because \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$]
$\therefore x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ ............ (i)
Tena, kutoka $\triangle ABD$ tunapata,
$\tan \angle ADB = \frac{AB}{BD}$
au, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{x+32}$
au, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x+32}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
au, $\sqrt{3}h = x+32$
au, $\sqrt{3}h = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 32$; [Kwa msaada wa hesabu (i)]
au, $\sqrt{3}h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = 32$
au, $\frac{3h-h}{\sqrt{3}} = 32$
au, $\frac{2h}{\sqrt{3}} = 32$
au, $2h = 32\sqrt{3}$
au, $h = \frac{32\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore h = 27.712$ m (takribani.)
Tukibadilisha thamani ya $h$ katika hesabu (i) tunapata,
$x = \frac{32\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = 16$ m.
$\therefore$ Urefu wa mnara ni $27.71$ m (takribani.) na upana wa mto ni $16$ m. (Jibu.)

Question: Mwamba wenye urefu wa mita $64$ huvunjika sehemu mbili bila kutengana kabisa na huunda pembe ya $60^\circ$ na ardhi. Tafuta urefu wa sehemu iliyovunjika ya mwamba.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa nguzo, $AB = 64$ m.
Nguzo inavunjika sehemu mbili bila kutengana kabisa kwenye nukta C na kutengeneza pembe $\angle BDC = 60^\circ$ na ardhi.
Hebu, $AC = CD = x$ m
$\therefore BC = (64 - x)$ m
Sasa, kutoka $\triangle BCD$ tunapata,
$\sin \angle BDC = \frac{BC}{CD}$
au, $\sin 60^\circ = \frac{64-x}{x}$
au, $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{64-x}{x}$
au, $\sqrt{3}x = 128 - 2x$
au, $(\sqrt{3}+2)x = 128$
au, $x = \frac{128}{\sqrt{3}+2}$
au, $x = \frac{128(\sqrt{3}-2)}{(\sqrt{3}+2)(\sqrt{3}-2)}$
au, $x = \frac{128(\sqrt{3}-2)}{(\sqrt{3})^2-(2)^2}$
au, $x = \frac{128(\sqrt{3}-2)}{3-4}$
au, $x = \frac{128(\sqrt{3}-2)}{-1}$
au, $x = -128(\sqrt{3}-2)$
au, $x = 128(2-\sqrt{3})$
$\therefore x = 34.298$ (takriban.) [$\because$ urefu huwa ni chanya daima]
$\therefore$ Urefu wa sehemu iliyovunjika ni $34.298$ m (takriban.)

Question: Mti uliovunjwa na dhoruba ukafanya sehemu iliyovunjika kutengeneza pembe ya $30^\circ$ na sehemu iliyobaki, na kugusa ardhi kwa umbali wa $12$ mita kutoka kwenye shina. Kokotoa urefu wa mti mzima.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu mzima wa mti, $AB = h$ m, mti umevunjika katika hatua C na sehemu $BC = x$ m hutengeneza pembe $\angle BCD = 30^\circ$ na sehemu nyingine na kugusa ardhi kwa umbali $BD = 12$ m kutoka kwake.
Hapa, $CD = AC = AB - BC = (h - x)$ m.
Sasa, kutoka $\triangle BCD$ tunapata,
$\tan \angle BCD = \frac{BD}{BC}$
au, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{12}{x}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
au, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{12}{x}$
$\therefore x = 12\sqrt{3}$
Tena, $\sin \angle BCD = \frac{BD}{CD}$
au, $\sin 30^\circ = \frac{12}{h-x}$
au, $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{12}{h-x}$ [$\because \sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}$]
au, $h-x = 24$
au, $h = 24 + x$
au, $h = 24 + 12\sqrt{3}$; [kwa kubadilisha thamani ya x]
$h = 44.79$ m (takriban.)
Urefu mzima wa mti ni $44.79$ m (takriban.) (Jibu.)

Question:
Simama popote kwenye **ubavu** wa mto, mtu aliona kwamba pembe ya mwinuko wa mti wenye urefu wa mita **150** moja kwa moja kwake kwenye **ubavu** mwingine ni **$30^\circ$**. Mtu huyo alianza kuelekea mti huo kwa kutumia mtumbwi. Lakini alifika umbali wa mita **10** kutoka kwenye mti huo kutokana na mkondo wa maji.
Kulingana na maelezo hayo, onesha maelezo yaliyo hapo juu kwa kutumia mchoro.
Solution: Hebu, upana wa mto $AB = x$ m na urefu wa mti $BC = 150$ m. Katika nukta A, pembe ya mwinuko wa mti $\angle CAB = 30^\circ$ na ikiwa msimamo wa boti kwenye ukingo mwingine uko kwenye nukta D, basi $AD = y$ m na $BD = 10$ m.

Question:
Simama popote kwenye ukingo wa mto, mtu aliona kwamba pembe ya mwinuko wa mti wenye urefu wa mita $150$ uliyo sawa kabisa naye upande wa pili wa mto ni $30^\circ$. Mtu huyo alianza kuelekea mti huo kwa boti. Lakini alifikia umbali wa mita $10$ kutoka kwenye mti huo kutokana na mkondo.
Tafuta upana wa mto.
Solution:
Kutoka $\triangle ABC$ tunapata,
$\tan \angle CAB = \frac{BC}{AB}$
au, $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{150}{x}$
au, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{150}{x}$ [$\because \tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$]
au, $x = 150\sqrt{3}$
$\therefore x = 259.808$ (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Upana wa mto ni $259.808$ m (takriban.) (Jibu.)

Question:
Usimamapo mahali popote katika ukingo wa mto, mwanaume aliona kwamba pembe ya mwinuko ya mti wenye urefu wa $150$ mita, uliokabiliwa moja kwa moja naye upande mwingine wa mto, ni $30^\circ$. Mwanaume huyo alianza safari ya kwenda kuelekea mti huo kwa kutumia boti. Hata hivyo, kutokana na mkondo wa maji, alifika umbali wa mita $10$ kutoka kwenye mti huo.
Tafuta umbali kutoka sehemu alipoanza hadi alipokwisha.
Solution:
Kwa kutumia nadharia ya Pythagoras tunapata kutoka $\triangle BAD$,
$CD^2 = AB^2 + BD^2$
$\therefore CD = \sqrt{(150\sqrt{3})^2 + 10^2}$
$= \sqrt{67500 + 100}$
$= \sqrt{67600}$
$= 260$
$\therefore$ Umbali kutoka mahali pa kuanzia hadi unakoenda ni $260$ m. (Jibu.)

Question: 20. Ngazi yenye urefu wa mita 16, ikiunda pembe ya $60^\circ$ na ardhi, hugusa kilele cha ukuta wa wima. Kulingana na kauli hiyo, onyesha maelezo yaliyo hapo juu kwa kutumia mchoro.
Solution: Hebu, kimo cha ukuta $AB = h$ mita, urefu wa ngazi $AC = 16$ mita na hutengeneza pembe na ardhi $\angle ACB = 60^\circ$

Question:
Fomu ya $60^\circ$ na ardhi, ngazi yenye urefu wa mita $16$ hugusa kilele cha ukuta wima.
Tafuta kimo cha ukuta.
Solution:
Kwa kutumia mchoro wa `a', Kutoka $\triangle ABC$,
$\sin \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{AC}$
Au, $\sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{h}{16}$
Au, $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{h}{16}$ [$\therefore \sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$]
Au, $2h = 16\sqrt{3}$
Au, $h = \frac{16\sqrt{3}}{2}$
Au, $h = 8\sqrt{3}$
$\therefore h = 13.86$ mita
$\therefore$ urefu wa ukuta $= 13.86$ mita (Jibu.)

Question:
Uundaji wa ngazi yenye urefu wa mita $16$ inayotegemeana na ukuta wima, na kutengeneza pembe ya $60^\circ$ na ardhi.
Mguu wa ngazi unahitaji kusogezwa umbali gani pamoja na mstari mlalo ili bado iguse ukuta na kutengeneza pembe ya $30^\circ$ na ardhi?
Solution:
$AB = 8\sqrt{3}$ metres
Hebu, ngazi inahitaji kuhamishwa $x$ metres kutoka nafasi yake ya awali.
Sasa, $AC = DE = 16$ metres
na $BE = BC + x$
Hapa, $BC^{2} + AB^{2} = AC^{2}$
au, $BC^{2} = AC^{2} - AB^{2}$
au, $BC^{2} = (16)^{2} - (8\sqrt{3})^{2}$
au, $BC^{2} = 64$
$\therefore BC = 8$
$\therefore BE = 8 + x$
Hivyo basi, $\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{BE}{DE} = \frac{BC+CE}{AC} = \frac{8+x}{16}$
au, $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{8+x}{16}$ au , $16+2x = 16\sqrt{3}$
au, $2x = 16\sqrt{3} - 16$
au, $x = \frac{16\sqrt{3} - 16}{2}$
$\therefore x = 5.86$ m.
$\therefore$ Ngazi inahitaji kuhamishwa $5.86$ metres kutoka nafasi yake ya awali (Jibu)

Question:
Katika mchoro, $CD = 96$ mita.
Je, kipimo cha $\angle CAD$ ni digrii ngapi?
Solution:
Kutoka kwenye mchoro,
$\angle ADC = 30^{\circ}$
na $\angle ACB = 60^{\circ}$
$\angle ACD = 180^{\circ} - 60^{\circ} = 120^{\circ}$
$\therefore \angle CAD = 180^{\circ} - (120^{\circ} + 30^{\circ})$
$= 180^{\circ} - 150^{\circ} = 30^{\circ}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Katika mchoro, $CD = 96$ mita.
Tafuta urefu wa $BC$.
Solution:
Urefu wa mnara $AB = h$ mita na pembe ya mwinuko $\angle ACB = 60^{\circ}|$ Tukisonga nyuma kutoka C, $CD =$
$96$ mita. Pembe ya mwinuko kwa D, $\angle ADB = 30^{\circ}$
Tuseme, urefu wa BC $x$ mita
$\therefore BD = BC + CD$
$= (x + 96)$ mita $|$ tuseme $BC = x$ mita
Kutoka $\triangle ABC$, $\tan \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{BC}$
au, $\tan 60^{\circ} = \frac{h}{x}$ au, $\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}$ $[\tan 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}]$
$\therefore x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ \quad ......... (i)
Kutoka $\triangle ABD$, $\tan \angle ADB = \frac{AB}{BD}$
au, $\tan 30^{\circ} = \frac{h}{x+96}$
au, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x+96}$ \quad $[\tan 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}]$
au, $\sqrt{3}h = x + 96$
au, $\sqrt{3}h = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 96$ \quad [Kutoka (i)]
au, $\sqrt{3}h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = 96$ au, $\frac{3h - h}{\sqrt{3}} = 96$
au, $\frac{2h}{\sqrt{3}} = 96$ au, $2h = 96\sqrt{3}$
au, $h = \frac{96\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore h = 83.138$ mita
Tukibadilisha thamani ya $h$ katika hesabu (i)
$x = \frac{96\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
$\therefore x = 48$
$\therefore$ urefu wa BC $48$ mita (Jibu.)

Question:
Katika mchoro, $CD = 96$ mita.
Tafuta yati wa $\triangle ACD$.
Solution:
Kutoka kwa `b',
urefu wa mnara $AB = h = 48\sqrt{3}$ mita
na $BC = x = 48$ mita
Imepewa, $CD = 96$ mita
$\therefore$ Katika $\triangle ABD$, $\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{AB}{AD}$
au, $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{48\sqrt{3}}{AD}$ au, $AD = 48\sqrt{3} \times 2$
$\therefore AD = 96\sqrt{3}$ mita
Katika $\triangle ABC$
$\sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{AB}{AC}$
au, $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{48\sqrt{3}}{AC}$
au, $\sqrt{3}AC = 48\sqrt{3} \times 2$
au, $AC = \frac{96\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}}$
$\therefore AC = 96$ mita
$\therefore$ Mzingo wa $\triangle ACD = (AC + CD + AD)$
$= (96 + 96 + 96\sqrt{3})$ mita
$= (192 + 166.28)$ mita
$= 358.277$ mita (Jibu.)

Question: Ikiwa pande za mraba wawili ni mita a na mita b mtawalia, uwiano wa maeneo yao utakuwaje?
Solution:
Urefu wa upande wa mraba wa $1 = \text{a metre}$
$\therefore \text{Eneo la mraba wa } 1 = \text{a} \times \text{a sq.metre} = \text{a}^2 \text{ sq.metre}$
Urefu wa upande wa mraba wa $2 = \text{b metre}$
$\therefore \text{Eneo la mraba wa } 2 = \text{b} \times \text{b sq.metre} = \text{b}^2 \text{ sq.metre}$
Sasa, $\frac{\text{eneo la mraba wa } 1}{\text{eneo la mraba wa } 2} = \frac{\text{a}^2}{\text{b}^2}$
$\therefore \text{Eneo la mraba wa } 1 \text{: Eneo la mraba wa } 2 = \text{a}^2 : \text{b}^2$
Jibu. $\text{a}^2 : \text{b}^2$

Question: Iwapo eneo la duara ni sawa na eneo la mraba, tafuta uwiano wa **mizunguko** yao.
Solution:
Tuchukulie, kipenyo cha duara ni r kitengo na urefu wa upande wa mraba ni x kitengo.
Tunajua, eneo la duara = $\pi r^2$ kitengo mraba
Eneo la mraba = $x^2$ kitengo mraba
Kwa hiyo, kulingana na swali, $\pi r^2 = x^2$
au, $\frac{r^2}{x^2} = \frac{1}{\pi}$
au, $\frac{r}{x} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi}} \quad \ldots \ldots (i)$
Tena, mzingo wa duara = $2\pi r$ kitengo
na mzingo wa mraba = $4x$ kitengo
$\therefore \frac{\text{mzingo wa duara}}{\text{mzingo wa mraba}} = \frac{2\pi r}{4x} = \frac{\pi r}{2x} = \frac{\pi}{2} \times \frac{r}{x}$
$= \frac{\pi}{2} \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi}}$ [kuingiza maadili kutoka (i)]
$= \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}$
$\therefore \text{Mzingo wa duara : mzingo wa mraba} = \sqrt{\pi} : 2$
Jibu. $\sqrt{\pi} : 2$

Question: Ikiwa uwiano wa namba mbili ni $3:4$ na L.C.M. yao ni $180$, tafuta namba hizo mbili.
Solution:
Dhana, namba ni $3x$ na $4x$
[ambapo $x$ ni jemedari mkuu]
$\therefore \text{K.K.M.K wa } 3x \text{ na } 4x \text{ ni} = 3 \times 4 \times x = 12x$
Kulingana na swali, $12x = 180$
au, $x = \frac{180}{12} \quad \therefore x = 15$
$\therefore \text{Namba ya kwanza}=3x = 3 \times 15 = 45 \text{ na}$
$\text{Namba ya pili}=4x = 4 \times 15 = 60$
Jibu. $45 \text{ na } 60.$

Question: Uwiano wa wanafunzi waliokosekana na waliokuwepo darasani mwako kwa siku moja ulipatikana kuwa $1:4$. Eleza idadi ya wanafunzi waliokosekana kwa asilimia ya idadi jumla ya wanafunzi.
Solution:
Kadiri idadi ya wanafunzi waliokosekana $= x$ na idadi ya wanafunzi waliokuwepo $= 4x$
[hapa x ni mara nyingi ya uwiano chanya]
Jumla ya idadi ya wanafunzi $= x + 4x = 5x$
$\therefore \text{Wanafunzi waliokosekana kwa asilimia ya jumla ya wanafunzi}$
$= \frac{\text{idadi ya wanafunzi waliokosekana}}{\text{jumla ya idadi ya wanafunzi}} \times 100\%$
$= \frac{x}{5x} \times 100\% = 20 \%$
Jibu. $20\%$

Question: Kitu hununuliwa kwanza kisha kinauzwa kwa hasara ya $28\%$. Tafuta uwiano wa gharama ya kununua na gharama ya kuuza.
Solution:
Tuseme, gharama ya kununua $= 100$
$\therefore$ Bei ya kuuza kwa hasara ya $28\%$ ni $=\text{Tk.}(100 - 28) = 72$
$\therefore \frac{\text{bei ya kuuza}}{\text{gharama ya kununua}} = \frac{72}{100} = \frac{18}{25}$
$\therefore \text{bei ya kuuza: bei ya kununua} = 18 : 25$
Jibu. $18 : 25$

Question: Jumla ya miaka ya baba na mwana ni miaka $70$. Miaka $7$ iliyopita uwiano wa miaka yao ulikuwa $5:2$. Je, uwiano wa miaka yao utakuwa upi baada ya miaka $5$?
Solution:
Miaka $7$ iliyopita, uwiano wa umri wa baba na mwana ulikuwa $5:2$.
$\therefore \text{Hebu, miaka } 7 \text{ iliyopita, umri wa baba ulikuwa } = 5x \text{ miaka}$
$\text{ na wa '' mwana '' } = 2x \text{ miaka}$
$\therefore \text{Umri wa baba kwa sasa } = (5x + 7) \text{ miaka}$
$\text{ na wa '' mwana '' } = (2x + 7) \text{ miaka}$
Kulingana na swali, $5x + 7 + 2x + 7 = 70$
au, $7x + 14 = 70$
au, $7x = 70 - 14$
au, $7x = 56$
au, $x = \frac{56}{7}$
$\therefore x = 8$
$\therefore \text{Umri wa baba utakuwa baada ya miaka } 5 = (5x + 7 + 5) \text{ miaka}$
$= (5x + 12) \text{ miaka}$
$= (5 \times 8 + 12) \text{ ,'}$
$= (40 + 12) \text{ ,'}$
$= 52 \text{ miaka}$
na umri wa mwana utakuwa baada ya miaka $5 = (2x + 7 + 5) \text{ miaka}$
$= (2x + 12) \text{ miaka}$
$= (2 \times 8 + 12) \text{ ,'}$
$= (16 + 12) \text{ ,'}$
$= 28 \text{ miaka}$
$\therefore \text{Uwiano wa miaka yao utakuwa baada ya miaka } 5 = 52 : 28$
$= 13 : 7$
Jibu. $13:7$

Question:
Ikiwa $a:b=b:c$, thibitisha kwamba,
 $\frac{a}{c}=\frac{a^2+b^2}{b^2+c^2}$
Solution:
Kutokana na, $a : b = b : c$
au, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c}$
au, $\frac{a^2}{b^2} = \frac{b^2}{c^2}$ [kwa kupandikiza pande zote mbili]
au, $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2} = \frac{b^2 + c^2}{c^2}$ [kwa kutumia componendo]
au, $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{b^2}{c^2}$ [kwa kutumia alternendo]
au, $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{ac}{c^2}$ [$\because \frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} \therefore ac = b^2$]
au, $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{a}{c}$
$\therefore \frac{a}{c} = \frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2}$ (Kuna uhakika)

Question:
Kama $a:b=b:c$, thibitisha kwamba,
$a^2b^2c^2\left(\frac{1}{a^3}+\frac{1}{b^3}+\frac{1}{c^3}\right)=a^3+b^3+c^3$
Solution:
Kutokana na, $a : b = b : c$
au, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c}$
$\therefore b^2 = ac$
$L.H.S. = a^2b^2c^2 \left(\frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3}\right)$
$= \frac{a^2b^2c^2}{a^3} + \frac{a^2b^2c^2}{b^3} + \frac{a^2b^2c^2}{c^3}$
$= \frac{b^2c^2}{a} + \frac{a^2c^2}{b} + \frac{a^2b^2}{c}$
$= \frac{b^2c^2}{a} + \frac{(ac)^2}{b} + \frac{a^2b^2}{c}$
$= \frac{b^2c^2}{a} + \frac{(b^2)^2}{b} + \frac{a^2(b^2)}{c}$ [$\because \frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} \therefore ac = b^2$]
$= \frac{ac \cdot c^2}{a} + \frac{b^4}{b} + \frac{a^2 \cdot ac}{c}$
$= c^3 + b^3 + a^3$
$= a^3 + b^3 + c^3 = R.H.S.$
$\therefore a^2b^2c^2 \left(\frac{1}{a^3} + \frac{1}{b^3} + \frac{1}{c^3}\right) = a^3 + b^3 + c^3$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Iwapo $a:b=b:c$, thibitisha kwamba,
$\frac{abc(a+b+c)^3}{(ab+bc+ca)^3}=1$
Solution:
Kapewa, $a : b = b : c \text{ yaani, } \frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c}$
Fikiria, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = k$
$\therefore b = ck$
$\therefore a = bk \cdot k = ck^2$
K.K.M. $= \frac{abc(a+b+c)^3}{(ab+bc+ca)^3}$
$= \frac{ck^2 \times ck \times c(ck^2 + ck + c)^3}{(ck^2 \times ck + ck \times c + c \times ck^2)^3}$
$= \frac{c^3k^3 \{c(k^2 + k + 1)\}^3}{(c^2k^3 + c^2k + c^2k^2)^3}$
$= \frac{c^3k^3 \times c^3(k^2+k+1)^3}{\{c^2k(k^2+1+k)\}^3}$
$= \frac{c^6k^3(k^2+k+1)^3}{c^6k^3(k^2+k+1)^3} = 1 = \text{K.K.B.}$
$\therefore \frac{abc(a+b+c)^3}{(ab+bc+ca)^3} = 1$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Tatua:
$\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x}}{1+\sqrt{1-x}}=\frac{1}{3}$
Solution:
$\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x}}{1+\sqrt{1-x}}=\frac{1}{3}$
au, $\frac{(1-\sqrt{1-x})+(1+\sqrt{1-x})}{(1-\sqrt{1-x})-(1+\sqrt{1-x})} = \frac{1+3}{1-3}$ [kwa kutumia kanuni ya "componendo and dividendo"]
au, $\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x}+1+\sqrt{1-x}}{1-\sqrt{1-x}-1-\sqrt{1-x}} = \frac{4}{-2}$
au, $\frac{2}{-2\sqrt{1-x}} = \frac{4}{-2}$
au, $\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x}} = 2$
au, $\frac{1}{1-x} = 4$ [kwa kupara pande zote mbili]
au, $4(1-x) = 1$ [kwa kuzidisha pande zote]
au, $4 - 4x = 1$
au, $-4x = 1 - 4$
au, $-4x = -3$
au, $x = \frac{3}{4}$
$\therefore$ Jibu ni $x = \frac{3}{4}$

Question:
Tatua:
    $81 \left(\frac{1-x}{1+x}\right)^3 = \frac{1+x}{1-x}$
Solution:
$81 \left(\frac{1-x}{1+x}\right)^3 = \frac{1+x}{1-x}$
au, $81 = \frac{1+x}{1-x} \times \left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right)^3$
au, $(9)^2 = \left\{\left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right)^2\right\}^2$
au, $\left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right)^2 = 9$ [kuchukua mzizi mraba]
au, $\frac{1+x}{1-x} = \pm 3$ [kuchukua mzizi mraba]
$\therefore \frac{1+x}{1-x} = 3$
au, $1+x = 3(1-x)$
au, $1+x = 3-3x$
au, $4x = 2$
$\therefore x = \frac{1}{2}$
au, $\frac{1+x}{1-x} = -3$
au, $1+x = -3(1-x)$
au, $1+x = -3+3x$
au, $4 = 2x$
au, $2x = 4$
$\therefore x = 2$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika $x = 2$ , $\frac{1}{2}$

Question:
Iwapo $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = \frac{c}{d}$, onyesha kwamba,
1) $\frac{a^3 + b^3}{b^3 + c^3} = \frac{b^3 + c^3}{c^3 + d^3}$
Solution:
Kipatikana, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = \frac{c}{d}$
Acha, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = \frac{c}{d} = k$
$\therefore c = dk$
$b = ck = dk \cdot k = dk^2$
$a = bk = dk^2 \cdot k = dk^3$
Upande wa Kushoto (L.H.S.) $= \frac{a^3 + b^3}{b^3 + c^3} = \frac{(dk^3)^3 + (dk^2)^3}{(dk^2)^3 + (dk)^3}$
$= \frac{d^3k^9 + d^3k^6}{d^3k^6 + d^3k^3} = \frac{d^3k^6(k^3 + 1)}{d^3k^3(k^3 + 1)} = k^3$
Upande wa Kulia (R.H.S.) $= \frac{b^3 + c^3}{c^3 + d^3} = \frac{(dk^2)^3 + (dk)^3}{(dk)^3 + d^3}$
$= \frac{d^3k^6 + d^3k^3}{d^3k^3 + d^3} = \frac{d^3k^3(k^3 + 1)}{d^3(k^3 + 1)}$
$= k^3$
$\therefore \frac{a^3 + b^3}{b^3 + c^3} = \frac{b^3 + c^3}{c^3 + d^3}$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question:
Kama $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c} = \frac{c}{d}$, onyesha kwamba,
     $(a^2 + b^2 + c^2)(b^2 + c^2 + d^2) = (ab + bc + cd)^2$
Ikiwa $x = \frac{4ab}{a+b}$, onyesha kwamba, $\frac{x+2a}{x-2a} + \frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = 2, a \ne b$.
Solution:
Imepewa, $x = \frac{4ab}{a+b}$
au, $x = \frac{2a \times 2b}{a+b}$
$\therefore \frac{x}{2a} = \frac{2b}{a+b}$ na $\frac{x}{2b} = \frac{2a}{a+b}$
kama, $\frac{x}{2a} = \frac{2b}{a+b}$
Kisha, $\frac{x+2a}{x-2a} = \frac{2b+a+b}{2b-a-b}$
[kwa kutumia kanuni ya componendo na dividendo]
$\therefore \frac{x+2a}{x-2a} = \frac{a+3b}{b-a}$ ..... (i)
Tena, kama $\frac{x}{2b} = \frac{2a}{a+b}$
Kisha, $\frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = \frac{2a+a+b}{2a-a-b}$
[kwa kutumia kanuni ya componendo na dividendo]
$\therefore \frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = \frac{3a+b}{a-b}$ ..... (ii)
Tukijumlisha hesabu (i) na (ii) tunapata,
$\frac{x+2a}{x-2a} + \frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = \frac{a+3b}{b-a} + \frac{3a+b}{a-b}$
$= \frac{a+3b}{b-a} + \frac{3a+b}{-(b-a)} = \frac{a+3b}{b-a} - \frac{3a+b}{b-a}$
$= \frac{a+3b-(3a+b)}{b-a} = \frac{a+3b-3a-b}{b-a}$
$= \frac{2b-2a}{b-a} = \frac{2(b-a)}{(b-a)}$
$= 2$
$\therefore \frac{x+2a}{x-2a} + \frac{x+2b}{x-2b} = 2$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question:
Kama $x = \frac{\sqrt[3]{m+1} + \sqrt[3]{m-1}}{\sqrt[3]{m+1} - \sqrt[3]{m-1}}$, onyesha kwamba
$x^3 - 3mx^2 + 3x - m = 0$.
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$x = \frac{\sqrt[3]{m+1} + \sqrt[3]{m-1}}{\sqrt[3]{m+1} - \sqrt[3]{m-1}}$
au, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \frac{\sqrt[3]{m+1} + \sqrt[3]{m-1} + \sqrt[3]{m+1} - \sqrt[3]{m-1}}{\sqrt[3]{m+1} + \sqrt[3]{m-1} - (\sqrt[3]{m+1} - \sqrt[3]{m-1})}$
[kwa kutumia kanuni ya componendo na dividendo]
au, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \frac{2\sqrt[3]{m+1}}{2\sqrt[3]{m-1}}$
au, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{m+1}{m-1}}$
au, $\left(\frac{x+1}{x-1}\right)^3 = \left(\sqrt[3]{\frac{m+1}{m-1}}\right)^3$ [kwa kupalilia pande zote mbili]
au, $\frac{(x+1)^3}{(x-1)^3} = \frac{m+1}{m-1}$
au, $\frac{x^3 + 3x^2 + 3x + 1}{x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 1} = \frac{m+1}{m-1}$
au, $\frac{x^3 + 3x^2 + 3x + 1 + x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 1}{x^3 + 3x^2 + 3x + 1 - (x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 1)} = \frac{m+1+m-1}{m+1-(m-1)}$
[Tena kwa kutumia kanuni ya componendo na dividendo]
au, $\frac{2x^3 + 6x}{2 + 6x^2} = \frac{2m}{2}$
au, $\frac{2(x^3 + 3x)}{2(1 + 3x^2)} = m$
au, $x^3 + 3x = m(1 + 3x^2)$ [kwa kuzidisha kwa kuvuka]
$\therefore x^3 - 3mx^2 + 3x - m = 0$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Ikiwa $x = \frac{\sqrt{2a+3b} + \sqrt{2a-3b}}{\sqrt{2a+3b} - \sqrt{2a-3b}}$, onesha kwamba,
$3bx^2 - 4ax + 3b = 0$.
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$x = \frac{\sqrt{2a+3b} + \sqrt{2a-3b}}{\sqrt{2a+3b} - \sqrt{2a-3b}}$
au, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \frac{\sqrt{2a+3b} + \sqrt{2a-3b} + \sqrt{2a+3b} - \sqrt{2a-3b}}{\sqrt{2a+3b} + \sqrt{2a-3b} - (\sqrt{2a+3b} - \sqrt{2a-3b})}$
[kwa kutumia componendo na dividendo]
au, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \frac{2\sqrt{2a+3b}}{2\sqrt{2a-3b}}$
au, $\frac{x+1}{x-1} = \sqrt{\frac{2a+3b}{2a-3b}}$
au, $\left(\frac{x+1}{x-1}\right)^2 = \left(\sqrt{\frac{2a+3b}{2a-3b}}\right)^2$ [Kwa kupandikiza pande zote mbili nguvu ya pili]
au, $\frac{(x+1)^2}{(x-1)^2} = \frac{2a+3b}{2a-3b}$
au, $\frac{(x+1)^2 + (x-1)^2}{(x+1)^2 - (x-1)^2} = \frac{2a+3b + 2a-3b}{2a+3b - (2a-3b)}$
[Tena kwa kutumia componendo na dividendo]
au, $\frac{2(x^2+1)}{4x} = \frac{4a}{6b}$
[$\therefore (a+b)^2+(a-b)^2 = 2(a^2+b^2)$ na $(a+b)^2-(a-b)^2=4ab$]
au, $\frac{x^2+1}{2x} = \frac{2a}{3b}$
au, $3b(x^2+1) = 4ax$ [kwa kuzidisha kimkato]
au, $3bx^2 + 3b = 4ax$
$\therefore 3bx^2 - 4ax + 3b = 0$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa $\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{(a+b)^2}{(b+c)^2}$, onyesha kwamba a, b, c huunda mpangilio wa idadi unaoendelea (progresi).
Solution:
Imepewa,
$\frac{a^2 + b^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{(a+b)^2}{(b+c)^2}$
au, $\frac{(b+c)^2}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{(a+b)^2}{a^2 + b^2}$ [kwa kubadilisha nafasi]
au, $\frac{b^2 + c^2 + 2bc}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{a^2 + b^2 + 2ab}{a^2 + b^2}$
au, $\frac{b^2 + c^2 + 2bc - (b^2 + c^2)}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{a^2 + b^2 + 2ab - (a^2 + b^2)}{a^2 + b^2}$
[kwa kugawanya pande zote]
au, $\frac{2bc}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{2ab}{a^2 + b^2}$
au, $\frac{c}{b^2 + c^2} = \frac{a}{a^2 + b^2}$ [kugawanya pande zote kwa $2b$]
au, $ab^2 + ac^2 = a^2c + b^2c$
au, $ac^2 - a^2c = b^2c - ab^2$
au, $ac(c - a) = b^2(c - a)$
au, $ac = b^2$
au, $\frac{ac}{bc} = \frac{b^2}{bc}$ [kugawanya pande zote kwa $bc$]
au, $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{b}{c}$
au, $a : b = b : c$
$\therefore a, b, c$ ziko katika uwiano mfuatano. (Imethibitishwa)
Exact Answer: a, b, c ziko katika uwiano unaoamriwa.

Question:
Ikiwa $\frac{x}{b+c} = \frac{y}{c+a} = \frac{z}{a+b}$, onyesha kwamba
$\frac{a}{y+z-x} = \frac{b}{z+x-y} = \frac{c}{x+y-z}$
Solution:
Tegemeeni, $\frac{x}{b+c} = \frac{y}{c+a} = \frac{z}{a+b} = k$
$\therefore x = k(b+c)$, $y = k(c+a)$, $z = k(a+b)$
Sasa, $y+z-x = k(c+a)+k(a+b)-k(b+c)$
$= k(c+a+a+b-b-c) = 2ak$
$\therefore \frac{a}{y+z-x} = \frac{a}{2ak} = \frac{1}{2k}$
Tena, $z+x-y = k(a+b)+k(b+c)-k(c+a)$
$= k(a+b+b+c-c-a)$
$= 2bk$
$\therefore \frac{b}{z+x-y} = \frac{b}{2bk} = \frac{1}{2k}$
Tena, $x+y-z = k(b+c)+k(c+a)-k(a+b)$
$= k(b+c+c+a-a-b)$
$= 2ck$
$\therefore \frac{c}{x+y-z} = \frac{c}{2ck} = \frac{1}{2k}$
Kama, $\frac{a}{y+z-x}$, $\frac{b}{z+x-y}$ na $\frac{c}{x+y-z}$
Kila uwiano unalingana na $\frac{1}{2k}$.
$\therefore \frac{a}{y+z-x} = \frac{b}{z+x-y} = \frac{c}{x+y-z}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Ikiwa $\frac{bz-cy}{a} = \frac{cx-az}{b} = \frac{ay-bx}{c}$, thibitisha kwamba
$\frac{x}{a} = \frac{y}{b} = \frac{z}{c}$
Solution:
Tuseme, $\frac{bz-cy}{a} = \frac{cx-az}{b} = \frac{ay-bx}{c} = k$
$\therefore bz-cy = ak$ \dotfill (i)
$\therefore cx-az = bk$ \dotfill (ii)
$\therefore ay-bx = ck$ \dotfill (iii)
Sasa tukizidisha milinganyo (i), (ii), na (iii) kwa a, b, na c mtawalia,
$abz-acy = a^2k$
$bcx-abz = b^2k$
$acy-cbx = c^2k$
$0 = k(a^2+b^2+c^2)$ [kwa kuongeza]
$\therefore k = 0$ [$\because$ Kwani a, b, c ni dhahiri, $a^2+b^2+c^2 \ne 0$]
Kwa hiyo, $\frac{bz-cy}{a} = 0$ Tena, $\frac{cx-az}{b} = 0$
au, $bz-cy = 0$ au, $cx-az = 0$
au, $bz = cy$ au, $cx = az$
$\therefore \frac{z}{c} = \frac{y}{b}$ \dotfill (iv) $\therefore \frac{x}{a} = \frac{z}{c}$ \dotfill (v)
Kutoka milinganyo (iv) na (v), $\frac{x}{a} = \frac{y}{b} = \frac{z}{c}$ (Imethibishwa)

Question:
Ikiwa $\frac{a+b-c}{a+b} = \frac{b+c-a}{b+c} = \frac{c+a-b}{c+a}$ na
$a+b+c \ne 0$, thibitisha kwamba $a=b=c$
Solution:
Kupewa,
$\frac{a+b-c}{a+b} = \frac{b+c-a}{b+c} = \frac{c+a-b}{c+a}$ na $a+b+c \ne 0$
au, $\frac{a+b-c-(a+b)}{a+b} = \frac{b+c-a-(b+c)}{b+c} = \frac{c+a-b-(c+a)}{c+a}$ [kwa dividendo]
au, $\frac{-c}{a+b} = \frac{-a}{b+c} = \frac{-b}{c+a}$
au, $\frac{c}{a+b} = \frac{a}{b+c} = \frac{b}{c+a}$ [kuzidisha kwa (-1)]
au, $\frac{a+b}{c} = \frac{b+c}{a} = \frac{c+a}{b}$ [kwa invertendo]
au, $\frac{a+b}{c}+1 = \frac{b+c}{a}+1 = \frac{c+a}{b}+1$ [kwa componendo]
au, $\frac{a+b+c}{c} = \frac{b+c+a}{a} = \frac{c+a+b}{b}$
au, $\frac{1}{c} = \frac{1}{a} = \frac{1}{b}$ [Kugawanya kwa $(a+b+c)$, ambapo $a+b+c \ne 0$]
au, $c=a=b$ [kwa invertendo]
$\therefore a=b=c$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Kama $\frac{x}{xa+yb+zc} = \frac{y}{ya+zb+xc} = \frac{z}{za+xb+yc}$ na $x+y+z \ne 0$, onyesha kwamba, kila uwiano ni $\frac{1}{a+b+c}$.
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$\frac{x}{xa+yb+zc} = \frac{y}{ya+zb+xc} = \frac{z}{za+xb+yc}$
Kutoka kwa sheria ya uwiano tunajua,
Ikiwa $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{c}{d} = \frac{e}{f}$, basi $\frac{a}{b} = \frac{c}{d} = \frac{e}{f} = \frac{a+c+e}{b+d+f}$
$\therefore$ Kutokana na, kila uwiano utakuwa sawa na uwiano unaofuata,
yaani, $\frac{x+y+z}{xa+yb+zc+ya+zb+xc+za+xb+yc}$
[Kuongeza visajilishi na vishuka]
$= \frac{x+y+z}{xa+xb+xc+ya+yb+yc+za+zb+zc}$
$= \frac{x+y+z}{x(a+b+c)+y(a+b+c)+z(a+b+c)}$
$= \frac{x+y+z}{(x+y+z)(a+b+c)}$
$= \frac{1}{a+b+c}$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa $(a+b+c)p = (b+c-a)q = (c+a-b)r = (a+b-c)s$, basi onyesha kwamba, $\frac{1}{q} + \frac{1}{r} + \frac{1}{s} = \frac{1}{p}$.
Solution:
Tuseme,
$(a+b+c)p = (b+c-a)q = (c+a-b)r = (a+b-c)s = k$
$\therefore p(a+b+c) = k$
au, $p = \frac{k}{a+b+c}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{p} = \frac{a+b+c}{k}$ \dotfill (i)
Tena, $q(b+c-a) = k$
au, $q = \frac{k}{b+c-a}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{q} = \frac{b+c-a}{k}$ \dotfill (ii)
na $r(c+a-b) = k$
au, $r = \frac{k}{c+a-b}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{r} = \frac{c+a-b}{k}$ \dotfill (iii)
Tena, $s(a+b-c) = k$
au, $s = \frac{k}{a+b-c}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{s} = \frac{a+b-c}{k}$ \dotfill (iv)
Tukijumlisha milinganyo (ii), (iii) na (iv) tunapata,
$\frac{1}{q} + \frac{1}{r} + \frac{1}{s} = \frac{b+c-a}{k} + \frac{c+a-b}{k} + \frac{a+b-c}{k}$
$= \frac{1}{k}(b+c-a+c+a-b+a+b-c)$
$= \frac{a+b+c}{k}$ [kutoka (i)]
$= \frac{1}{p}$
$\therefore \frac{1}{q} + \frac{1}{r} + \frac{1}{s} = \frac{1}{p}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Ikiwa $lx = my = nz$, basi onyesha kwamba,
$\frac{x^2}{yz} + \frac{y^2}{zx} + \frac{z^2}{xy} = \frac{mn}{l^2} + \frac{nl}{m^2} + \frac{lm}{n^2}$.
Solution:
Dhana, $lx = my = nz = k$
$\therefore x = \frac{k}{l}$, $y = \frac{k}{m}$ na $z = \frac{k}{n}$
L.H.S. (Upande wa Kushoto) $= \frac{x^2}{yz} + \frac{y^2}{zx} + \frac{z^2}{xy}$
$= \frac{\left(\frac{k}{l}\right)^2}{\frac{k}{m} \times \frac{k}{n}} + \frac{\left(\frac{k}{m}\right)^2}{\frac{k}{n} \times \frac{k}{l}} + \frac{\left(\frac{k}{n}\right)^2}{\frac{k}{l} \times \frac{k}{m}}$ [kwa kuingiza thamani za x, y na z]
$= \frac{\frac{k^2}{l^2}}{\frac{k^2}{mn}} + \frac{\frac{k^2}{m^2}}{\frac{k^2}{nl}} + \frac{\frac{k^2}{n^2}}{\frac{k^2}{ml}}$
$= \left(\frac{k^2}{l^2} \times \frac{mn}{k^2}\right) + \left(\frac{k^2}{m^2} \times \frac{nl}{k^2}\right) + \left(\frac{k^2}{n^2} \times \frac{ml}{k^2}\right)$
$= \frac{mn}{l^2} + \frac{nl}{m^2} + \frac{lm}{n^2}$
$= \text{R.H.S. (Upande wa Kulia)}$
$\therefore \frac{x^2}{yz} + \frac{y^2}{zx} + \frac{z^2}{xy} = \frac{mn}{l^2} + \frac{nl}{m^2} + \frac{lm}{n^2}$ (Imeonyeshwa).

Question:
Iwapo $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{a^2}{b^2}$ na $\frac{a}{b} = \sqrt{\frac{a+q}{a-q}}$ onyesha kwamba,
$\frac{p+q}{a} = \frac{p-q}{b}$.
Solution:
Imetolewa, $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{a^2}{b^2}$
au, $\frac{p+q}{p-q} = \frac{a^2+b^2}{a^2-b^2}$ [componendo na dividendo]
\dotfill (i)
Tena, $\frac{a}{b} = \sqrt{\frac{a+q}{a-q}}$
au, $\frac{a^2}{b^2} = \frac{a+q}{a-q}$ ;[kupanga kwa mraba]
au, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{a^2-b^2} = \frac{a+q+a-q}{a+q-(a-q)}$; [kwa componendo na dividendo]
au, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{a^2-b^2} = \frac{2a}{2q}$
$\therefore \frac{a^2+b^2}{a^2-b^2} = \frac{a}{q}$ \dotfill (ii)
Tunapata kutoka (i) na (ii),
$\frac{p+q}{p-q} = \frac{a}{q}$
$\therefore \frac{p+q}{a} = \frac{p-q}{q}$ (Imethibitishwa).

Question: Uzito wa 1 cm³ mbao ni gramu 0.7. Ni asilimia ngapi uzito wa mbao kwa uzito wa maji wenye kiasi sawa?
Solution:
Uzito wa sentimita mraba 1 wa mti ni desigrami 7.
Tunajua,
Uzito wa sentimita mraba 1 wa maji $= 1$ gramu $= 10$ desigrami.
Asilimia ya desigrami 7 kati ya desigrami 10
$= \frac{7}{10} \times 100 \% = 70 \%$
Jibu. $70\%$

Question: Gawa Tk. $300$ kati ya a, b, c, d jinsi kwamba uwiano wa sehemu ya a : sehemu ya b $= 2:3$, sehemu ya b : sehemu ya c $= 1:2$ na sehemu ya c : sehemu ya d $= 3:2$.
Solution:
Kupewa,
$a:b = 2:3$
$b:c = 1:2 = (1 \times 3) : (2 \times 3) = 3:6$
[kuzidisha sehemu zote mbili za uwiano kwa 3]
$c:d = 3:2 = (3 \times 2) : (2 \times 2) = 6:4$
[kuzidisha sehemu zote mbili za uwiano kwa 2]
$\therefore a:b:c:d = 2:3:6:4$
Weka, sehemu ya a ni Tk.$2x$
sehemu ya b ni Tk.$3x$
sehemu ya c ni Tk $6x$.
Na sehemu ya d ni Tk.$4x$
Kulingana na swali,
$2x + 3x + 6x + 4x = 300$
au, $15x = 300$
au, $x = \frac{300}{15}$
$\therefore x = 20$
$\therefore$ sehemu ya a ni Tk.$2x$ = Tk. $(2 \times 20)$ = Tk.$40$
sehemu ya b ni Tk.$3x$. = Tk. $(3 \times 20)$ = Tk.$60$
sehemu ya c ni Tk.$6x$ = Tk. $(6 \times 20)$ = Tk.$120$
Na sehemu ya d ni Tk.$4x$ = Tk. $(4 \times 20)$ = Tk. $80$
Jibu. sehemu ya a Tk.$40$, sehemu ya b Tk.$60$, sehemu ya c Tk.$120$ na sehemu ya d Tk.$80$

Question: Wavuvi watatu wamepata vipande 690 vya samaki. Uwiano wa sehemu zao ni $\frac{2}{3}$, $\frac{4}{5}$, na $\frac{5}{6}$. Kila mmoja atapata samaki wangapi?
Solution: Mawiano ya sehemu hizo ni $\frac{2}{3} : \frac{4}{5} : \frac{5}{6}$. Ili kurahisisha mawiano, tafuta denomoneta ya pamoja, ambayo ni 30. Mawiano yanakuwa $\frac{2}{3}\times 30 : \frac{4}{5}\times 30 : \frac{5}{6}\times 30 = 20:24:25$. Jumla ya sehemu za mawiano ni $20+24+25=69$. Mvuvi wa kwanza anapata $\frac{20}{69} \times 690 = 200$ samaki. Mvuvi wa pili anapata $\frac{24}{69} \times 690 = 240$ samaki. Mvuvi wa tatu anapata $\frac{25}{69} \times 690 = 250$ samaki.

Question: Uzunguko wa pembetatu ni 45 cm. Uwiano wa urefu wa pande zake ni $3:5:7$. Tafuta urefu wa kila upande.
Solution: Hebu pande za pembetatu ziwe $3x$, $5x$, na $7x$. Mzingo ni jumla ya pande, kwa hivyo $3x + 5x + 7x = 45$. Hii hurahisishwa kuwa $15x = 45$. Kugawanya kwa 15 kunatoa $x=3$. Urefu wa upande wa kwanza ni $3x = 3(3) = 9$ cm. Urefu wa upande wa pili ni $5x = 5(3) = 15$ cm. Urefu wa upande wa tatu ni $7x = 7(3) = 21$ cm.

Question: Ikiwa uwiano wa namba mbili ni $5:7$ na K.U.K. (Kikokotoo cha Upekee Kikubwa) chao ni $4$, ni K.U.D. (Kigawo cha Upekee Kidogo) cha namba hizo ni ipi?
Solution:
Uwiano wa namba mbili ni $5:7$
na H.C.F. yao ni $= 4$
Acha, namba ya kwanza $= 5x$
na namba ya pili $= 7x$
$\therefore$ H.C.F. ya namba hizo $= x$
na L.C.M. $= 5 \times 7 \times x = 35x$
Kulingana na swali, $x=4$
$\therefore$ L.C.M. ya namba hizo $= 35 \times 4 = 140$
Jibu. $140$

Question: Katika mchezo wa kriketi, jumla ya mbio zilizofungwa na Sakib, Mushfique na Mashrafi zilikuwa 171. Uwiano wa mbio zilizofungwa na Sakib na Mushfique, na uwiano wa mbio zilizofungwa na Mushfique na Mashrafi ulikuwa $3:2$. Ni mbio ngapi zilizofungwa na kila mmoja wao binafsi?
Solution:
Mbio zilizofungwa na Sakib : Mbio zilizofungwa na Mushfique $= 3:2$
$= (3 \times 3) : (2 \times 3)$
[kuzidisha pande zote mbili za uwiano kwa 3]
$= 9:6$
Mbio zilizofungwa na Mushfique : Mbio zilizofungwa na Mashrafi $= 3:2 = (3 \times 2) : (2 \times 2)$
$= 6:4$
[kuzidisha pande zote mbili za uwiano kwa 2]
$\therefore$ Mbio zilizofungwa na Sakib : Mbio zilizofungwa na Mushfique : Mbio zilizofungwa na Mashrafi $= 9:6:4$
Tegua, Mbio zilizofungwa na Sakib $= 9x$
Mbio zilizofungwa na Mushfique $= 6x$
Na, Mbio zilizofungwa na Mashrafi $= 4x$
Kulingana na swali,
$9x + 6x + 4x = 171$
au, $19x = 171$ au, $x = \frac{171}{19}$
$\therefore x = 9$
$\therefore$ Mbio zilizofungwa na Sakib $= 9x = (9 \times 9) = 81$
Mbio zilizofungwa na Mushfique $= 6x = (6 \times 9) = 54$
Na, Mbio zilizofungwa na Mashrafi $= 4x = (4 \times 9) = 36$
Jibu. Mbio zilizofungwa na Sakib, Mushfique na Mashrafi ni $81, 54$ na $36$ mbio mtiririko huo.

Question: Katika ofisi moja, kuna maafisa 2, makarani 7 na wahudumu 3. Ikiwa mhudumu mmoja anapata Tk. 1, karani mmoja anapata Tk. 2 na ofisa mmoja anapata Tk. 4. Jumla ya mishahara yao ni Tk. 150,000. Je, mshahara wao binafsi ni kiasi gani?
Solution:
Ikiwa mbeba hubeba anapata Tk. 1 basi karani hupata Tk. 2 na afisa hupata Tk. 4
$\therefore$ Uwiano wa mshahara wa afisa, karani na mbeba $= 4:2:1$
Hebu, Mshahara wa afisa $=$ Tk.$4x$
$\therefore$ Mshahara wa karani $=$ Tk.$2x$
Na Mshahara wa mbeba $=$ Tk. $x$
Kulingana na swali,
$4x \times 2 + 2x \times 7 + x \times 3 = 150000$
au, $8x + 14x + 3x = 150000$
au, $25x = 150000$
au, $x = \frac{150000}{25}$ $\therefore x = 6000$
$\therefore$ Mbeba 1 hupata Tk. $(1 \times 6000)$ au, Tk.$6000$
Karani 1 hupata Tk. $(6000 \times 2)$ au, Tk.$12000$
Na afisa 1 hupata Tk. $(6000 \times 4)$ au, Tk.$24000$
Jibu. Afisa hupata Tk.$24000$, Karani hupata Tk.$12000$ na mbeba hupata Tk.$6000$.

Question: Iwapo **upande** wa mraba huongezwa kwa $20\%$, ni asilimia gani ya ongezeko la eneo la mraba?
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa kila upande wa mraba ni kitengo kimoja.
$\therefore$ Eneo la mraba ni $a^2$ za mraba.
Baada ya kuongeza $20\%$, urefu wa kila upande utakuwa $(a + 20\%$ ya $a)$ kitengo
$= (a + \frac{20a}{100})$ kitengo $= (a + \frac{a}{5})$ kitengo
$= \frac{5a+a}{5}$ kitengo $= \frac{6a}{5}$ kitengo
Kwa hiyo, eneo la mraba ulioongezeka $= (\frac{6a}{5})^2$ za mraba
$= \frac{36a^2}{25}$ za mraba.
$\therefore$ Eneo lililoongezeka la mraba $(\frac{36a^2}{25} - a^2)$ za mraba
$= (\frac{36a^2 - 25a^2}{25})$ za mraba $= \frac{11a^2}{25}$ za mraba.
$\therefore$ Asilimia ya eneo lililoongezeka
$= \frac{\text{Eneo lililoongezeka}}{\text{Eneo la awali}} \times 100 = \frac{\frac{11a^2}{25}}{a^2} \times 100$
$= \frac{11a^2}{25} \times \frac{1}{a^2} \times 100 = 44$
Jibu. $44\%$

Question: Iwapo urefu wa mstatili umeongezeka kwa $10\%$ na upana umepungua kwa $10\%$, ni asilimia ngapi ongezeko au upungufu wa eneo la mstatili?
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa mstatili $= x$ kipimo na upana wa mstatili $= y$ kipimo
Kwa hiyo, eneo la mstatili $= xy$ za mraba kipimo
Urefu uliongezeka ni $10\%$ ya $x = (\frac{10}{100} \text{ ya } x)$ kipimo
$= \frac{x}{10}$ kipimo
Upana ulipungua ni $10\%$ ya $y = (\frac{10}{100} \text{ ya } y)$ kipimo
$= \frac{y}{10}$ kipimo
$\therefore$ Urefu wa mstatili mpya $= (x + \frac{x}{10})$ kipimo $= \frac{11x}{10}$ kipimo
na upana wa mstatili mpya $= (y - \frac{y}{10})$ kipimo $= \frac{9y}{10}$ kipimo
$\therefore$ Eneo la mstatili mpya $= (\frac{11x}{10} \times \frac{9y}{10})$ za mraba kipimo
$= \frac{99xy}{100}$ za mraba kipimo
Kupungua kwa eneo $= (xy - \frac{99xy}{100})$ za mraba kipimo
$= (\frac{100xy - 99xy}{100})$ za mraba kipimo
$= \frac{xy}{100}$ za mraba kipimo
$\therefore$ Asilimia ya eneo lililopungua
$= \frac{\text{Eneo lililopungua}}{\text{Eneo la awali}} \times 100 = \frac{\frac{xy}{100}}{xy} \times 100$
$= \frac{xy}{100} \times \frac{1}{xy} \times 100 = 1$

Jibu. $1\%$

Question: Katika shamba, uwiano wa uzalishaji ni $4:7$ kabla na baada ya umwagiliaji. Katika shamba hilo, uzalishaji wa mpunga hapo awali ulikuwa $304$ quintal. Je, uzalishaji wa mpunga ungekuwa kiasi gani baada ya umwagiliaji?
Solution:
Hebu, uzalishaji kabla ya umwagiliaji $= 4x$ quintal
Kisha, uzalishaji baada ya umwagiliaji $= 7x$ quintal
Kulingana na swali,
$4x = 304$
au, $x = \frac{304}{4}$
$\therefore x = 76$
$\therefore$ Uzalishaji baada ya umwagiliaji $= 7x$ quintal
$= (7 \times 76)$ quintal $= 532$ quintal
Jibu. 532 quintal.

Question: Iwapo uwiano wa mpunga na mchele unaozalishwa kutokana na mpunga ni $3:2$ na uwiano wa ngano na suzi unaozalishwa kutokana na ngano ni $4:3$, tafuta uwiano wa mchele na suzi unaozalishwa kutokana na wingi sawa wa **mchele** na **ngano**.
Solution:
Uwiano wa mbegu mbichi na wali unaozalishwa kutoka kwa mbegu mbichi $= 3:2 = 1:\frac{2}{3}$
[kugawanya kiasi chote cha uwiano kwa 3]
Tena, uwiano wa ngano na sembe unaozalishwa kutoka kwa ngano $= 4:3 = 1:\frac{3}{4}$
[kugawanya kiasi chote cha uwiano kwa 4]
Sasa, uwiano wa mbegu mbichi na wali unaozalishwa kutoka kwa mbegu mbichi kutoka kwa kiasi kilichowekwa $= 1:\frac{2}{3}$
na, uwiano wa ngano na sembe unaozalishwa kutoka kwa ngano kutoka kwa kiasi hicho hicho $= 1:\frac{3}{4}$
$\therefore$ Uwiano wa wali na sembe unaozalishwa kutoka kwa mbegu mbichi na ngano wa kiasi sawa $= \frac{2}{3}:\frac{3}{4}$
$= (\frac{2}{3} \times 12):(\frac{3}{4} \times 12) = 8:9$
$\therefore$ Uwiano unaohitajika $= 8:9$
Jibu. $8:9$

Question: Eneo la ardhi moja ni mita za mraba $432$. Iwapo uwiano wa urefu na upana wa ardhi hiyo na ardhi nyingine ni $3:2$ na $4:5$ mtawalia, basi ni eneo gani la ardhi nyingine?
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa ardhi ya kwanza $= 3x$ mita
$\therefore$ urefu wa ardhi ya pili $= 4x$ mita,
na upana wa ardhi ya kwanza $= 2y$ mita
$\therefore$ upana wa ardhi ya pili $= 5y$ mita
Eneo la ardhi ya kwanza $= 3x \times 2y$ za mraba
$= 6xy$ za mraba
Kulingana na swali, $6xy = 432$
au, $xy = \frac{432}{6}$
$\therefore xy = 72$
$\therefore$ Eneo la ardhi nyingine $= 4x \times 5y$ za mraba
$= 20xy$ za mraba
$= 20 \times 72$ za mraba
$= 1440$ za mraba.

Jibu. $1440$ za mraba.

Question: Zami na Simi wanakopa kiasi tofauti cha fedha kwa riba ya $10\%$ ya faida rahisi kila mwaka kutoka Benki moja, siku moja. Kiasi cha mtaji na faida ambacho Zami analipa baada ya miaka $2$ ni sawa na kiasi ambacho Simi analipa baada ya miaka $3$ kwa mtaji na faida. Bainisha uwiano wa mikopo yao.
Solution:
Hebu, Kiasi cha mkopo cha Zami na Simi ni $x$ Tk. na $y$ Tk. mtawalia.
Tunajua, Faida $=$ Mtaji $\times$ Kiwango cha faida $\times$ Muda
$\therefore$ Kwa faida rahisi ya $10\%$ baada ya miaka $2$ Zami atatoa faida Tk. $(x \times \frac{10}{100} \times 2) = \text{Tk.} \frac{x}{5}$
$\therefore$ Kwa faida rahisi ya $10\%$ baada ya miaka $3$ Simi atatoa faida $= \text{Tk.} (y \times \frac{10}{100} \times 3) = \text{Tk.} \frac{3y}{10}$
Zami atarejesha baada ya miaka 2 $= \text{Tk.} (x + \frac{x}{5})$
$= \text{Tk.} (\frac{5x+x}{5}) = \text{Tk.} \frac{6x}{5}$
Na Simi atarejesha baada ya miaka 3 $= (y + \frac{3y}{10})$ Tk.
$= (\frac{10y+3y}{10})$ Tk. $= \frac{13y}{10}$ Tk.
Kulingana na swali,
$\frac{6x}{5} = \frac{13y}{10}$
au, $60x = 65y$ [kwa kuzidisha kwa njia ya msalaba]
au, $\frac{x}{y} = \frac{65}{60}$
au, $\frac{x}{y} = \frac{13}{12} \therefore x:y = 13:12$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Uwiano wa wanafunzi waliopo na waliokosekana darasani kwa siku moja ni $1:4$.
Eleza asilimia ya wanafunzi waliokosekana dhidi ya jumla ya wanafunzi.
Solution:
Heka idadi ya wanafunzi waliokosekana = $x$
Na idadi ya wanafunzi waliopo = $4x$
[Hapa, $x$ ni mara kwa mara ya uwiano chanya]
$	herefore$ Jumla ya idadi ya wanafunzi = $x + 4x = 5x$
