Jibu. Uzungushi wa eneo la mstatili ni $96$ mita.

Question: Urefu wa kiwanja ni $80$ metre na upana wake ni $60$ metre. Kidimbwi kilichimbwa katika kiwanja hicho. Ikiwa upana wa kila upande wa mpaka unaozunguka kidimbwi ni $4$ metre, bainisha eneo la mpaka wa kidimbwi.
Solution:
Kutokana na taarifa,
Urefu wa kiwanja ni $80$ mita na upana wake ni $60$ mita
$\therefore$ Eneo la kiwanja $= (80 \times 60)$ mita za mraba.
$= 4800$ mita za mraba.
Kama ilivyo tena, urefu wa kidimbwi bila mpaka
$= (80 - 2 \times 4)$ mita $= 72$ mita
Upana wa kidimbwi bila mpaka
$= (60 - 2 \times 4)$ mita $= 52$ mita
$\therefore$ Eneo la kidimbwi bila mpaka $= (72 \times 52)$ mita za mraba $= 3744$ mita za mraba
$\therefore$ Eneo la mpaka $= (4800 - 3744)$ mita za mraba
$= 1056$ mita za mraba
Jibu. $1056$ mita za mraba.

Question: Urefu wa bustani ni $40$ mita na upana wake ni $30$ mita. Kuna kidimbwi ndani ya bustani chenye mpaka wa upana sawa unaokizunguka. Ikiwa eneo la kidimbwi ni $\frac{1}{2}$ ya eneo la bustani, tafuta urefu na upana wa kidimbwi.
Solution:
Kituo,
Urefu wa bustani ni mita $40$ na upana ni mita $30$
$\therefore$ Eneo la bustani $= (40 \times 30)$ mita za mraba.
$= 1200$ mita za mraba.
Acha, upana wa mpaka uwe mita $x$
$\therefore$ Urefu wa kidimbwi bila mpaka $=(40 - 2x)$ m
na upana wa kidimbwi bila mpaka $=(30 - 2x)$ m
$\therefore$ Eneo la kidimbwi bila mpaka $= (40 - 2x)(30 - 2x)$ mita za mraba.
$= (1200 - 80x - 60x + 4x^2)$ mita za mraba.
$= (4x^2 - 140x + 1200)$ mita za mraba.
Kulingana na swali, $4x^2 - 140x + 1200 = \frac{1}{2} \times 1200$
au, $4x^2 - 140x + 1200 - 600 = 0$
au, $4x^2 - 140x + 600 = 0$
au, $x^2 - 35x + 150 = 0$ [kugawanya pande zote kwa 4]
au, $x^2 - 30x - 5x + 150 = 0$
au, $x(x - 30) - 5(x - 30) = 0$
au, $(x - 30)(x - 5) = 0$
$\therefore x - 30 = 0$ au, $x - 5 = 0$
au, $x = 30$ au, $x = 5$
Lakini upana wa mpaka si sawa na upana wa bustani.
Hivyo, $x = 30$ haikubaliki. $\therefore x = 5$
$\therefore$ Urefu wa kidimbwi $= (40 - 2 \times 5)$ mita
$= (40 - 10)$ mita
$= 30$ mita
na upana wa kidimbwi $= (30 - 2 \times 5)$ mita
$= (30 - 10)$ mita
$= 20$ mita
Urefu ni $30$ mita, upana ni $20$ mita

Question: Nje ya mraba, kuna njia yenye upana wa mita $5$ inayozunguka. Kama eneo la njia ni mita za mraba $500$, tafuta eneo la mraba.
Solution:
Hebu, upande mmoja wa bustani ya mraba ni $x$ mita
$\therefore$ Eneo la bustani ya mraba $= x^2$ mita za mraba.
Imepewa, eneo la njia $= 500$ mita za mraba.
Kwa hiyo, eneo la shamba linalojumuisha njia
$= (x^2 + 500)$ mita za mraba ... ... ...(i)
Tena, urefu wa upande mmoja wa bustani pamoja na njia
$= (x + 2 \times 5)$ mita $= (x + 10)$ mita
$\therefore$ Eneo la bustani ya mraba inayojumuisha njia
$= (x + 10)^2$ mita za mraba
$= (x^2 + 20x + 100)$ mita za mraba .........(ii)
Sasa kutoka (i) na (ii) tunapata,
$x^2 + 20x + 100 = x^2 + 500$
au, $20x = 400$ au, $x = 20$
Kwa hiyo, eneo la bustani $= x^2$ mita za mraba.
$= 20^2$ mita za mraba $= 400$ mita za mraba.
$400$ mita za mraba.

Question: Kizunguko cha eneo la mraba ni sawa na kizunguko cha eneo la mstatili. Urefu wa eneo la mstatili ni mara tatu ya upana wake na eneo lake ni $768$ mita za mraba. Ni mawe mangapi yatahitajika kufunika eneo la mraba kwa mawe ya mraba yenye ukubwa wa $40$ cm kila moja?
Solution:
Imepewa,
Eneo la eneo la mstatili $= 768$ m$^2$
na upande mmoja wa jiwe la mraba $= 40$ cm $= \frac{40}{100}$ m $= 0.4$ m
Hebu, upana wa eneo la mstatili $= x$ m
na urefu wa eneo la mstatili $= 3x$ m
$\therefore$ Eneo la eneo la mstatili $= 3x \times x$ m$^2$
$= 3x^2$ m$^2$
Kulingana na swali, $3x^2 = 768$
au, $x^2 = 256$ $\therefore x = 16$
Sasa, mzingo wa mstatili $= 2(3x + x)$ m
$= 2 \times 4x$ mita
$= 2 \times 4 \times 16$ mita
$= 128$ mita
Kulingana na swali, Mzingo wa mraba $=$ Mzingo wa mstatili
$\therefore$ Mzingo wa mraba $= 128$ mita
$\therefore$ Upande mmoja wa mraba $= \frac{\text{Mzingo}}{4} = \frac{128}{4}$ m $= 32$ mita
Sasa, eneo la mraba $= (32)^2$ m$^2$
$= 1024$ m$^2$
Eneo la jiwe la mraba $= (0.4)^2$ m$^2$
$= 0.16$ m$^2$
$\therefore$ Idadi ya mawe yanayohitajika
$= \frac{\text{Eneo la eneo la mraba}}{\text{Eneo la jiwe moja la mraba}} = \frac{1024}{0.16} = 6400$
Idadi ya mawe ni $6400$

Question: Eneo la mstatili ni mita za mraba $160$. Ikiwa urefu utapunguzwa kwa $6$ mita, eneo hilo litakuwa eneo la mraba. Bainisha urefu na upana wa mstatili.
Solution:
Hebu,
Urefu wa eneo la mstatili $= x$ mita
na upana, $ = y$ mita
$\therefore$ Eneo la eneo la mstatili $= xy$ mita za mraba.
Kulingana na swali, $xy = 160$ ......... (i)
Tena, $x - 6 = y$
au, $x = y + 6$ ......... (ii)
Sasa, kutoka (i) na (ii) tunapata,
$(y + 6) y = 160$
au, $y^2 + 6y - 160 = 0$
au, $y^2 + 16y - 10y - 160 = 0$
au, $y(y + 16) - 10(y + 16) = 0$
au, $(y + 16)(y - 10) = 0$
$\therefore y + 16 = 0$ au, $y - 10 = 0$
$\therefore y = -16$ $\therefore y = 10$
$\therefore y = 10$, Kwani $y = -16$ hakukubaliki. [Kwa sababu urefu na upana haviwezi kuwa hasi]
Kutoka, (ii) tunapata
$x = 10 + 6 = 16$
Kwa hiyo, urefu wa mstatili ni $16$ mita
na upana, $10$ mita
Urefu ni $16$ mita na upana ni $10$ mita.

Question: Msingi wa kijiridisha-urefu ni $\frac{3}{4}$ ya kimo chake na eneo lake ni sentimita za mraba 363. Bainisha msingi na kimo cha kijiridisha-urefu hicho.
Solution:
Hebu, kimo cha kijobari $= h$ inchi
$\therefore$ Msingi wa kijobari $= h \times \frac{3}{4}$ inchi
$= \frac{3h}{4}$ inchi
$\therefore$ Eneo la kijobari $= \frac{3h}{4} \times h$ za mraba
$= \frac{3h^2}{4}$ za mraba
Kulingana na swali, $\frac{3h^2}{4} = 363$
au, $3h^2 = 363 \times 4$ au, $h^2 = \frac{363 \times 4}{3}$
au, $h^2 = 121 \times 4$ au, $h^2 = 484$
$\therefore h = 22$
$\therefore$ Kimo cha kijobari $= 22$ inchi
$\therefore$ Msingi wa kijobari $= \frac{3h}{4}$ inchi
$= \frac{3 \times 22}{4}$ inchi
$= \frac{66}{4}$ inchi $= 16.5$ inchi
Msingi na kimo cha kijobari ni $16.5$ inchi na $22$ inchi mtawalia.

Question: Eneo la kijimwamba ni sawa na eneo la mraba. Iwapo msingi wa kijimwamba ni $125$ m na kimo ni $5$ m, tafuta urefu wa diagonal wa mraba.
Solution:
Imepewa, msingi wa kijazilizi ni $125$ na kimo ni $5$ mita.
$\therefore$ Eneo la kijazilizi $= 125 \times 5$ mita za mraba.
$= 625$ mita za mraba.
Tuchukulie, urefu wa mraba $= a$ m.
$\therefore$ Eneo $= a^2$ mita za mraba.
Kulingana na swali, $a^2 = 625$ $\therefore a = 25$
$\therefore$ Urefu wa mpande $= a\sqrt{2}$ mita
$= 25\sqrt{2}$ mita $= 35.35$ mita
 Urefu wa mpande ni $35.35$ mita (takriban.)

Question: Urefu wa pande mbili za kijazilaba ni $30$ cm na $26$ cm. Kama upenyo wake mfupi ni $28$ cm, tafuta urefu wa upenyo mwingine.
Solution:
Hebu, $AC$ na $BD$ ziwe vipenyo vya kijemba $ABCD$ na $AC > BD$.
Katika mchoro, $AB = DC = 30$ cm , $AD = BC = 26$ cm na $BD = 28$ cm.
$\therefore$ Nusu ya mzingo wa $\triangle ABD$, $s = \frac{30 + 28 + 26}{2}$ cm
$= \frac{84}{2}$ cm $= 42$ cm
$\therefore$ Eneo la $\triangle ABD$
$= \sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}$ cm$^2$
$= \sqrt{42(42-30)(42-28)(42-26)}$ cm$^2$
$= \sqrt{42 \times 12 \times 14 \times 16}$ cm$^2$
$= \sqrt{112896}$ cm$^2$
$= 336$ cm$^2$
Sasa, tunachora $DF \perp AB$ na $CE \perp$ upanuzi wa $AB$
$\therefore$ Katika $\triangle ADF$ na $\triangle BCE$
$\angle DAF = \angle CBE$ [pembe zinazolingana]
$\angle AFD = \angle BEC = 1$ pembe ya kulia
na $AD = CB$ [$\therefore$ pande zinazopingana za kijemba ni sawa]
$\therefore \triangle ADF \cong \triangle BCE$
$\therefore DF = CE$ na $AF = BE$
Tena, eneo la $\triangle ABD = \frac{1}{2} \times AB \times DF = \frac{1}{2} \times 30 \times DF$
$= 15 DF$
$\therefore 15DF = 336$
au, $DF = \frac{336}{15}$ cm $= 22.4$ cm
$\therefore CE = 22.4$ cm
Katika pembetatu yenye pembe ya kulia $ADF$, $AD = 26$ cm, kimo (urefu wa juu) $DF = 22.4$ cm
$\therefore$ Kwa mujibu wa nadharia ya Pythagoras,
$AD^2 = DF^2 + AF^2$
au, $AF^2 = AD^2 - DF^2 = (26)^2 - (22.4)^2$
$= 676 - 501.76 = 174.24$
$\therefore AF = \sqrt{174.24}$ cm $= 13.2$ cm
$\therefore BE = 13.2$ cm
$\therefore AE = AB + BE = (30 + 13.2)$ cm $= 43.2$ cm
Katika pembetatu yenye pembe ya kulia $\triangle ACE$,
$AC^2 = AE^2 + CE^2 = (43.2)^2 + (22.4)^2$
$= 1866.24 + 501.76 = 2368$
$\therefore AC = \sqrt{2368} = 48.66$ (takribani.)
$\therefore$ Urefu wa kipenyo kingine $= 48.66$ cm (takribani)
 $48.66$ cm. (takribani.)

Question: Kizunguzungu cha rombus ni $180$ cm. Diagonali yake fupi ni $54$ cm. Pata diagonali nyingine na eneo la rombus.
Solution:
Hebu $ABCD$ iwe rhombo ambapo mianzo miwili $AC$ na $BD$ hukutana katika nukta $O$.
\nKulingana na taarifa,
Mzingo wa rhombo $= 180$ cm
Na mianzo mmoja $BD = 54$ cm

Upande wa rhombo,
$AB = \frac{\text{Mzingo}}{4} = \frac{180}{4}$ cm
$= 45$ cm

Tunajua, mianzo ya rhombo hugawanyana nusu kila mmoja kwa pembe za kulia.

$\therefore OB = \frac{1}{2} BD = \frac{1}{2} \times 54$ cm
$= 27$ cm

Kutoka katika pembetatu yenye pembe ya kulia $AOB$, tunapata:
$AB^2 = OA^2 + OB^2$
$\Rightarrow 45^2 = OA^2 + 27^2$
$\Rightarrow OA^2 = 45^2 - 27^2$
$\Rightarrow OA^2 = 1296$
$\therefore OA = 36$

$\therefore$ Mianzo $AC = 2 \times OA$
[Kwa kuwa $O$ ni sehemu ya katikati ya $AC$]
$= 2 \times 36$ cm
$= 72$ cm

Sasa, Eneo la rhombo $= \frac{1}{2} \times BD \times AC$
[Kwa kuwa eneo la rhombo $= \frac{1}{2} \times$ (bidhaa ya mianzo)]
$= \frac{1}{2} \times 54 \times 72$ cm mraba
$= 1944$ cm mraba

Hivyo basi, mianzo mwingine ni $72$ cm na eneo ni $1944$ cm mraba.

Question: Tofauti kati ya urefu wa pande mbili sambamba za **trapezium** ni $8$ cm na umbali wao wa perpendicular ni $24$ cm. Ikiwa eneo la **trapezium** ni $312$ cm², tafuta urefu wa pande mbili sambamba za **trapezium**.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa pande mbili sambamba uwe a na b na umbali wao wa perpendicular uwe h
Kulingana na swali, $312 = \frac{1}{2} (a + b) \times h$
au, $312 = \frac{1}{2} (a + b) \times 24 \quad [\therefore h=24]$
$\therefore a + b = 26 \quad \dots \dots \dots \dots \dots \dots \dots \dots (i)$
Tena, kulingana na swali, $a - b = 8 \quad \dots \dots \dots \dots \dots \dots (ii)$
Sasa, kwa kuongeza (i) na (ii) tunapata, $2a = 34$
$\therefore a = 17$
Kwa kutoa (i) na (ii) tunapata, $2b = 18 \quad \therefore b = 9$
$\therefore$ Urefu wa pande mbili sambamba ni $17$ cm na $9$ cm.
$17$cm. na $9$cm.

Question: Urefu wa pande mbili sambamba za kipenyo (trapezium) ni $31$cm na $11$ cm mtiririko, na pande mbili nyingine ni $10$ cm na $12$ cm mtiririko. Kokotoa eneo la kipenyo hicho.
Solution:
Hebu, pande mbili zinazofanana za pembe nne za kawaida (trapezium) $ABCD$ ziwe $AB$ na $CD$.
Kwa hiyo, $AB = 11$ cm, $CD = 31$ cm
$AD = 10$ cm na $BC = 12$ cm
Kutoka $CD$ chora mstari $DE$ wenye urefu sawa na $AB$ na unganisha $B, E$.
Sasa, $AB = DE$ na $AB \parallel DE$. Kwa hiyo, $ABED$ ni kijazabepande (parallelogram).
$\therefore BE = AD = 10$ cm na $CE = CD - DE$
$= CD - AB$ [$\therefore AB = DE$]
$= (31 - 11)$ cm $= 20$ cm
Nusu ya mzingo wa pembetatu $\triangle BEC$, $s = \frac{BC + CE + BE}{2}$
$= \frac{12 + 20 + 10}{2}$ cm
$= \frac{42}{2}$ cm $= 21$ cm
$\therefore$ Eneo la $\triangle BEC = \sqrt{s(s - BC)(s - CE)(s - BE)}$
$= \sqrt{21(21 - 12)(21 - 20)(21 - 10)}$ sq. cm
$= \sqrt{21 \times 9 \times 1 \times 11}$ sq. cm
$= \sqrt{9 \times 231}$ sq. cm
$= 3\sqrt{231}$ sq. cm
Chora mstari $BF \perp EC$. Hebu, $BF = h$ cm
Eneo la $\triangle BEC = \frac{1}{2} \times CE \times BF$
au, $3\sqrt{231} = \frac{1}{2} \times 20 \times h$
au, $3\sqrt{231} = 10h$
au, $10h = 3\sqrt{231}$
$\therefore h = \frac{3\sqrt{231}}{10}$
$\therefore BF = \frac{3\sqrt{231}}{10}$ cm
$\therefore$ Eneo la trapezium $= \frac{1}{2} (AB + CD)BF$
$= \frac{1}{2} (11 + 31) \times \frac{3\sqrt{231}}{10}$ sq. cm
$= \frac{1}{2} \times 42 \times \frac{3\sqrt{231}}{10}$ sq. cm
$= \frac{63\sqrt{231}}{10}$ sq. cm
$= 95.75$ sq. cm (takribani)
$95.75$ sq. cm (takribani)

Question: Umbali kutoka kituo hadi kilele cha oktagoni sawia ni $1.5$ mita. Kokotoa eneo la oktagoni sawia.
Solution:
Hebu, $ABCDEFGH$ iwe oktagoni ya kawaida. Unganisha alama za pembe kutoka katikati. Kama matokeo, kutakuwa na pembetatu ambazo maeneo yake ni sawa na kila mmoja na pembe katika kituo ni $360^\circ$.
$\therefore \angle COD = \frac{360^\circ}{8} = 45^\circ$.
Hebu, umbali kati ya alama za pembe na kituo uwe mita.
$\therefore a = 1.5$ mita.
$\therefore$ Eneo la $\triangle COD = \frac{1}{2} a.a \sin\angle COD$
$= \frac{1}{2} a^2 \sin 45^\circ$ mita mraba.
$= \frac{1}{2} \times (1.5)^2 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ mita mraba.
$= \frac{1}{2} \times 2.25 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ mita mraba.
$= \frac{2.25}{2\sqrt{2}}$ mita mraba.
$\therefore$ Eneo la oktagoni $= 8 \times$ Eneo la $\triangle COD$
$= 8 \times \frac{2.25}{2\sqrt{2}}$ mita mraba.
$= \frac{4\times 2.25}{\sqrt{2}}$
$= \frac{9}{\sqrt{2}}$
$= \frac{9\sqrt{2}}{2}$
$= 6.36$ mita mraba (takriban).

Question:
Urefu wa bustani ya maua yenye umbo la mstatili ni mita $150$ na upana wake ni mita $100$. Kwa ajili ya utunzaji wa bustani, kuna njia yenye upana wa mita $3$ inayopita katikati ya bustani, sambamba na urefu na upana wake.
   Bainisha eneo la njia.
Solution:
Kando ya urefu wa bustani, eneo la barabara
$= 150 \times 3$ m mraba
$= 450$ m mraba
na kando ya upana wa bustani, eneo la barabara
$= 100 \times 3$ m mraba
$= 300$ m mraba
$\therefore$ Eneo la jumla la barabara $= (450 + 300)$ m mraba
$= 750$ m mraba
Lakini eneo la $ABCD$ ambalo barabara mbili zinapishana $= 3$ m $\times 3$ m $= 9$ m mraba
Pamoja na eneo la barabara, eneo la sehemu ya kawaida limeongezwa mara mbili.
$\therefore$ Eneo la barabara $= (750 - 9)$ m mraba
$= 741$ m mraba.

Question:
Urefu wa bustani ya maua ya mstatili ni mita $150$ na upana wake ni mita $100$. Kwa ajili ya kutunza bustani, kuna njia yenye upana wa mita $3$ katikati ya bustani, iendayo kando ya urefu na upana wake.
     Je, ni matofali mangapi yenye urefu wa sentimita $25$ na upana wa sentimita $12.5$ yatahitajika kutengeneza njia hiyo kwa lami?
Solution:
Eneo la barabara $= 741$ sq. m.
Kutokana na kupewa, urefu wa tofali $= 25$ cm
$= 0.25$ mita
[$\therefore 1$ mita $= 100$ cm.]
Upana wa tofali $= 12.5$ cm
$= 0.125$ mita [$\therefore 1$ mita $= 100$ cm]
$\therefore$ Eneo la tofali
$= (0.25 \times 0.125)$ sq. m.
$= 0.03125$ sq. m.
$\therefore$ Idadi ya matofali yanayohitajika $= (741 \div 0.03125)$
$= 23,712$

Question: Pembe inayofunuliwa na kipande cha mviringo kwenye kituo ni $30^\circ$. Ikiwa kipenyo cha duara ni $126$ cm, bainisha urefu wa upinde.
Solution:
Hapa,
Kipenyo, $d = 126$ cm.
Radius, $r = \frac{126}{2}$ cm. $= 63$ cm.
Kama urefu wa bendi ni $s$,
Tunajua, $s = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r = \frac{30}{360} \times 2 \times 3.1416 \times 63$ cm.
$= 32.987$ cm.
$\therefore$ Urefu wa bendi $= 32.987$ cm. (takriban)
$32.987$ cm. (takriban)

Question: Hebu farasi azunguke uwanja kwa kasi ya mita $66$ kwa dakika kwa muda wa dakika $1\frac{1}{2}$. Bainisha kipenyo cha uwanja.
Solution:
Hebu, radiusi ya uwanja mviringo iwe $r$ mita na kituo chake ni O.
$\therefore$ Kipenyo, AB $= 2r$ metre
Katika dakika 1 farasi hufunika mita 66.
$\therefore$, dakika $1\frac{1}{2}$ au $\frac{3}{2}$ , , , $66 \times \frac{3}{2} = 99$ m.
Ikiwa radiusi ni $r$, mzingo wa uwanja $= 2\pi r$
Kulingana na sharti,
$2\pi r = 99$
au, $2r = \frac{99}{\pi} = \frac{99}{3.1416} = 31.513$
$\therefore$ Kipenyo ni mita 31.513 (takriban.)
Jibu. Mita 31.513 (takriban.)

Question: Eneo la sehemu ya duara ni $77$ mita za mraba na radius ni $21$ mita. Tambua pembe iliyopunguzwa katikati na safu ya mviringo.
Solution:
Kipawa, Radiusi wa duara, $r = 21$ m.
Eneo la sehemu ya duara $= 77$ sq. m.
Tunajua, eneo la sehemu ya duara $= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \pi r^2$
Ambapo, $\theta =$ pembe inayotegwa katikati na sehemu ya duara (kwa digrii).
Kulingana na swali, $77 = \frac{\theta}{360} \times 3.1416 \times 21^2$
au, $\theta = \frac{77 \times 360}{3.1416 \times 21 \times 21}$
$\therefore \theta = 20.008^\circ$
 $20.008^\circ$ (takriban.)

Question: Tafadhali tambua eneo la sehemu ya duara, ambapo **radius** ya duara ni $14$ cm na upinde huunda pembe ya $75^\circ$ katikati yake.
Solution:
Hebu, kipenyo cha duara, $r = 14$ cm. na pembe inayojengwa katikati na sehemu ya duara, $\theta = 75^\circ$.
Tunajua,
Eneo la sehemu ya duara $= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2$
$= \frac{75}{360} \times 3.1416 \times (14)^2$ cm. za mraba.
$= \frac{75}{360} \times 3.1416 \times 196$ cm. za mraba.
$= 128.282$ cm. za mraba. (takriban)
Jibu. $128.282$ cm. za mraba. (takriban)

Question: 5. Kuna barabara inayozunguka shamba la mviringo. Mzingo wa nje wa barabara ni mkuu kuliko mzingo wa ndani kwa mita $44$. Tafuta upana wa barabara.
Solution:
Hebu, kipenyo cha duara la ndani $= r$ mita na upana wa barabara ni $x$ mita
$\therefore$ Kipenyo cha duara la nje $= (r+x)$ m.
Mzingo wa duara la ndani $= 2\pi r$ m.
Mzingo wa duara la nje $= 2\pi(r+x)$ m.
Kulingana na swali, $2\pi (r+x) = 2\pi r + 44$
au, $2\pi (r+x) - 2\pi r = 44$
au, $2\pi (r+x-r) = 44$
au, $2\pi x = 44$
au, $x = \frac{44}{2\pi}$
au, $x = \frac{22}{3.1416}$
$\therefore x = 7.003$
$\therefore$ Upana wa barabara ni $= 7.003$ mita (takriban.)
Jibu. $7.003$ mita (takriban.)

Question: 6. Kipenyo cha bustani ya duara ni mita $26$. Kuna barabara yenye upana wa mita $2$ inayozunguka bustani hiyo. Tambua eneo la barabara.
Solution:
Kutokana na kipenyo cha hifadhi ya mviringo, $2r = 26$ m.
$\therefore$ **Nusu kipenyo** $r = \frac{26}{2}$ mita $= 13$ m.
$\therefore$ Eneo la hifadhi $= \pi r^2$
$= 3.1416 \times 13^2$ m. za mraba
$= 530.93$ m. za mraba (takriban.)
Tena, upana wa barabara $= 2$ m.
**Nusu kipenyo** cha hifadhi ikiwa na njia $= (13+2)$ m. $= 15$ m.
$\therefore$ Eneo la hifadhi ikiwa na njia $= \pi \times 15^2$
$= 3.1416 \times 225$ m. za mraba
$= 706.86$ m. za mraba (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Eneo la njia $= (706.86 - 530.93)$ m. za mraba (takriban.)
$= 175.93$ m. za mraba (takriban.)
Jibu. $175.93$ m. za mraba (takriban.)

Question: Kipenyo cha gurudumu la mbele la gari ni $28$ cm na kipenyo cha gurudumu la nyuma ni $35$ cm. Ili kufunika umbali wa $88$ mita, mara ngapi zaidi gurudumu la mbele litazunguka kuliko gurudumu la nyuma?
Solution:
Radi ya gurudumu la mbele la gari $= \frac{28}{2}$ cm.
$= 14$ cm.
, , nyuma , , , , $= \frac{35}{2}$ cm..
Kwa hiyo, mzingo wa gurudumu la mbele
$= 2 \times 3.1416 \times 14$ cm.
$= 87.9648$ cm.(takriban.)
Na mzingo wa gurudumu la nyuma
$= 2 \times 3.1416 \times \frac{35}{2}$ cm.
$= 109.956$ cm.

Sasa, $88$ metre $= 88 \times 100$ cm.
Gurudumu la mbele litazunguka ili kufunika $88$ metre
$= \frac{88 \times 100}{87.9648}$ mara
au, $100.04$ mara
au, $100$ mara(takriban.)
Na gurudumu la nyuma litazunguka ili kufunika $88$ metre
$= \frac{88 \times 100}{109.956}$ mara
au, $80.032$ mara
au, $80$ mara(takriban.)
Kwa hiyo, gurudumu la mbele litazunguka zaidi ya gurudumu la nyuma
$= (100-80) = 20$ mara
Jibu. $20$ mara

Question: Mzingo wa duara ni mita $220$. Bainisha urefu wa upande wa mraba, uliojumuishwa ndani ya duara hilo.
Solution:
Hebu,
Kipenyo cha duara $= r$ metre
na ABCD ni mraba ulioandikwa kwenye duara.
Tunajua, mzingo wa duara $= 2\pi r$ kitengo
Kulingana na swali, $2\pi r = 220$
au, $r = \frac{220}{2\pi} = \frac{220}{2 \times 3.1416} = 35.014$
$\therefore$ Kipenyo cha duara AC $= 2r = 2 \times 35.014$ metre
$= 70.028$ metre
Sasa, diagonal ya mraba ABCD ni AC $= d$
$d = \sqrt{2} \cdot a$
$[\because a = \text{urefu wa kila upande wa mraba}]$
$\therefore a = \frac{d}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{70.028}{\sqrt{2}}$ metre $= \frac{70.028 \times \sqrt{2}}{2}$ metre
$= 49.5173$ metre
$\therefore$ Urefu wa upande wa mraba ni $49.517$ metre (takribani)
Jibu. $49.517$ metre (takribani)

Question: Mzingo wa duara ni sawa na mzingo wa pembetatu *sawa sisi*. Bainisha uwiano wa maeneo yao.
Solution:
Tuseme, kipenyo cha duara $=r$
Hivyo, eneo la duara $= \pi r^2$
na mzingo $= 2\pi r$
Kulingana na swali,
Mzingo wa duara $=$ mzunguko wa pembetatu sawa.
$\therefore$ Urefu wa upande mmoja, $a = \frac{2\pi r}{3}$
Sasa, eneo la pembetatu $= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} a^2$ sehemu za mraba
$= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \left(\frac{2\pi r}{3}\right)^2$ sehemu za mraba
$= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \cdot \frac{4\pi^2 r^2}{9}$ sehemu za mraba
$= \frac{\pi^2 r^2}{3\sqrt{3}}$ sehemu za mraba
$\therefore$ Eneo la duara: Eneo la pembetatu sawa
$= \pi r^2 : \frac{\pi^2 r^2}{3\sqrt{3}} = 3\sqrt{3} : \pi$ Jibu. $3\sqrt{3} : \pi$

Question: Urefu, upana na kimo cha mstatili wa pande tatu ni mita $16$, mita $12$ na mita $4.5$ mtawalia. Bainisha eneo la jumla la nyuso zake zote, urefu wa diagonal na ujazo wake.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu $a=16$ cm.,
Upana, $b=12$ cm. na
urefu $c=4.5$ cm. wa umbo la mstatili.
Tunajua, eneo la jumla la uso wa umbo la mstatili
$=2(ab+bc+ca)$ kizio mraba
$=2(16\times 12+12\times 4.5+4.5\times 16)$ mita mraba
$=2(192+54+72)$ mita mraba
$=2\times 318$ mita mraba
$=636$ mita mraba
$\therefore$ Urefu wa diagonali ya umbo la mstatili
$=\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}$ kizio
$=\sqrt{(16)^2+(12)^2+(4.5)^2}$ m.
$=\sqrt{256+144+20.25}$ m.
$=\sqrt{420.25}$ m.
$=20.5$ m.
Ujazo wa umbo la mstatili
$=(16\times 12\times 4.5)$ mita ujazo
$=864$ mita ujazo

Jibu. Eneo la jumla la uso wa umbo la mstatili ni $636$ mita mraba, diagonal ni $20.5$ m na ujazo ni $864$ mita ujazo

Question: Uwiano wa urefu, upana na kimo cha akimna ni $21:16:12$ na urefu wa diagonal ni $87$ cm. Bainisha eneo la uso mzima wa akimna hiyo.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu, upana na kimo cha umbo la mstatili kiwe a cm, b cm. na c cm. mtiririko huo.
Hebu, $a=21x$, $b=16x$ na $c=12x$
Urefu wa diagonali ya umbo la mstatili
$=\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}$ cm.
Kulingana na swali,
$\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}=87$
au, $a^2+b^2+c^2=87^2$ [kupa kote pande zote]
au, $(21x)^2+(16x)^2+(12x)^2=(87)^2$
au, $441x^2+256x^2+144x^2=7569$
au, $841x^2=7569$
au, $x^2=\frac{7569}{841}$
au, $x^2=9$
$\therefore x=3$
Eneo la jumla la uso
$=2(ab+bc+ca)$ cm. za mraba.
$=2(21x\times 16x+16x\times 12x+12x\times 21x)$ cm. za mraba.
$=2(336x^2+192x^2+252x^2)$ cm. za mraba.
$=2\times 780x^2$ cm. za mraba.
$=1560\times 3^2$ cm. za mraba. [$\therefore x=3$]
$=1560\times 9$ cm. za mraba.
$=14040$ cm. za mraba.
Jibu. Eneo la jumla la uso ni $14040$ cm. za mraba.

Question: Kisanduku chenye umbo la mstatili kimewekwa juu ya msingi wenye eneo la $48$ mita za mraba. Kimo chake ni $3$ m na diagonal ni $13$ m. Bainisha urefu na upana wa kisanduku hicho chenye umbo la mstatili.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa kisanduku cha mstatili $=a$ m
Upana, $''$ $''$ $''$ $=b$ m
$\therefore$ Eneo la msingi $=ab$ sq.cm. $=48$ square metre
Tunajua, urefu wa diagonali ya kisanduku cha mstatili $=\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}$
Kupewa, kimo, $c=3$ cm.
$\therefore 13=\sqrt{a^2+b^2+3^2}$
au, $169=a^2+b^2+9$ [kukiweka sawa pande zote]
au, $a^2+b^2=169-9=160$ ......... (i)
Tunajua, $(a+b)^2=a^2+b^2+2ab$
$=160+2\times 48 [\therefore a^2+b^2=160\text{ na }ab=48]$
$=256$
$\therefore a+b=\sqrt{256}=16$ ......... (ii)
Tena, $(a-b)^2=a^2+b^2-2ab$
$=160-96=64$
$\therefore a-b=8$ ......... (iii)
Sasa kwa kuongeza (ii) na (iii) tunapata,
$2a=24$
au, $a=12$
na kwa kutoa (iii) kutoka (ii) tunapata,
$2b=8$,
au, $b=4$
Kwa hiyo, urefu $12$ m. na upana $4$ m.
Jibu. Urefu ni $12$ m. na upana ni $4$ m.

Question: Vipimo vya nje vya kisanduku cha mbao chenye umbo la mstatili ni $8$ cm., $6$ cm. na $4$ cm. mtawalia, na eneo la uso mzima wa ndani ni $88$ cm$^2$. Pata unene wa mbao wa kisanduku hicho.
Solution:
Acheni, unene wa mbao wa kisanduku uwe $x$ cm.
Kwa pande za ndani,
urefu, $a=(8-2x)$ cm.
upana, $b=(6-2x)$ cm. na
urefu, $c=(4-2x)$ cm.
$\therefore$ Eneo la uso mzima wa ndani wa kisanduku
$=2(ab+bc+ca)$ sq.cm
$=2\{(8-2x)(6-2x)+(6-2x)(4-2x)+(8-2x)(6-2x)\}$
$=2(24-20x+4x^2+32-24x+4x^2+48-28x+4x^2)$
$=2(12x^2-72x+104)$
Kulingana na swali,
$2(12x^2-72x+104)=88$
au, $12x^2-72x+104=44$ [kugawanya pande zote kwa 2]
au, $12x^2-72x+104-44=0$
au, $12x^2-72x+60=0$
au, $12(x^2-6x+5)=0$
au, $x^2-6x+5=0$
au, $x^2-5x-x+5=0$
au, $x(x-5)-1(x-5)=0$
au, $(x-5)(x-1)=0$
Aidha, $(x-5)=0$ au, $(x-1)=0$
$\therefore x=5$ $\therefore x=1$
Lakini unene wa kisanduku hauwezi kuzidi upana wake yaani $x \ne 5$
$\therefore x=1$
Jibu. Unene wa kisanduku ni $1$ cm.

Question: Urefu wa ukuta ni mita $25$, kimo chake ni mita $6$, na upana wake ni cm $30$. Urefu, upana na kimo cha tofali ni cm $10$, cm $5$, na cm $3$. mtawalia. Bainisha idadi ya matofali yanayohitajika kujenga ukuta kwa matofali hayo.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa ukuta, $a=25$ m.
$=25\times 100$ cm.
$=2500$ cm.
Urefu $b=6$ m.
$=6\times 100$ cm. [$\therefore 1$ m. $=100$ cm.]
$=600$ cm.
na unene $c=30$ cm.
$\therefore$ Kiasi cha ukuta $=abc$ cm$^3$.
$=2500\times 600\times 30$ cm$^3$.
$=45000000$ cm$^3$.

Tena,
Hebu, urefu wa tofali $p=10$ cm.
upana wa tofali $q=5$ cm.
na urefu wa tofali $r=3$ cm.
$\therefore$ Kiasi cha tofali $=pqr$ cm$^3$.
$=10\times 5\times 3$ cm$^3$.
$=150$ cm$^3$.

Hebu idadi ya matofali yanayohitajika kujenga ukuta $=x$
Kwa hiyo, kiasi cha ukuta $=x\times$ kiasi cha tofali
$=x\times 150$ cm$^3$.
$=150x$ cm$^3$.

Kulingana na swali,
$150x=45000000$
au, $x=\frac{45000000}{150}$
$\therefore x=300000$
$\therefore$ Idadi ya matofali yanayohitajika kujenga ukuta ni $300000$

Question: Eneo la uso wa mchemraba ni sentimita mraba $2400$. Bainisha diagonal ya mchemraba.
Solution:
Hebu, $a$ iwe urefu wa ubavu wa akat)=(1).
$\therefore$ Eneo la uso mzima $=6a^2$ cm mraba.
Kulingana na swali, $6a^2=2400$
au, $a^2=\frac{2400}{6}$
au, $a^2=400$
$\therefore a=20$
$\therefore$ Urefu wa ubavu wa akat)=(1) $=20$ cm.
$\therefore$ Diagonali ya akat)=(1) $=\sqrt{3}a$ cm.
$=\sqrt{3}\times 20$ cm.
$=34.641$ cm. (Takribani)

Question: Kitufe cha msingi wa silinda yenye urefu wa $12$ cm. na **kipenyo** cha $5$ cm. Tafuta eneo la uso mzima na ujazo wa silinda.
Solution:
Hebu, kimo cha silinda $h=12$ cm na kipenyo cha msingi $r=5$ cm.
$\therefore$ Eneo la uso mzima $=2\pi r (r+h)$ sm mraba
$=2\times 3.1416\times 5\times (5+12)$ sm mraba.
$=6.2832\times 5\times 17$ sm mraba.
$=534.072$ sm mraba. (takriban.)
na ujazo wa silinda $=\pi r^2 h$ sm$^3$.
$=3.1416\times 5^2 \times 12$ sm$^3$.
$=942.48$ sm$^3$. (takriban.)

Question: Eneo la sehemu iliyopinda ya silinda duara ya mlingoti ni $100$ cm$^2$ na ujazo wake ni $150$ cm$^3$. Tafuta kimo na kipenyo cha silinda.
Solution:
Hebu, kimo cha silinda kiwe h cm.
na kipenyo cha msingi kiwe r cm.
Eneo la sehemu iliyopinda ya silinda $=2\pi rh$ za mraba.
na ujazo wake $=\pi r^2 h$ cm$^3$
Kulingana na swali,
$2\pi rh = 100$ ......... (i)
$\pi r^2 h = 150$ ......... (ii)
Kutoka (ii) $\div$ (i) tunapata,
au, $\frac{\pi r^2 h}{2\pi rh} = \frac{150}{100}$
au, $\frac{r}{2}=1.5$
au, $r=1.5\times 2$
$\therefore r=3$
Kwa hiyo, kipenyo cha msingi $=3$ cm.
Kwa kuingiza thamani ya r katika (i) tunapata,
$2\pi\times 3\times h = 100$
au, $6\times 3.1416\times h = 100$
au, $h=\frac{100}{6\times 3.1416}$
$\therefore h=5.305$
Kwa hiyo kimo cha silinda $=5.305$ cm.

Question: Eneo la kando la silinda duara ya mzingo ni $4400$ cm$^2$. Ikiwa urefu wake ni $30$ cm, tafuta eneo la uso wake mzima.
Solution:
Hebu, urefu wa silinda duara yenye kimo sawa, $h=30$ cm.
na kipenyo cha msingi ni $r$ cm.
$\therefore$ Eneo la kando la uso $=2\pi rh$ za mraba.
$=2\times 3.1416\times r\times 30$ za mraba.sentimeta.
$=60\times 3.1416\times r$ za mraba.sentimeta.
Kulingana na swali, $60\times 3.1416\times r=4400$
au, $r=\frac{4400}{60\times 3.1416}=\frac{220}{3\times 3.1416}$
$\frac{220}{9.4248}=23.34267$
$\therefore$ Kipenyo cha msingi $r=23.34267$ cm. (takribani)
$\therefore$ Eneo la uso mzima wa silinda
$=2\pi r (r+h)$ za mraba.sentimeta.
$=2\times 3.1416\times 23.34267 (23.34267+30)$ za mraba.sentimeta.
$=6.2832\times 23.34267\times 53.34267$ za mraba.sentimeta.
$=7823.6$ za mraba.sentimeta.(takribani)
$\therefore$ Eneo la uso mzima wa silinda ni $7823.6$ za mraba.sentimeta.

Question: Mviringo wa ndani na wa nje wa bomba la chuma ni $12$ cm na $14$ cm mtawalia, na urefu wa bomba ni $5$ mita, tafuta uzito wa bomba la chuma ambapo uzito wa chuma cha $1$ cm$^3$ ni $7.2$ gm.
Solution:
Kutokana na tatizo, kipenyo cha ndani cha bomba $=12$ cm.
na kipenyo cha nje cha bomba $=14$ cm.
Urefu $h=5$ m. $=5\times 100$ cm.
$=500$ cm.
na uzito uliotolewa wa chuma cha gramu $7.2$ $=1$ cm$^3$.
Tunajua,
kiasi cha sehemu ya pembeni ya silinda $=\pi r^2 h$ cm$^3$.
$\therefore$ Kiasi cha nje cha bomba $=\pi\times (\frac{14}{2})^2 \times 500$ cm$^3$.
$=76969.2$ cm$^3$. (kama).
na kiasi cha ndani cha bomba $=\pi\times (\frac{12}{2})^2 \times 500$ cm$^3$.
$=56548.8$ cm$^3$. (kama).
Sasa,
Kiasi cha chuma $=$ Kiasi cha nje cha bomba $-$ kiasi cha ndani cha bomba
$=(76969.2-56548.8)$ cm$^3$.
$=20420.4$ cm$^3$. (kama).
$\therefore$ Uzito wa chuma cha bomba $=20420.4\times 7.2$ gm
$=147026.88$ gm
$=\frac{147026.88}{1000}$ kg
$=147.027$ kg (kama).

Question: Vipimo vya eneo la mraba na eneo la mstatili ni sawa. Urefu wa mstatili ni mara 3 ya upana wake na eneo lake ni mita za mraba 1200. Tambua mzunguko wa mstatili kwa kutumia kigezo, $x$.
Solution:
Hebu, Urefu wa mstatili = x mita
Urefu wa upana = x mita
\therefore Mzingo wa Mstatili = 2(x + 3x) = 2 \times 4x
= 8x mita

Question: Vipenyo vya eneo la mraba na eneo la mstatili ni sawa. Urefu wa mstatili ni mara 3 ya upana wake na eneo lake ni mita za mraba 1200. Bainisha eneo la mraba.
Solution:
Eneo la mstatili = (3x \times x) m² = 3x² m²
Kulingana na swali, 3x² = 1200
au, x² = \frac{1200}{3}
au, x² = 400
\therefore x = 20 mita
\therefore Upana wa mstatili = 20 m
Urefu wa mstatili = (3 \times 20) m = 60 m
\therefore Mcheduara wa mstatili = 2(60 + 20) m
= (2 \times 80) m
= 160 mita

Hebu, upande wa mraba = a m
Mcheduara wa mraba huo = 4a m
Kwa kuwa, Mcheduara wa mraba huo = Mcheduara wa mstatili
\therefore 4a = 160 [Kutoka 'a']
au, a = \frac{160}{4}
\therefore a = 40 mita
Tunajua,
Eneo la mraba = a² m² = (40)² m²
= 1600 m²

Question: Vizingiti vya eneo la mraba na eneo la mstatili vinafanana. Urefu wa mstatili ni mara 3 ya upana wake na eneo lake ni mita za mraba 1200. Fikiria njia yenye upana wa mita 1.5 inayozunguka eneo la mstatili. Ni matofali mangapi yenye ukubwa wa 25 cm x 12.5 cm yatahitajika kutengeneza njia hiyo kwa lami?
Solution:
Urefu wa mstatili $= 60$ m, upana $= 20$ m

Urefu wa mstatili pamoja na barabara $= (60 + 2\times 1.5)$ m.
$= (60 + 3)$ m.
$= 63$ m.

Upana wa mstatili pamoja na barabara $= (20 + 2\times 1.5)$ m.
$= (20 + 3)$ m.
$= 23$ m.

Eneo la mstatili pamoja na barabara $= (63 \times 23)$ mita za mraba.
$= 1449$ mita za mraba.
Eneo la mstatili bila barabara
$= (\text{Urefu} \times \text{upana})$
$= (60 \times 20)$ mita za mraba.
$= 1200$ mita za mraba.
$\therefore$ Eneo la barabara $= (1449 - 1200)$ mita za mraba. $= 249$ mita za mraba.

Kutokana na kwamba, eneo la uso wa tofali $= 25 \times 12.5$ cm za mraba
$= \frac{25 \times 12.5}{100 \times 100}$ mita za mraba.
$= .03125$ mita za mraba.
Kwa hiyo, idadi ya matofali $= \frac{249}{.03125}$
$= 7968$

Question: Tafuta namba isiyo na kikomo kati ya $\sqrt{3}$ na $4$.
Solution:
Hapa, $\sqrt{3}=1.7320508 \ldots$
 
Tuchukulie, $a=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}+4}{2} \approx 2.866$ na $b=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}+4+4}{3} \approx 3.244$

Ni wazi kwamba $a$ na $b$ zote ni namba halisi na zote ni kubwa kuliko $\sqrt{3}$ na ndogo kuliko $4$ kwa sababu 
$a$ ni wastani wa namba mbili zisizo sawa $\sqrt{3}$ na $4$, na $b$ ni wastani wa namba $\sqrt{3}, \ 4 $ na $4$. 

Hiyo ni kusema, $\sqrt{3} < 2.866 < 4$ na $\sqrt{3} < 3.244  < 4$

Tena, $a$ na $b$ haziwezi kuonyeshwa kama sehemu za vipande. 

$ \therefore a$ na $b$ ni namba zinazohitajika. 

Kwa kweli tunaweza kuunda namba zisizo na kikomo kama hizi za kiasi.
Exact Answer: a na b ni namba zinazohitajika.

Question: Thibitisha kwamba unapoongeza moja (1) kwenye mazao ya namba asili nne (4) zinazofuatana, matokeo huwa mraba kamili.
Solution:
Heka namba zinazofuatana ziwe $x, \ x+1, \ x+2, \ x+3$।

Ikiwa tutaongeza $1$ kwenye bidhaa ya namba hizi 4 tunapata:

\qquad $x(x+1)(x+2)(x+3)+1$

\qquad $=x(x+3)(x+1)(x+2)+1$

\qquad $=(x^2+3x)(x^2+3x+2)+1$

\qquad $=a(a+2)+1 \ \text{[Tuzingatie $x^2+3x = a$  ]}$

\qquad $= a^2+2a+1 = (a+1)^2$

\qquad $=(x^2+3x+1)^2$

ambayo ni mraba kamili. Kwa hiyo, wakati $1$ inapoongezwa kwenye bidhaa ya namba asilia nne zinazofuatana, hii ni mraba kamili.

Question: Geuza sehemu ndogo za desimali zinazojirudia zifuatazo $0.\dot{3}$, $0.\dot{2}\dot{4}$, na $42.34\dot{7}\dot{8}$ ziwe sehemu ndogo za kawaida.
Geuza $5.23\dot{4}5\dot{7}$ kuwa sehemu ya kawaida.
Geuza $45.2\dot{3}4\dot{6}$ kuwa sehemu ya kawaida.
Geuza $32.\dot{5}6\dot{7}$ kuwa sehemu ya kawaida.

$32.\dot{5}6\dot{7}=\dfrac{32567-32}{999}=\dfrac{32535}{999}=\dfrac{3615}{111}=\dfrac{1205}{37}=32\dfrac{21}{37}$\\
$\therefore$ sehemu ya kukokotoa inayohitajika ni $32\dfrac{21}{37}$.

Question: Geuza $5.\dot{6}$, $7.3\dot{4}\dot{5}$, na $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3}$ kuwa desimali zinazorudiarudia.
Solution: Drazi za desimali zinazorudiwa $5.\dot{6}$, $7.3\dot{4}\dot{5}$, na $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3}$ zina tarakimu zisizorudiwa zinazolingana na $0$, $1$, na $2$ mtawalia. Hapa $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3}$ ina idadi kubwa zaidi ya tarakimu katika sehemu isiyorudiwa, kwa hiyo, ili kuzigeuza kuwa madraza sawa ya desimali zinazorudiwa tunapaswa kuwa na tarakimu $2$ katika sehemu isiyorudiwa ya kila namba. $5.\dot{6}$, $7.3\dot{4}\dot{5}$ na $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3}$ madraza ya desimali zinazorudiwa yana, mtawalia, tarakimu $1$, $2$ na $3$ katika sehemu inayorudiwa. LCM ya $1$, $2$ na $3$ ni $6$. Kwa hivyo, ili kuzigeuza kuwa madraza sawa ya desimali zinazorudiwa tunapaswa kuwa na tarakimu $6$ katika sehemu inayorudiwa ya kila namba. Hivyo, $5.\dot{6} = 5.66\dot{6}6666\dot{6}$, $7.3\dot{4}\dot{5} = 7.34\dot{5}4545\dot{4}$ na $10.78\dot{4}2\dot{3} = 10.78\dot{4}2342\dot{3}$. Madraza yanayotakiwa ya desimali zinazorudiwa ni mtawalia $5.66\dot{6}6666\dot{6}$, $7.34\dot{5}4545\dot{4}$ na $10.78\dot{4}2342\dot{3}$.

Question: Geuza $1.7643$, $3.\dot{2}\dot{4}$ na $2.78\dot{3}4\dot{6}$ kuwa sehemu ndogo zinazofanana za desimali zinazorudiarudia.
Solution:
Katika $1.7643$ tuna tarakimu $4$ katika sehemu isiyorudiwa na haina sehemu inayorudiwa. Katika $3.\dot{2}\dot{4}$ idadi ya tarakimu katika sehemu isiyorudiwa ni $0$ na ile ya sehemu inayorudiwa ni $2$; katika $2.78\dot{3}4\dot{6}$ idadi ya tarakimu katika sehemu isiyorudiwa ni $2$ na ile katika sehemu inayorudiwa ni $3$. Hapa idadi kubwa zaidi ya tarakimu zisizorudiwa ni $4$ na idadi ya tarakimu katika sehemu zinazorudiwa ni $2$ na $3$, ambazo LCM yake ni $6$. Kwa hiyo kila nambari lazima iwe na tarakimu $4$ zisizorudiwa na tarakimu $6$ zinazorudiwa.
\\
$\therefore $ $1.7643 = 1.7643\dot{0}0000\dot{0}$, $3.\dot{2}\dot{4} = 3.2424\dot{2}4242\dot{4}$ na $2.78\dot{3}4\dot{6} = 2.7834\dot{6}3463\dot{4}$
\\
Vigaizo vinavyotakiwa vya desimali vinavyorudiwa vinayofanana kwa mtiririko ni $1.7643\dot{0}0000\dot{0}$, $3.2424\dot{2}4242\dot{4}$ na $2.7834\dot{6}3463\dot{4}$

Question: Ongeza $3.\dot{8}\dot{9}$, $2.1\dot{7}\dot{8}$ na $5.89\dot{7}9\dot{8}$.
Ongeza $8.9\dot{4}7\dot{8}$, $2.346$ na $4.\dot{7}\dot{1}$.
Toa $5.24\dot{6}7\dot{3}$ kutoka $8.2\dot{4}\dot{3}$.
Tekua $16.\dot{4}3\dot{7}$ kutoka $24.45\dot{6}4\dot{5}$.
Zidisha $4.\dot{3}$ na $5.\dot{7}$.
Solution:
$$4.\dot{3}  = \dfrac{43-4}{9}=\dfrac{39}{9}=\dfrac{13}{3}$$
$$5.\dot{7}  = \dfrac{57-5}{9}=\dfrac{52}{9}$$

$$\therefore 4.\dot{3} \times 5.\dot{7} = \dfrac{13}{3} \times \dfrac{52}{9} = \dfrac{676}{27}=25.\dot{0}3\dot{7}$$

Matokeo yanayotarajiwa ni $25.\dot{0}3\dot{7}$.

Question: Zidisha $0.2\dot{8}$ na $42.\dot{1}\dot{8}$.
Hesabu ni kiasi gani cha $2.5 \times 4.\overline{35} \times 1.2\overline{34}$?
Gawa $7.\dot{3}\dot{2}$ kwa $0.2\dot{7}$.
Solution:
$$7.\dot{3}\dot{2}=\dfrac{732-7}{99}=\dfrac{725}{99}$$
        $$0.2\dot{7}=\dfrac{27-2}{90}=\dfrac{25}{90}=\dfrac{5}{18}$$

$$\therefore 7.\dot{3}\dot{2} \div 0.2\dot{7} = \dfrac{725}{99} \div \dfrac{5}{18} = \dfrac{725}{99} \times \dfrac{18}{5} = \dfrac{290}{11}=26.\dot{3}\dot{6}$$

Matokeo yanayotarajiwa ni $26.\dot{3}\dot{6}$.

Question: Gawanya $2.\dot{2}71\dot{8}$ kwa $1.9\dot{1}\dot{2}$.
Gawanya $9.45$ kwa $2.8\dot{6}\dot{3}$.
Solution:
$$9.45 = \dfrac{945}{100} ‌\qquad \qquad \qquad 2.8\dot{6}\dot{3}=\dfrac{2863-28}{990}=\dfrac{2835}{990}$$
$$\therefore 9.45 \div 2.8\dot{6}\dot{3} = \dfrac{945}{100} \div \dfrac{2835}{990} = \dfrac{945}{100} \times \dfrac{990}{2835} = \dfrac{189\times 99}{2\times 2835} = \dfrac{33}{10}=3.3$$                             
Matokeo yanayohitajika ni   $3.3$

Question: $A = \{x \mid x \text{ ni kigezo cha } 7 \text{ na } 7 \le x \le 28\}$
Solution:
Vitu vya $A$ ni  $7, 14, 21, 28$.

Hapa, kila kitu ni kipimo cha $7$ na hakizidi $28$.

 $\therefore$ $A = \{x:x |\text{ni kipimo cha }  7 $   \text{na}  $0<x \leq 28\}$

Question: Bainisha $B = \{x:x, \    \text{ni kigawanyo cha } 28\}$ kwa kutumia njia ya orodha.
Solution:
Hapa,
$28 = 1 \times 28= 2 \times 14= 4 \times 7$

$\therefore$ viviga vya $28$ ni $1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 28$

Hivyo basi, seti inayotakiwa ni $B = \{1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 28\}$

Question: $C = \{x:x$ ni namba kamili chanya na $x^{2} < 18\}$ kwa kutumia mbinu ya orodha.
Solution:
$1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ...$ ni namba kamili chanya.

Hapa, ikiwa

        $x=1$ basi,  $x^{2} = 1^{2} = 1; $ ikiwa $\ x=2$  basi,  $x^{2} = 2^{2} = 4$

Ikiwa        $x=3$  basi,  $x^{2}=3^{2}=9; $ ikiwa $\ x=4$ basi,  $x^{2} = 4^{2} = 16$

        Ikiwa $x=5$  basi,  $x^{2} = 5^{2} = 25$ ;  ambayo ni kubwa kuliko    $18$.


$\therefore$ kama inavyotakiwa na masharti, namba kamili chanya zinazokubalika ni $1, 2, 3$ na $4$.

$\therefore$ seti iliyotolewa ni   $C = \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$

Question: Thibitisha kwamba mkusanyiko wa namba zote za asili ni mkusanyiko usio na mwisho.
Solution:
Kikundi cha namba asili $N = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, ...\}$

Kikundi $A = \{1, 3, 5, 7, ...\}$ kinachojumuisha namba asili ambazo si jozi kutoka kwa kikundi $N$.

Kikundi $B= \{2, 4, 6, 8, ...\}$ kinachojumuisha namba asili ambazo ni jozi kutoka kwa kikundi $N$.

Kikundi cha namba $C =\{3, 6, 9, 12, ...\}$ ambazo ni mbalimbali za $3$ kutoka kwa $N$.

Hapa, vikundi vinavyojumuisha vitu kutoka kwa $N$ haviwezi kuamuliwa kwa kuhesabu. Kama matokeo, $A, B, C$ ni vikundi visivyo na kikomo.

$\therefore N$ ni kikundi kisicho na kikomo.
Exact Answer: N ni seti isiyo na kikomo.

Question: Andika vi subset vya $P = \{x, y, z\}$ na utambue yale yaliyo *proper* subsets.
Solution:
Zimetolewa,   $P = \{x, y, z\}$

Vigawe vya $P$  ni  $\{x, y, z\}, \{x, y\},  \{x, z\},  \{y, z\}, \{x\},  \{y\},  \{z\},  \varnothing$.

Vigawe sahihi vya $P$  ni $\{x, y\},  \{x, z\},  \{y, z\}, \{x\},  \{y\},  \{z\},  \varnothing$।

Question: Ikiwa $P =\{x:x $ \text{ ni kigezo cha} $12$ $\}$ na $Q= \{ x:x $ ni mgawo wa $3$ na $x \leq 12\}$ kisha ubaini $P - Q$.
Solution:
Kufuatana na $P=\{x:x$ ni sababu ya $12$ $\}$

Hapa, vigawo vya $12$ ni $1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12$

$\therefore$ $P = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12\}$

Tena, $Q= \{ x:3$ ni sababu ya $x$ na $x \leq 12\}$

Hapa, namba zilizo chini ya au sawa na $12$ ambazo zinagawanyika kwa $3$ ni $3, 6, 9, 12$

$\therefore$ $Q = \{3, 6, 9, 12\}$

$\therefore$ $P - Q = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12\} - \{3, 6, 9, 12\} = \{1, 2, 4\}$

Seti ni: $\{1, 2, 4\}$

Question: Hebu $C = \{3, 4, 5\}$ na $D = \{4, 6, 8\}$ bainisha $C \cup D.$
Ikiwa $P = \{x \in N: 2 < x \leq 6\}$ na $Q = \{x \in N: x$ ni namba ya pili na $x\leq 8\}$ bainisha $P \cap Q.$
Solution:
Kupewa

$P = \{x \in N: 2 < x \leq 6\} = \{3, 4, 5, 6\}$

$Q = \{x \in N: x$ ni namba ya jozi na     $x\leq 8\} = \{2, 4, 6, 8\}$

$\therefore$   $P \cap Q = \{3, 4, 5, 6\} \cap \{2, 4, 6, 8\} = \{4, 6\}$

Seti itakayobainishwa ni   $\{4, 6\}$

Question: Tafuta idadi ya vipengele vya seti pambizo za nguvu: $A = \varnothing$,  $B = \{a\}$,  $C = \{a, b\}.$
Solution:
Hapa $P(A) = \{\varnothing\}$.

$\therefore$ idadi ya vipengele vya $A$ ni $0$ na idadi ya vipengele vya seti yake ya nguvu ni
$ = 1 = 2^0$.

Tena, $P(B) = \{\{a\}, \varnothing\}$.

$\therefore$ idadi ya vipengele vya $B$ ni $1$, na idadi ya vipengele vya seti yake ya nguvu ni
$ = 2 = 2^1$.

Na $P(C) = \{\{a\}, \{b\}, \{a, b\}, \varnothing\}$.

$\therefore$ idadi ya vipengele vya $C$ ni $2$ na idadi ya vipengele vya seti yake ya nguvu ni
$ = 4 = 2^2$.

Hivyo, ikiwa idadi ya vipengele vya seti ni $n$, basi idadi ya vipengele vya seti yake ya nguvu ni $2^n$.
Exact Answer: ikiwa idadi ya vipengele vya seti ni n, basi idadi ya vipengele vya seti yake ya nguvu ni 2^n.

Question: Ikiwa $(2x+y, 3)=(6, x-y)$  basi bainisha $(x, y).$
Solution:
Kutokana na  $(2x+y, 3)=(6, x-y)$

Kama ilivyo kwa masharti ya jozi zilizoamriwa,

$2x + y = 6 \cdots\cdots (1)$

$x - y = 3 \cdots\cdots (2)$

Kwa kuongeza milinganyo $(1)$ na $(2)$ tunapata $3x=9$ au $x=3$

Kuweka thamani ya $x$ katika milinganyo $(1)$ tunapata, $6+y=6$ au $y=0$

$\therefore (x, y) = (3, 0)$

Question: Ikiwa $P = \{1, 2, 3\}$, $Q = \{3, 4\}$, $R = P \cap Q$ basi bainisha $P\times R$ na $R\times Q.$
Bainisha seti ya namba asilia ambazo zina salio sawa na $23$ zinapogawa $311$ na $419.$
Solution:
Namba asilia ambazo huacha $23$ kama riba wakati zinapogawa $311$ na $419$ zitakuwa kubwa kuliko $23$ na zitakuwa mgawanyo wa pamoja wa $311-23 = 288$ na $419-23 = 396$.

Acha $A$ kiwe kilele cha namba asilia zilizo kubwa kuliko $23$ na zinazogawa $288$.

Hapa $288 = 1 \times 288 = 2 \times 144 = 3 \times 96 = 4 \times 72 = 6 \times 48 = 8 \times 36 = 9 \times 32 = 12 \times 24 = 16 \times 18$

$\therefore A = \{24, 32, 36, 48, 72, 96, 144, 288\}$

Acha $B$ kiwe kilele cha namba asilia zilizo kubwa kuliko $23$ na zinazogawa $396$.

Hapa $396 = 1 \times 396 = 2 \times 198 = 3 \times 132 = 4 \times 99 = 6 \times 66 = 9 \times 44 = 11 \times 36 = 12 \times 33 = 18 \times 22$

$\therefore B = \{33, 36, 44, 66, 99, 132, 198, 396\}$

$\therefore$ $A \cap B= \{24, 32, 36, 48, 72, 96, 144, 288\} \cap \{33, 36, 44, 66, 99, 132, 198, 396\}$

$\therefore$ $A \cap B= \{36\}$

Kilele kinachotafutwa ni $\{36\}$.

Question: Kati ya wanafunzi $100$, $88$ walifaulu Bangla, $80$ walifaulu Hisabati na $70$ walifaulu masomo yote mawili. Onyesha taarifa hizo katika mchoro wa Venn, na uhesabu ni wanafunzi wangapi walishindwa katika masomo yote mawili.
Solution:
Katika mchoro wa Venn, eneo la mstatili huwakilisha $U$, seti ya wanafunzi $100$. Seti za wanafunzi waliofaulu Bangla na Hisabati huashiriwa kwa mtiririko na $B$ na $M$. Kama matokeo, mchoro wa Venn umegawanywa katika seti $4$ zisizoingiliana zikiashiriwa na $P, Q, R$ na $F$.

Hapa, seti ya wanafunzi waliofaulu masomo yote ni $Q = B\cap M$, idadi yake ni $70$.

$P$ ni seti ya wanafunzi waliofaulu Bangla tu. Idadi yake ni $|P|= 88 - 70 = 18.$

$R$ ni seti ya wanafunzi waliofaulu Hisabati tu. $\therefore, \ |R|= 80 - 70 = 10.$

Wanafunzi waliofaulu angalau somo moja ni $P \cup Q\cup R = B\cup M$, na idadi inayolingana ni $18 + 10 + 70 = 98.$

$F$ ni seti ya wanafunzi waliofeli masomo yote, na
$|F|= 100 - 98 = 2.$

$\therefore$ idadi ya wanafunzi waliofeli masomo yote ni $2.$

Question: Ikiwa $P = \{2, 3, 4\}$, $Q = \{4, 6\}$ na kwa vipengele vya $P$ na $Q$ kunahusiana $y=2x$, basi tafuta uhusiano huo.
Ikiwa $A = \{1, 2, 3\}$, $B = \{0, 2, 4\}$ na vipengele vya $A$ na $B$ vina uhusiano $x = y - 1$, tafuta jozi za vipengele zinazohusiana.
Kama $f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3$, basi **hesabu** $f(-1)$.
Ikiwa $g(x)=x^{3}+ax^{2}-3x-6$ basi kwa thamani gani ya $a$ itakuwa $g(-2)=0$?
Solution:
Zikiwa $g(x)=x^{3}+ax^{2}-3x-6$

$\therefore$ $g(-2)=(- 2)^{3}+a(- 2)^{2}-3(-2)-6$

\qquad $ = -8+4a+6-6 = 4a-8$

Kama ilivyo katika swali $g(-2)=0$

$\therefore$ $4a-8=0$ au  $4a=8$ au  $a=2$

$\therefore$ ikiwa $a=2$   basi  $g(-2)=0.$

Question: Tafuta domain na range ya uhusiano $S=\{(2, 1), (2, 2), (3, 2), (4, 5)\}$.
Solution:
Ilipewa $S=\{(2, 1), (2, 2), (3, 2), (4, 5)\}$

Vipengele vya kwanza vya jozi zilizoagizwa za $S$ ni $2, 2, 3, 4$ na vipengele vya pili ni $1, 2, 2, 5$.

$\therefore,  Dom\   S = \{2, 3, 4\}$  na $Range \ S = \{1, 2, 5\}$

Question:
Hebu seti kipeo kiwe $U=\{x:x \in N$ na  $x \le 6\},$ 
$A=\{x:x$ ni namba mpevu na $x\le 5\}.$ Bainisha  $A^c$.

Hebu seti ya kiuniverse iwe $U=\{x:x \in N$ na  $x \le 6\},$
$A=\{x:x$ ni namba za **primes** na $x\le 5\},$
$B=\{x: x$ ni **namba ya kiwango** na $x\le 6\}.$
Thibitisha kwamba, $A \cup B=(A\setminus B) \cup (B \setminus A) \cup (A \cap B)$
Solution:
\qquad $A=\{x:x$ {\rm ni namba\ primu na}  $x\le 5\}=\{2,3,5\}$                                                                                                     Imepewa

$B=\{x: x$ {\rm ni namba\ primu na }  $x\le 6\}=\{2,4,6\}$ 

$\therefore \ A \cup B=\{2,3,5\} \cup \{2,4, 6\}=\{2,3,4,5,6\} \cdots\cdots (1)$

$A\setminus B= \{2,3,5\}-\{2,4,6\}=\{3,5\}$

$B \setminus A=\{2,4,6\}-\{2,3,5\}=\{4,6\}$

$A \cap B=\{2,3,5\}\cap \{2,4,6\}=\{2\}$

$\therefore \ (A \setminus B) \cup (B \setminus A) \cup (A \cap B)=\{3,5\}\cup \{4,6\}\cup \{2\}=\{2,3,4,5,6\} \cdots (2)$

Kwa hiyo, tukilinganisha $(1)$ na $(2)$ tunapata, 

$A \cup B=(A\setminus B) \cup (B \setminus A) \cup (A \cap B)$

Question:
Hebu kiwe kiwango cha kiuniverse $U=\{x:x \in N$ na  $x \le 6\},$ 
$A=\{x:x$ ni namba teule na $x\le 5\},$ 
$B=\{x: x$ ni namba ya pili na $x\le 6\}$ na 
$C=A \setminus B$. Thibitisha kwamba, $(A \cap C) \times B=(A \times B) \cap (C \times B)$

Hebu $A=\{4,5,6,7\}, \ B=\{0,1,2,3\}$.
Thibitisha kwamba, seti $A$ na $B$ hazina vipengele vya pamoja.
Solution:
Kupewa,
$A=\{4,5,6,7\}$ na $B=\{0,1,2,3\}$

$\therefore \ A \cap B=\{4,5,6,7\} \cap \{0,1,2,3\} =\varnothing$

Kwa kuwa $A \cap B=\varnothing$

  $A$ na $B$ ni viungo visivyoingiliana (disjoint).

Question: B = \{0, 1, 2, 3\}  Tambua $P(B)$ ili kuonyesha kwamba idadi ya vipengele vya $P(B)$ ni $2^n$, ambapo $n$ ni idadi ya vipengele vya $B$.
Solution:
$B=\{0,1,2,3\} $
 
 $\therefore\  P(B)=\{\{0\},\{1\}, \{2\},\{3\},\{0,1\},\{0,2\},\{0.3\},\{1,2\},\{1,3\},\{2,3\},$
 
  \hspace{1 cm} $ \{0,1,2\},\{0,1,3\},\{0,2,3\},\{1,2,3\},\{0,1,2,3\}, \varnothing \}$
 
 Hapa idadi ya vipengele vya $B$ ni $4$ na idadi ya vipengele vya keti yenye nguvu ni $2^4=16$
 
 $\therefore$ ikiwa $n$ ni idadi ya vipengele vya $B$ basi idadi ya vipengele vya keti yenye nguvu ni $2^n$.
 
 $\therefore$ idadi ya vipengele vya $P(B)$ inatimiza fomula ya $2^n$.
Exact Answer: idadi ya vipengele vya P(B) inatimiza fomula 2^n

Question: Je, mraba wa $(4x+5y)$ ni upi?
Ni mraba wa $(3a-7b)$ ni upi?
Tafuta mraba wa $996$ kwa kutumia kanuni ya mraba.
Ni mraba wa $a+b+c+d$ ni kiasi gani?
Rahisisha: $(5x+7y+3z)^{2}+2(7x-7y-3z)(5x+7y+3z)+(7x-7y-3z)^{2}$
Solution:
Hebu, $5x+7y+3z=a$ na $7x-7y-3z=b$

\therefore {Sehemu iliyotolewa} &=a^{2}+2\cdot b\cdot a+b^{2} = a^{2}+2ab+b^{2}\\
&=  (a+b)^{2}\\
&=  \{(5x+7y+3z)+(7x-7y-3z)\}^{2}  {[ Kwa kubadilisha thamani ya $a$ na $b$]}\\
&=  (5x+7y+3z+7x-7y-3z)^2\\
&=  (12x)^{2} =  144x^{2}

Question: Ikiwa $x-y=2$ na $xy=24$, ni thamani gani ya $x+y$ ?
Thibitisha kwamba, $(a+b)^{4}-(a-b)^{4}=8ab(a^{2}+b^{2})$
Ikiwa $a+b+c=15$ na $a^{2}+b^{2}+c^{2}=83$, ni thamani gani ya $ab+bc+ac$?
Ikiwa $a+b+c=2$ na $ab+bc+ac=1$, basi thamani ya $(a+b)^{2}+(b+c)^{2}+(c+a)^{2}$ ni ipi?
Eleza $(2x+3y)(4x-5y)$ kama tofauti ya viwanja viwili.
Solution:
Hebu, $2x+3y=a$ na $4x-5y=b$

$\therefore$ Kielelezo kilichopewa $ab=\left(\dfrac{a+b}{2}\right)^{2}-\left(\dfrac{a-b}{2}\right)^{2}$

\qquad$=\left(\dfrac{2x+3y+4x-5y}{2}\right)^{2}-\left(\dfrac{2x+3y-4x+5y}{2}\right)^{2}$   [Kwa kubadilisha maadili ya $a$ na $b$]

\qquad$=\left(\dfrac{6x-2y}{2}\right)^{2}-\left(\dfrac{8y-2x}{2}\right)^{2}$

\qquad$=\left\{\dfrac{2(3x-y)}{2}\right\}^{2}-\left\{\dfrac{2(4y-x)}{2}\right\}^{2}$

\qquad$=(3x-y)^{2}-(4y-x)^{2}$  

$\therefore (2x+3y)(4x-5y)=(3x-y)^{2}-(4y-x)^{2}$

Question: Kokotoa kipeo cha tatu cha $2x+3y$.
Kokotoa kipeo cha tatu cha $2x-y$.
Ikiwa $x=37$, basi thamani ya $8x^{3}+72x^{2}+216x+216$ ni ipi?
Kama $x-y=8$ na $xy=5$, basi thamani ya $x^{3}-y^{3}+8(x+y)^{2}$ ni ipi?
Kama $a=\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}$ , Thibitisha kwamba, $a^{3}+\dfrac{1}{a^{3}}=4\sqrt{3}$
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba, $a=\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}\ $

\qquad $\therefore \  \dfrac{1}{a} =\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}}$

\qquad $=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}}{(\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2})(\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2})}$ [kuzidisha namba na kigawanyo kwa $(\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2})$ ]

\qquad $=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}}{(\sqrt{3})^{2}-(\sqrt{2})^{2}} =\dfrac{\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}}{3-2}=\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}$

$\therefore \ a+\dfrac{1}{a}=(\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2})+(\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2})=\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}=2\sqrt{3}$

Sasa, $a^{3}+\dfrac{1}{a^{3}} =\left(a+\dfrac{1}{a}\right)^{3}-3\cdot a\cdot \dfrac{1}{a}\left(a+\dfrac{1}{a}\right)$

\qquad $=(2\sqrt{3})^{3}-3(2\sqrt{3}) \left[\because a+\dfrac{1}{a}=2\sqrt{3}\right]$

\qquad $=2^{3}\cdot (\sqrt{3})^{3}-3\times 2\sqrt{3} =8\cdot 3\sqrt{3}-6\sqrt{3}$

\qquad $ =24\sqrt{3}-6\sqrt{3}=18\sqrt{3}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Ikiwa $x+y=5,\  xy=6$ na $x > y$, tafuta thamani ya $2(x^2+y^2)$.
Solution:
Tunajua, $2(x^2+y^2) = 2\{(x+y)^2 - 2xy\}$

\qquad $= 2(5^2 - 2\cdot 6) = 2 \times 13 = 26$

\qquad $\therefore 2(x^2+y^2) = 26$

Question: Ikiwa $x+y=5,\  xy=6$ na $x > y$, tafuta thamani ya $x^3-y^3-3(x^2+y^2)$.
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba, $x+y=5$ na $xy=6,\  x > y$

$\therefore x - y = \pm \sqrt{(x+y)^2-4xy}$

\qquad $= \pm \sqrt{5^2 - 4\cdot 6} = \pm \sqrt{25-24} = \pm \sqrt{1} = \pm 1$

$x^3-y^3 - 3(x^2+y^2)$

\qquad $= (x-y)^3 + 3xy(x-y) - \dfrac{3}{2}\cdot 2(x^2+y^2)$

\qquad $= 1^3 + 3\cdot 6\cdot 1 - \dfrac{3}{2}\cdot  26$ au $ (-1)^3 + 3\cdot 6\cdot (-1) - \dfrac{3}{2}\cdot  26$

\qquad $= 1 + 18 - 39$ au $-1 - 18 - 39$

\qquad $= -20$ au -$58$

$\therefore x^3-y^3-3(x^2+y^2) = -20$ au $-58$

Question: Ikiwa $x+y=5,\  xy=6$ na $x > y$, tatua thamani ya $x^5+y^5$.
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba, $x+y=5$ na $xy=6,\  x > y$

$\therefore x - y = \pm \sqrt{(x+y)^2-4xy}$

\qquad $= \pm \sqrt{5^2 - 4\cdot 6} = \pm \sqrt{25-24} = \pm \sqrt{1} = \pm 1$                                                                                                                                                                                                           $x+y=5$ na $x-y=\pm 1$

Tukiongeza, $2x = 6,4$ \qquad $\therefore x = \dfrac{6}{2} = 3$ au $\dfrac{4}{2} = 2$

Tukitoa, $2y = 4,\ 6$  \qquad $\therefore y = \dfrac{4}{2} = 2$ au $\dfrac{6}{2} = 3$

$\therefore x^5+y^5 = 3^5 + 2^5 = 243 + 32 = 275$ [Matokeo yatakuwa sawa hata kama $x=2$ na $y=3$]

Question: Tatua kwa vigawo: $3a^{2}b+6ab^{2}+12a^{2}b^{2}$
Suluhisha kwa kutafuta vipengele: $2ab(x-y)+2bc(x-y)+3ca(x-y)$
Solution: $2ab(x-y)+2bc(x-y)+3ca(x-y)=(x-y)(2ab+2bc+3ca)$

Question: Tatua kwa visawazilishi: $4x^{2}+12x+9$
Tatua kwa mambo: $9x^{2}-30xy+25y^{2}$
Tatua kwa vitambuzi: $a^{2}-b^{2}+2b-1$
Tatua kwa visawazilishi: $a^{4}+64b^{4}$
Tatua kwa vipengele: $x^{2}+12x+35$
Tatua $x^{2}+x-20$ kwa kuupata vigawe vyake.
Suluhisha kwa vipengele: $3x^{2}-x-14$
Gawa kwa vipengele: $8x^{3}+36x^{2}y+54xy^{2}+27y^{3}$

Tatua kwa faktori:
$8a^{3}+27b^{3}$

Tatua kwa vipengele:
$a^{6}-64$
Tatua viiniliza: $x^{3}+6x^{2}y+11xy^{2}+6y^{3}$
Tatua katika vipengele: $x^{3}-x-6$
Solution:
Hapa, $f(x)=x^{3}-x-6$ ni polinomu. Vigawo vya mara kwa mara $-6$ ni $\pm 1, \pm 2, \pm 3, \pm 6$.

Sasa, kwa kuweka $x=1, -1$ tunaona kwamba thamani ya $f(x)$ si sifuri.

Lakini, kwa kuweka $x=2$ tunaona kwamba thamani ya $f(x)$ si sifuri.

Hivyo, $f(2)=2^{3}-2-6=8-2-6=0$.

Kwa hiyo, $x-2$ ni kigezo cha $f(x)$.

$\therefore f(x)= x^{3}-x-6$

\qquad $ =x^{3}-2x^{2}+2x^{2}-4x+3x-6$

\qquad $ =x^{2}(x-2)+2x(x-2)+3(x-2)$

\qquad $ =(x-2)(x^{2}+2x+3)$

Question: Tatua kwa viambajengo: $x^{3}-3xy^{2}+2y^{3}$ na $x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$.
Solution:
Hapa, tunachukulia $x$ kama kigezo (variable) na $y$ kama kimilisi (constant).

Tunachukulia maelezo yaliyotolewa kama mchanganuo mlingano wa $x$.

Acha, $f(x)=x^{3}-3xy^{2}+2y^{3}$

Kisha, $f(y)=y^{3}-3y\cdot y^{2}+2y^{3}=3y^{3}-3y^{3}=0$

$\therefore$ $(x-y)$ ni kipengele cha $f(x)$.

Sasa, $x^{3}-3xy^{2}+2y^{3}$

\qquad $ =x^{3}-x^{2}y+x^{2}y-xy^{2}-2xy^{2}+2y^{3}$

\qquad $        =x^{2}(x-y)+xy(x-y)-2y^{2}(x-y)$

\qquad $        =(x-y)(x^{2}+xy-2y^{2})$

Tena acha, $g(x)=x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$

$\therefore$ $g(y)=y^{2}+y^{2}-2y^{2} = 0$

$\therefore$ $(x-y)$ ni kipengele cha $g(x)$.

$\therefore g(x)= x^{2}+xy-2y^{2}$

\qquad $        =x^{2}-xy+2xy-2y^{2}$

\qquad $        =x(x-y)+2y(x-y)$

\qquad $        =(x-y)(x+2y)$

$\therefore$ $x^{3}-3xy^{2}+2y^{3}=(x-y)^{2}(x+2y)$

Question: Tatua kwa vitabia: $54x^{4}+27x^{3}a-16x-8a$.
Solution:
Hebu, $f(x)=54x^{4}+27x^{3}a-16x-8a$

Kisha,     $f\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)=54\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)^{4}+27a\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)^{3}-16\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)-8a$

\qquad        $=\dfrac{27}{8}a^{4}-\dfrac{27}{8}a^{4}+8a-8a=0$

$\therefore$ $x-\Bigg(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\Bigg)=x+\dfrac{a}{2}=\dfrac{1}{2}(2x+a)$ ni kipengele cha $f(x)$.

Hivyo,   $(2x+a)$ ni kipengele cha $f(x)$.

Sasa,    $54x^{4}+27x^{3}a-16x-8a$

\qquad $=27x^{3}(2x+a)-8(2x+a)$

\qquad $=(2x+a)(27x^{3}-8)$

\qquad $=(2x+a)\{(3x)^{3}-(2)^{3}\}$

\qquad $=(2x+a)(3x-2)(9x^{2}+6x+4)$

Question: $g(a)=a^3+a^2+10a-8$. Ikiwa $g(a)$ imegawanywa na $(a-2)$, basi bainisha marejesho.
Solution:
Kutokana na maelezo,
$g(a)=a^3+a^2+10a-8$

Kulingana na mchanganuo wa mabaki, ikiwa $g(a)$ itagawanywa na $(a-2)$ basi la mabaki litakuwa $g(2)$.

$\therefore \ g(2)=2^3+2^2+10\cdot 2-8=8+4+20-8=32-8=24$

$\therefore \ g(2)=24$

La mabaki lililokokotwa ni $24$.

Question: Hebu $f(a) = a^3 - 9 + (a+1)^3$. Tatua katika vipengele: $f(a)$
Solution:
$f(a)=a^3-9+(a+1)^3$

$f(a)$ ni polynomial, tukibadilisha $a=1$, basi matokeo ya polynomial yatakuwa sifuri.

Kwa hiyo $(a-1)$ ni sababu ya polynomial.

$\therefore \ f(a)=a^3-9+a^3+3a^2+3a+1=2a^3+3a^2+3a-8$

\qquad $=2a^3-2a^2+5a^2-5a+8a-8$

\qquad $=2a^2(a-1)+5a(a-1)+8(a-1)$

\qquad $=(a-1)(2a^2+5a+8)$

$\therefore \ a^3-9+(a+1)^3=(a-1)(2a^2+5a+8)$

Question: Kwa ajili ya shughuli ya Michezo ya Mwaka, wanachama wa chama walitenga bajeti ya TZS. $45000$ na kugawanya kwamba kila mwanachama atachangia kwa usawa. Lakini wanachama $5$ walikataa kuchangia. Kwa sababu hiyo, kiasi cha michango cha kila mwanachama kiliongezeka kwa TZS. $15$ kwa kila mwanachama. Walikuwa na wanachama wangapi katika chama hicho?
Solution:
Hebu idadi ya wanachama wa chama iwe $x$ na kiasi cha michango kwa kila mtu kiwe Tk. $q$.

Kisha jumla ya kiasi cha michango, Tk $A=qx=45,000$.

Kwa hakika idadi ya wanachama ilikuwa $(x-5)$ na kiasi cha michango kwa kila mtu kilikuwa Tk. $(q+15)$.

Kisha, jumla ya kiasi cha michango $(x-5)(q+15)$.

Kwa mujibu wa swali,

\qquad $qx=(x-5)(q+15)$ $\cdots\cdots (1)$

\qquad $qx=45000$ $\cdots\cdots (2)$

Kutoka katika equation $(1)$ tunapata,

\qquad $qx=(x-5)(q+15)$

\qquad au, $qx=qx-5q+15x-75$

\qquad au, $5q=15x-75=5(3x-15)$

$\therefore$ $q=3x-15$

Tukibadilisha thamani ya $q$ katika $(2)$,

\qquad $(3x-15)\times x=45000$

\qquad au, $3x^{2}-15x=45000$

\qquad au, $x^{2}-5x=15000$ [kugawanya pande zote kwa $3$]

\qquad au, $x^{2}-5x-15000=0$

\qquad au, $x^{2}-125x+120x-15000=0$

\qquad au, $x(x-125)+120(x-125)=0$

\qquad au, $(x-125)(x+120)=0$

Kwa hiyo, $(x-125)=0$ au $(x+120)=0$

\qquad au, $x=125$ au, $x=-120$

Kwa kuwa idadi ya wanachama haiwezi kuwa hasi, hivyo thamani ya $x$ kama $-120$ haikubaliki.

Kwa hiyo, idadi ya wanachama wa chama ni $125$.

Question: Mtu wa boti anaweza kusafiri kwa umbali wa $x$ km katika muda wa $t_1$ saa dhidi ya mkondo. Ili kufunika umbali huo pamoja na mkondo anachukua $t_2$ saa. Kasi ya boti na ya mkondo ni kiasi gani?
Solution:
Hebu kasi ya boti katika maji tulivu iwe $u$ km kwa saa na ile ya mkondo iwe $v$ km kwa saa.

Kisha, pamoja na mkondo, kasi halisi ya boti ni $(u+v)$ km kwa saa na kinyume na mkondo, kasi halisi ya boti ni $(u-v)$ km kwa saa.

Tunajua, $\text{kasi}=\dfrac{\text{umbali uliovukwa}}{\text{wakati}}$
\newpage

Kulingana na swali, $u+v=\dfrac{x}{t_2}$ $\cdots\cdots (1)$

        na $u-v=\dfrac{x}{t_1}$ $\cdots\cdots (2)$

Tukijumlisha milinganyo $(1)$ na $(2)$ tunapata,

    $2u=\dfrac{x}{t_2}+\dfrac{x}{t_1}=x\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_1}+\dfrac{1}{t_2}\Bigg)$ au,     $u=\dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_1}+\dfrac{1}{t_2}\Bigg)$

Tukitoa milinganyo $(2)$ kutoka milinganyo $(1)$ tunapata,

    $2v=\dfrac{x}{t_2}-\dfrac{x}{t_1}=x\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_2}-\dfrac{1}{t_1}\Bigg)$ au,      $v=\dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_2}-\dfrac{1}{t_1}\Bigg)$

Hivyo kasi ya mkondo ni $\dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_2}-\dfrac{1}{t_1}\Bigg)$ km kwa saa na kasi ya boti ni $\dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_1}+\dfrac{1}{t_2}\Bigg)$ km kwa saa.
Exact Answer: \dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_2}-\dfrac{1}{t_1}\Bigg) km kwa saa na kasi ya boti ni \dfrac{x}{2}\Bigg(\dfrac{1}{t_1}+\dfrac{1}{t_2}\Bigg)

Question: Bomba moja linaweza kujaza tangi tupu katika dakika $12$. Bomba lingine linatoa lita $14$ za maji kwa kila dakika. Ikiwa mabomba yote mawili yatafunguliwa pamoja na tangi tupu likajazwa katika dakika $96$, ni ujazo gani wa maji tangi hilo linaweza kuwa nao?
Solution:
Hebu $x$ lita za maji zipite kwa dakika kupitia bomba la kwanza na tangi hiyo inaweza kuweka kiwango cha maji cha $y$ lita.

Kulingana na swali, tangi hiyo inajazwa na bomba la kwanza kwa dakika $12$.

$\therefore y=12x$ $\cdots\cdots (1)$

Tena, tangi tupu inajazwa na mabomba yote mawili pamoja kwa dakika $96$.

$\therefore y=96x-96\times 14$ $\cdots\cdots (2)$

Kutoka kwenye equation $(1)$ tunapata, $x=\dfrac{y}{12}$

Kwa kuingiza thamani ya $x$ kwenye equation $(2)$ tunapata,

      $y=96\times\dfrac{y}{12}-96\times 14$

au, $y=8y-96\times 14$

au, $7y=96\times 14$

au, $y=\dfrac{96\times 14}{7}=192$

Hivyo, jumla ya lita $192$ za maji zinahifadhiwa kwenye tangi.

Question: Bei ya kitabu ni Tk. $24$. Bei hii ni $80\%$ ya bei halisi. Serikali inafadhili **tofauti ya** bei husika. Serikali inafadhili kiasi gani cha pesa kwa kila kitabu?
Solution:
Bei ya soko = $80\%$ ya bei halisi

Tunajua,    $p=br$

Hapa,    $p=24$ Tk na  $r=80\%=\dfrac{80}{100}$

        $\therefore 24=b\times\dfrac{80}{100}$

Au,    $b=\dfrac{24\times 100}{80}$

$\therefore b=30$ Tk.

Hivyo, bei halisi ya kitabu ni Tk. $30$.

$\therefore$ Kiasi cha pesa za ruzuku Tk. $=(30-24)$ au Tk. $=6$

Hivyo, pesa za ruzuku kwa kila kitabu ni Tk. $6$.

Question: Hasara ni $r\%$ wakati machungwa $n$ yanauzwa kwa taka moja. Ni machungwa mangapi yanapaswa kuuzwa kwa taka moja ili kupata faida ya $s\%$?
Solution:
Ikiwa bei ya gharama ni Tk $100$, bei ya mauzo kwa hasara ya $r\%$ ni Tk $(100-r)$.

Ikiwa bei ya mauzo ni Tk. $(100-r)$, bei ya gharama ni Tk. $100$

$\therefore$ Ikiwa bei ya mauzo ni Tk. $1$, bei ya gharama ni Tk. $\dfrac{100}{100-r}$.

Tena, ikiwa bei ya gharama ni Tk. $100$, bei ya mauzo kwa faida ya $s\%$ ni Tk. $(100+s)$.

$\therefore$ Ikiwa bei ya gharama ni Tk. $\dfrac{100}{100-r}$, bei ya mauzo kwa faida ya $s\%$ ni Tk. $\Bigg(\dfrac{100+s}{100}\times\dfrac{100}{100-r}\Bigg)$

        $=$ Tk. $\dfrac{100+s}{100-r}$

Kwa hiyo, kwa Tk. $\dfrac{100+s}{100-r}$ idadi ya machungwa yanayopaswa kuuzwa ni $n$.

$\therefore$ Kwa Tk. $1$ idadi ya machungwa yanayopaswa kuuzwa ni $n\times\Bigg(\dfrac{100-r}{100+s}\Bigg)$

Hivyo, machungwa $\dfrac{n(100-r)}{100+s}$ yanapaswa kuuzwa kwa kila taka.

Question: Faida ya Tk. $650$ katika miaka $6$ kwa kiwango cha faida cha Tk. $7$ asilimia kwa mwaka ni ipi?
Solution:
Tunajua,    $I=Pnr$

Hapa,    $P=650$ Tk,    $n=6$ miaka, riba kwa mwaka $s=7\%$

$\therefore  r=\dfrac{s}{100}=\dfrac{7}{100}$         

$\therefore  I=650\times 6\times\dfrac{7}{100}=273$         

Hivyo, riba ni Tk. $273$.

Question: Kokotoa kiinua-mikuu cha jumla na faida ya jumla ya Tk. $15000$ kwa miaka $3$ kwa faida ya asilimia $6$ kwa mwaka.
Solution:
Tunajua, $C=P(1+r)^{n}$ [ambapo $C$ ni faida kuu katika kesi ya faida ya kiwanja]

Imepewa, $P=15000$ Tk, $r=6\%=\dfrac{6}{100}$, $n=3$ miaka

$\therefore C=15000\Bigg(1+\dfrac{6}{100}\Bigg)^{3}=15000\Bigg(1+\dfrac{3}{50}\Bigg)^{3} =15000\Bigg(\dfrac{53}{50}\Bigg)^{3}$

       \qquad $=15000\times\dfrac{53}{50}\times\dfrac{53}{50}\times\dfrac{53}{50} =\dfrac{446631}{25} =17865.24$

$\therefore$ Faida kuu ni Tk $17865.24$

$\therefore$ Faida ya kiwanja ni Tk. $(17865.24-15000)$ Tk. $=2865.24$.

Question: Upotevu ni $x\%$ wakati ice cream $10$ zinauzwa kwa taka moja. Ni ice cream ngapi zinapaswa kuuzwa kwa taka moja ili kupata faida ya $z\%$?
Solution:
Kama bei ya gharama ni Tk. $100$, bei ya mauzo kwa hasara ya $x\%$ ni Tk. $100 - x$.

Ikiwa bei ya mauzo ni Tk. $100 - x$, basi bei ya gharama ni Tk. $100$.
$\therefore$ Ikiwa bei ya mauzo ni Tk. $1$, basi bei ya gharama ni Tk. $\dfrac{100}{100 - x}$.

Hivyo, bei ya gharama ya ice creams $10$ ni Tk. $\dfrac{100}{100 - x}$.
$\therefore$ Bei ya gharama ya ice cream $1$ ni Tk. $\dfrac{100}{(100 - x) \times 10}$.

Tena, ikiwa bei ya gharama ni Tk. $100$, basi bei ya mauzo kwa faida ya $z\%$ ni Tk. $100 + z$.

Ikiwa bei ya gharama ni Tk. $100$, basi bei ya mauzo ni Tk. $100 + z$.
Ikiwa bei ya gharama ni Tk. $1$, basi bei ya mauzo ni Tk. $\dfrac{100 + z}{100}$.

$\therefore$ Ikiwa bei ya gharama ni Tk. $\dfrac{100}{(100 - x) \times 10}$,
basi bei ya mauzo ni Tk. $\dfrac{100 + z}{100} \times \dfrac{100}{(100 - x) \times 10} = \dfrac{100 + z}{(100 - x) \times 10}$.

Bei ya mauzo ya ice cream $1$ ni Tk. $\dfrac{100 + z}{(100 - x) \times 10} = \dfrac{100 + z}{1000 - 10x}$.

Hivyo basi, ice creams $\dfrac{1000 - 10x}{100 + z}$ zinatakiwa kuuzwa kwa kila taka.

Question: Kokotoa thamani: $\dfrac{5^2}{5^3}$
Kokotoa maadili: $\left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right) ^5 \times \left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right) ^{-5}$
Solution: $\left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right) ^5 \times \left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right) ^{-5}= \left( \dfrac{2}{3} \right) ^{5-5}=\left( \dfrac{2}{3}\right )^0=1$

Question: Rahisisha: $\dfrac{5^4 \times 2^3 \times 2^4}{2^5 \times 5^3}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{5^4\times 8\times 16}{2^5\times 125}= \dfrac{5^4\times 2^3\times 2^4}{2^5\times 5^3}=\dfrac{5^4\times 2^{3+4}}{5^3\times 2^5}=\dfrac{5^4}{5^3}\times \dfrac{2^7}{2^5}$

$= 5^{4-3}\times 2^{7-5} =5^1\times2^2= 5\times 4=20$

Question: Rahisisha: $\dfrac{3\cdot2^n-4\cdot2^{n-2}}{2^n- 2^{n-1}}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{3\cdot2^n-4\cdot2^{n-2}}{2^n- 2^{n-1}} = \dfrac{3\cdot2^n-2^2\cdot2^{n-2}}{2^n- 2^n\cdot2^{-1}} = \dfrac{3\cdot2^n-2^{2+n-2}}{2^n- 2^n\cdot\dfrac{1}{2}}$ 

$=\dfrac{3\cdot2^n-2^{n}}{\left(1-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)\cdot2^n}= \dfrac{(3-1)\cdot2^n}{\dfrac{1}{2}\cdot2^n}=\dfrac{2\cdot2^n}{\dfrac{1}{2}\cdot2^n}=2\cdot 2=4$

Question: Thibitisha kwamba, $\left(a^p\right)^{q-r}\cdot(a^q)^{r-p}\cdot(a^r)^{p-q}= 1$
Solution:
$\left(a^p\right)^{q-r}\cdot(a^q)^{r-p}\cdot(a^r)^{p-q} = a^{p(q-r)}\cdot a^{q(r-p)}\cdot a^{r(p-q)} \ [\because \left(a^m\right)^n=a^{mn}]$

\qquad\qquad$=a^{pq-pr}\cdot a^{qr-pq}\cdot a^{pr-qr} =a^{pq-pr+qr-pq+pr-qr} =a^0=1$

Question: Rahisisha: $(12)^{-\frac{1}{2}}\times \sqrt[3]{54}$
Rahisisha: $(-3)^3\times \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^2$
Solution:
$(-3)^3\times \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^2$
$=(-3)(-3)(-3)\times \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)$
$=-27\times \dfrac{1}{4}$
$=-\dfrac{27}{4}$

Question: Tatua: $4^{x+1}=32$
Solution:
$4^{x+1}=32$ \qquad au, $(2^2)^{x+1}=32$ \qquad au, $2^{2x+2}=2^5$

$\therefore 2x+2=5$ \enspace [ikiwa $a^x=a^y$, basi $x=y$]

au, $2x= 5-2$ \enspace au, $2x=3$

$\therefore x=\dfrac{3}{2}$

Question: Kokotoa maadili: $\log_{10} 100$
Tathmini thamani: $\log_3 \dfrac{1}{9}$
Solution:
$\log_3\left(\dfrac{1}{9}\right)=\log_3\left(\dfrac{1}{3^2}\right)=\log_3 3^{-2}=-2\log_3 3$        $[\because \log_a M^r=r\log_a M]$

$ = -2\times 1=-2$ $[\because \log_a a=1]$

Question: Tathmini thamani: $\log_{\sqrt{3}} 81$
Solution:
$\log_{\sqrt{3}}81=\log_{\sqrt{3}}3^4=\log_{\sqrt{3}}\{(\sqrt{3})^2\}^4=\log_{\sqrt{3}}(\sqrt{3})^8$

$=8\log_{\sqrt{3}} \sqrt{3} =8\times 1 = 8$ $[\because \log_a a=1]$

Question: Logi ya $5\sqrt{5}$ kwa msingi wa $5$ ni ipi?
Solution:
Logi ya $5\sqrt{5}$ kwa msingi wa $5$

$=\log_5 5\sqrt{5}=\log_5 (5\times 5^{\frac{1}{2}})=\log_5 5^{\frac{3}{2}}$

$=\dfrac{3}{2}\log_5 5$ $[\because \log_a M^r=r\log_a M]$

$=\dfrac{3}{2}\times 1 = \dfrac{3}{2}$ $[\because \log_a a=1]$

Question: Ikiwa logaritmi ya $400$ ni $4$, basi ni nini msingi wa logaritmi hiyo?
Solution:
Hebu msingi uwe $a$

$\therefore$ Kwa mujibu wa swali, $\log_a 400=4$

$\therefore a^4=400$
au, $a^4=(20)^2=\{(2\sqrt{5})^2\}^2=(2\sqrt{5})^4$

$\therefore  a=2\sqrt{5}$ \qquad $[\because   a^x=b^x,\ a^x\neq 0,\ a=b]$

$\therefore$ Msingi ni $2\sqrt{5}$

Question: Tathmini thamani ya $x$: $\log_{10} x=-2$
Tatua thamani ya $x$: $\log_x 324=4$
Solution:
$\log_x 324=4$

au, $x^{4}=324=3\times 3\times 3\times 3\times 2\times 2 = 3^{4}\times 2^{2}$
 
au, $x^{4}=3^{4}\times (\sqrt{2})^{4}$

au, $x^{4}=(3\sqrt{2})^{4}$

 $\therefore x=3\sqrt{2}$

Question: Thibitisha kwamba, $3\log_{10} 2+\log_{10} 5=\log_{10} 40$
Solution:
Upande wa kushoto $= 3\log_{10} 2+\log_{10} 5$

  \qquad   $=\log_{10} 2^{3}+\log_{10} 5 \qquad [\because \log_a M^{r}=r\log_a M]$

  \qquad   $=\log_{10} 8+\log_{10} 5$

  \qquad   $=\log_{10} (8\times 5) \qquad [\because \log_a (MN)=\log_a M+\log_a N]$

  \qquad   $=\log_{10} 40 =$ upande wa kulia (imethibitishwa)

Question: Rahisisha: $\dfrac {\log_{10} \sqrt{27}+\log_{10} 8-\log_{10} \sqrt{1000}}{\log_{10} 1.2}$
Tafuta tabia za logi za nambari zifuatazo: $5570$
Solution:
$5570=5.570\times 1000=5.570\times 10^3$

$\therefore$ Kiashiria cha logi ya namba ni $3$

Idadi ya tarakimu katika namba $5570$ ni $4$.

$\therefore$ Kiashiria cha logi ya namba ni $=4-1=3$

Question: Tathmini sifa za logaritiki ya nambari zifuatazo: $45.70$
Solution:
$45.70=4.570\times 10^1$

$\therefore$ Tabia ya logi ya namba ni $1$

Kuna namba $2$ katika sehemu ya jumla (yaani, upande wa kushoto wa nukta ya desimali) ya namba.

$\therefore$ Tabia ya logi ya namba $=2-1=1$

Question: Tathmini sifa za logi ya nambari zifuatazo: $0.4305$
Solution:
$0.4305=4.305\times 10^{-1}$
        $\therefore$ Sifa ya logaritmi ya namba ni $-1$ 

 

        $\therefore$ Sifa ya logaritmi ya namba ni $=0-1=-1=\bar{1}$ 

Hakuna sifuri kati ya nukta ya desimali na tarakimu yake ya kwanza muhimu ya namba $0.4305$, yaani kuna sifuri $0$. 

$\therefore$ Sifa ya logaritmi ya namba ni $=-(0+1)=-1=\bar{1}$  

$\therefore$  Sifa ya logaritmi ya namba $0.4305$ ni $\bar{1}$

Question: Tambua sifa za logi ya nambari ifuatayo: $0.000435$
Solution:
$0.000435=4.35\times 10^{-4}$

$\therefore$ Sifa ya logaritimu ya namba ni $-4$ au $\bar{4}$

$\therefore$ Sifa ya logaritimu ya namba ni $=-(3+1)=-4=\bar{4}$

$\therefore$ Sifa ya logaritimu ya namba $0.000435$ ni $\bar{4}$

Question: Tatua: $\dfrac{5x}{7}-\dfrac{4}{5}= \dfrac{x}{5}-\dfrac{2}{7}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{5x}{7}-\dfrac{4}{5}= \dfrac{x}{5}-\dfrac{2}{7}$ \enspace au, $\dfrac{5x}{7}-\dfrac{x}{5}=\dfrac{4}{5}-\dfrac{2}{7}$   [kwa kuhamisha]

\enspace au, $\dfrac{25x-7x}{35}=\dfrac{28-10}{35}$ \enspace au, $\dfrac{18x}{35}= \dfrac{18}{35}$ 

\enspace au, $18x=18$  \enspace        au, $x=1$  

$\therefore$ Suluhisho ni $x=1$

Question: Tatua: $(y-1)(y+2)= (y+4)(y-2)$
Solution:
$(y-1)(y+2)= (y+4)(y-2)$

\qquad        au, $y^2-y+2y-2=y^2+4y-2y-8$  

\qquad        au, $y-2=2y-8$ 

\qquad        au, $y-2y=-8+2$  [kwa kuhamisha]

\qquad        au, $-y=-6$ 

\qquad        au, $y=6$   

$\therefore$ Jibu ni $y=6$

Question: Tatua na uandike seti ya suluhisho: $\dfrac{6x+1}{15}-\dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}=\dfrac{2x-1}{5}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{6x+1}{15}-\dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}=\dfrac{2x-1}{5}$

\qquad        au, $\dfrac{6x+1}{15}-\dfrac{2x-1}{5}=\dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}$ \qquad     [kwa kuhamisha]

\qquad        au, $\dfrac{6x+1-3(2x-1)}{15}= \dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}$ 

\qquad   au, $\dfrac{6x+1-6x+3}{15}= \dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}$ 

\qquad   au, $\dfrac{4}{15}= \dfrac{2x-4}{7x-1}$ 

\qquad        au, $15(2x-4)=4(7x-1)$        [kwa kuzidisha matawi]

\qquad        au, $30x-60=28x-4$

\qquad        au, $30x-28x=60-4$ \qquad         [kwa kuhamisha]

\qquad        au, $2x=56$   \qquad au, $x=28$ 

$\therefore$ Suluhisho ni $x=28$  

na seti ya suluhisho ni $S=\{28\}$

Question: Tatua: $\dfrac{1}{x-3}+\dfrac{1}{x-4}=\dfrac{1}{x-2}+\dfrac{1}{x-5}$
Solution:
$\dfrac{1}{x-3}+\dfrac{1}{x-4}=\dfrac{1}{x-2}+\dfrac{1}{x-5}$

\qquad        au, $\dfrac{x-4+x-3}{(x-3)(x-4)}=\dfrac{x-5+x-2}{(x-2)(x-5)}$

\qquad   au, $\dfrac{2x-7}{x^2-7x+12}=\dfrac{2x-7}{x^2-7x+10}$

Msemo wa pande zote mbili za sehemu una thamani sawa. Tena, viviga vya pande zote mbili ni sawa, lakini vinalinganishi haviko sawa. Katika hali hii, ikiwa tu thamani ya viviga ni sifuri, pande zote mbili zitakuwa sawa.

$\therefore 2x-7=0$ \qquad au, $2x=7$ \qquad au, $x=\dfrac{7}{2}$

$\therefore$  Suluhisho ni $x=\dfrac{7}{2}$

Question:
Nambari ya vitengo vya mahali pa nambari inayojumuisha tarakimu mbili ni $2$
zaidi ya tarakimu ya mahali pa kumi. Ikiwa maeneo ya tarakimu yamebadilishwa, nambari 
 itakayoundwa itakuwa ndogo kwa $6$ kuliko mara mbili ya nambari iliyotolewa. Tafuta nambari.
Solution:
Hebu tarakimu ya mahali pa makumi iwe $x$. Kisha tarakimu ya mahali pa umoja itakuwa $x+2$.

$\therefore$ Namba ni $10x+(x+2)$ au, $11x+2$

Sasa, kama mahali pa tarakimu yamebadilishwa, namba iliyobadilishwa itakuwa $10(x+2)+x$ au, $11x+20$

Kulingana na swali, $11x+20= 2(11x+2)-6$

au, $11x+20= 22x+4-6$

au, $22x-11x= 20+6-4$ [kwa uhamishaji]

au, $11x=22$

au, $x=2$

$\therefore$ Namba ni $11x+2= 11\times 2+2=24$

$\therefore$ Namba iliyotolewa ni $24$

Question: Katika darasa, ikiwa wanafunzi $4$ wanakaa kila benchi, benchi $3$ hubaki hazina watu. Lakini ikiwa wanafunzi $3$ wanakaa kila benchi, wanafunzi $6$ hubaki wamesimama. Idadi ya wanafunzi katika darasa hilo ni ipi?
Solution:
Hebu idadi ya wanafunzi darasani iwe $x$

Kwa kuwa, ikiwa wanafunzi $4$ wameketi kwenye benchi, benchi $3$ zinabaki hazina kitu, idadi ya
benchi za darasa hilo $=\dfrac{x}{4}+3$

Tena, kwa kuwa, ikiwa wanafunzi $3$ wameketi kila benchi, wanafunzi $6$ watabaki
wamesimama, idadi ya benchi za darasa hilo $=\dfrac{x-6}{3}$

Kwa kuwa idadi ya benchi ni thabiti,

kwa hiyo $\dfrac{x}{4}+3=\dfrac{x-6}{3}$ \enspace au, $\dfrac{x+12}{4}=\dfrac{x-6}{3}$

au, $4x-24=3x+36$ \enspace au, $4x-3x=36+24$

au, $x=60$

$\therefore$ idadi ya wanafunzi wa darasa ni $60$

Question: Bw. Kabir, kutoka kwa Tk $56000$ zake, aliwekeza sehemu ya fedha kwa kiwango cha faida cha $12\%$ kwa mwaka na fedha zilizobaki kwa kiwango cha faida cha $10\%$ kwa mwaka. Baada ya mwaka mmoja alipata faida ya jumla ya Tk. $6400$. Ni kiasi gani cha fedha alichowekeza kwa kiwango cha faida cha $12\%$?
Solution:
Acha Bw. Kabir aekeze Tk. $x$ kwa kiwango cha faida $12\%$.

$\therefore$ aliwekeza Tk. $(56000-x)$ kwa kiwango cha faida $10\%$.

Sasa, faida ya Tk. $x$ kwa mwaka $1$ ni Tk. $x\times \dfrac{12}{100}$ au Tk. $\dfrac{12x}{100}$.

Tena, faida ya Tk. $(56000 - x)$ kwa mwaka $1$ ni Tk. $(56000-x)\times \dfrac{10}{100}$ au Tk. $\dfrac{10(56000-x)}{100}$.

Kwa mujibu wa swali, $\dfrac{12x}{100}+\dfrac{10(56000-x)}{100}=6400$

au, $12x+560000-10x=640000$

au, $2x=640000-560000$

au, $2x=80000$

au, $x=40000$

$\therefore$ Bw. Kabir aliwekeza Tk. $40000$ kwa kiwango cha faida $12\%$.
Exact Answer: Bw. Kabir aliwekeza Tk. 40000 kwa kiwango cha faida 12\%

Question: Tatua: $(x+2)(x-3)=0$
Solution:
$(x+2)(x-3)=0$

$\therefore x+2=0$ au  $x-3=0$

Ikiwa $x+2=0$, $x=-2$ 

Tena, ikiwa $x-3=0$, $x=3$ 

$\therefore$ suluhisho ni $x=-2$  au  $x=3$

Question: Tathmini seti ya masuluhisho: $y^{2}=\sqrt{3}y$
Solution:
$y^{2}=\sqrt{3}y$

au, $y^{2}-\sqrt{3}y=0$ \qquad [Kwa kuhamisha, upande wa kulia umefanywa sifuri]

au, $y(y-\sqrt{3})=0$

$\therefore y=0$ au $y-\sqrt{3}=0$

Tena, ikiwa $y-\sqrt{3}=0$, basi $y=\sqrt{3}$

$\therefore$ Seti ya masuluhisho ni $\{0,\sqrt{3}\}$

Question: Tatua na uandike seti ya suluhisho: $x-4=\dfrac{x-4}{x}$
Solution:
$x-4=\dfrac{x-4}{x}$   

        au, $x(x-4)=x-4$ \qquad        [kwa kuzidisha msalaba]

        au, $x(x-4)-(x-4)=0$ \qquad [kwa kuhamisha]

        au, $(x-4)(x-1)=0$ 

$\therefore x-4=0$   au   $x-1=0$

Kama  $x-4=0$,  $x=4$

Tena, kama  $x-1=0$, $x=1$ 

$\therefore $  seti ya majibu ni  $\{1,4\}$

Question: Tatua: $\left(\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}\right)^{2}-5\left(\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}\right)+6=0$
Solution:
$\left(\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}\right)^{2}-5\left(\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}\right)+6=0\ldots (1)$

Weka, $\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}=y$

$\therefore$ Kutoka $(1)$ tunapata, $y^{2}-5y+6=0$

au, $y^{2}-2y-3y+6=0$

au, $y(y-2)-3(y-2)=0$

au, $(y-2)(y-3)=0$

$\therefore$ wakati $y-2=0$, $y=2$

au ikiwa $y-3=0$, $y=3$

Sasa, ikiwa $y=2$,

$\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}=\dfrac{2}{1}$ \qquad [kuingiza thamani ya $y$]

au, $x+a=2(x-a)$ \qquad [kwa kuzidisha msalaba]

au, $x+a=2x-2a$

au, $2x-x=a+2a$

au, $x=3a$

Tena, wakati $y=3$,

$\dfrac{x+a}{x-a}=\dfrac{3}{1}$

au, $x+a=3(x-a)$ \qquad [kwa kuzidisha msalaba]

au, $x+a=3x-3a$

au, $3x-x=a+3a$

au, $x=2a$

$\therefore$ suluhisho ni $x=2a$ au, $x=3a$

Question: Kichwa cha sehemu ya kawaida ni $4$ zaidi ya kihesabu. Ikiwa sehemu hiyo itapigwa mraba, kichwa chake kitakuwa $40$ zaidi ya kihesabu. Pata sehemu hiyo.
Solution:
Hebu kipeo cha **kihesabu** cha sehemu ya nambari kiwe $x$ na kipeo cha **kihesabu cha mlinganyo** kiwe $x+4$

Hivyo sehemu ya nambari ni $\dfrac{x}{x+4}$

Mraba wa sehemu ya nambari =$\left(\dfrac{x}{x+4}\right)^{2}=\dfrac{x^{2}}{(x+4)^{2}}=\dfrac{x^{2}}{x^{2}+8x+16}$

Hapa, kipeo cha **kihesabu cha nambari** = $x^{2}$ na kipeo cha **kihesabu cha mlinganyo** = $x^{2}+8x+16$

Kutoka kwenye swali, $x^{2}+8x+16=x^{2}+40$

au, $8x+16=40$

au, $8x=40-16$

au, $8x=24$

au, $x=3$

$\therefore x+4=3+4=7$

$\therefore \dfrac{x}{x+4}=\dfrac{3}{7}$

$\therefore$ sehemu ya nambari ni $\dfrac{3}{7}$

Question: Jumba la bustani la mstatili lenye urefu wa $50$ mita na upana wa $40$ mita lina njia yenye upana sawa kuzunguka ndani ya bustani. Ikiwa eneo la bustani isipokuwa njia ni $1200$ mita za mraba, upana wa njia ni mita ngapi?
Solution:
Hebu njia iwe na upana wa x mita.

Bila njia, urefu wa bustani ni $(50-2x)$ mita na upana ni $(40-2x)$ mita.

$\therefore$ Eneo la bustani bila njia = $(50-2x)\times (40-2x)$ mita za mraba.

Kulingana na swali, $(50-2x)\times (40-2x)=1200$.

Au, $2000-80x-100x+4x^2=1200$.

Au, $4x^2-180x+800=0$.

Au, $x^2-45x+200=0$ [kugawanya kwa $4$].

Au, $x^2-5x-40x+200=0$.

Au, $x(x-5)-40(x-5)=0$.

Au, $(x-5)(x-40)=0$.

$\therefore x-5=0$ au $x-40=0$.

Ikiwa $x-5=0$, basi $x=5$.

Ikiwa $x-40=0$, basi $x=40$.

Lakini upana wa njia utakuwa chini ya $40$ mita kutoka upana wa bustani.

$\therefore x\neq 40;\ \therefore x = 5$.

$\therefore$ Njia ina upana wa $5$ mita.

Question:
Shahik alinunua kalamu kwa thamani ya Tk. $240$. Ikiwa angepata kalamu moja zaidi kwa
fedha hizo, gharama ya wastani ya kila kalamu ingepungua kwa Tk. $1$. Alinunua
kalamu ngapi?
Solution:
Hebu, shahik alinunua $x$ kalamu jumla kwa Tk. $240$. Kisha kila kalamu gharama yake ni Tk $\dfrac{240}{x}$.
 
Kama angepata $(x+1)$ kalamu kwa Tk. $240$, basi gharama ya kila kalamu ingekuwa Tk. $\dfrac{240}{x+1}$.

Kwa mujibu wa swali, $\dfrac{240}{x+1}=\dfrac{240}{x}-1$  

au, $\dfrac{240}{x+1}=\dfrac{240-x}{x}$  

au, $240x=(x+1)(240-x)$\qquad [kwa kuzidisha pande zote]

au, $240x=240x+240-x^2-x$ 

au, $x^2+x-240=0$          [kwa kuhamisha]

au, $x^2+16x-15x-240=0$  

au, $x(x+16)-15(x+16)=0$  

au, $(x+16)(x-15)=0$  

$\therefore x+16=0$,  au $x-15=0$ 

\quad ikiwa $x+16=0$, $x=-16$ 

\quad ikiwa $x-15=0$, $x=15$ 

Lakini idadi ya kalamu $x$, haiwezi kuwa hasi.

$\therefore x\neq -16$; $\ \therefore x=15$     

$\therefore$ Shahik alinunua kalamu $15$.

Question:
Katika mtihani wa darasa la IX la shule, jumla ya alama za wanafunzi $x$ waliopata katika hisabati ni $1950$. Ikiwa katika mtihani huo huo, alama za mwanafunzi mpya katika hisabati ni $34$ na zikiongezwa kwenye jumla ya alama za awali, wastani wa alama unapungua kwa $1$.

\item  Andika wastani wa alama zilizopatikana za wanafunzi wote ikiwa ni pamoja na mwanafunzi mpya, na wastani wa alama za wanafunzi $x$ pekee, zote katika vipengele vya $x$.
Solution:
Wastani wa alama zilizopatikana na wanafunzi $x$ = $\dfrac{1950}{x}$

Wastani wa alama zilizopatikana na wanafunzi $(x+1)$ ikiwemo mwanafunzi mpya $=\dfrac{1950+34}{x+1}=\dfrac{1984}{x+1}$

Question:
Katika mtihani wa darasa la IX la shule, jumla ya alama za wanafunzi $x$ walizopata katika hisabati ni $1950$. Iwapo katika mtihani huo huo, alama za mwanafunzi mpya katika hisabati ni $34$ na zinaongezwa kwenye jumla ya alama za awali, wastani wa alama unakuwa unapungua kwa $1$.

\item Kwa kuunda mlinganyo kutoka kwa masharti yaliyotolewa, onyesha kwamba, $x^2+35x-1950=0$
Solution:
Kulingana na swali, $\dfrac{1950}{x}=\dfrac{1984}{x+1}+1$

\quad        au, $\dfrac{1950}{x}-\dfrac{1984}{x+1}=1$ \quad    [kwa kuhamisha]

\quad        au, $\dfrac{1950(x+1)-1984x}{x(x+1)}=1$

\quad        au, $1950x+1950-1984x = x(x+1)$ \quad   [kwa kuzidisha pande zote]

\quad        au, $1950-34x = x^2+x$

\quad        $\therefore x^2+35x-1950=0$ \quad   [imeonyeshwa]

Question:
Katika mtihani wa darasa la IX la shule, jumla ya alama za wanafunzi $x$ waliopata katika hisabati ni $1950$. Ikiwa katika mtihani ule ule, alama za mwanafunzi mpya katika hisabati ni $34$ na zikiongezwa kwenye jumla ya alama za awali, wastani wa alama unapungua kwa $1$.

\item Kwa kutafuta thamani ya $x$, tafuta wastani wa alama katika **hali** mbili.
Solution:
$x^2+35x-1950=0$

\quad        au, $x^2+65x-30x-1950=0$

\quad        au, $x(x+65)-30(x+65)=0$

\quad        au, $(x+65)(x-30)=0$

$\therefore x+65=0$ au $x-30=0$

 Kama $x+65=0$, $x=-65$

Tena, kama $x-30=0$, $x=30$

Kwa kuwa idadi ya wanafunzi, yaani $x$ haiwezi kuwa hasi,

Hivyo, $x\neq -65$

$\therefore x=30$

$\therefore$ katika kisa cha kwanza, wastani = $\dfrac{1950}{30}=65$ na katika kisa cha pili, wastani = $\dfrac{1984}{31}=64$
Exact Answer: katika kisa cha kwanza, wastani = \dfrac{1950}{30}=65 na katika kisa cha pili, wastani = \dfrac{1984}{31}=64

Question: Ikiwa $\text{tan} A=\dfrac{4}{3}$, tafuta uwiano mwingine wa trigonomitria wa pembe $A$.
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba, $\text{tan} A=\dfrac{4}{3}$।

Hivyo, upande wa kinyume wa pembe $A$= $4$, upande wa jirani= $3$

hypotenuse =$\sqrt{4^{2}+3^{2}}=\sqrt{25}=5$

Kwa hiyo, $\text{sin} A =\dfrac{4}{5}$, $\text{cos} A =\dfrac{3}{5}$, $\text{cot} A =\dfrac{3}{4}$

 $\text{cosec} A =\dfrac{5}{4}$, $\text{sec} A =\dfrac{5}{3}$

Question: $\angle B$ ni pembe ya kulia ya pembetatu yenye pembe ya kulia $ABC$. Ikiwa $\text{tan} A=1$ basi thibitisha ukweli wa $2\text{sin} A\text{cos} A=1$.
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba, $\text{tan} A=1$

Hivyo, upande unaokabili pembe=upande wa jirani=$a$

hypotenuse = $\sqrt{a^{2}+a^{2}}=\sqrt{2}a$

Kwa hiyo, $\text{sin} A= \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{2}a} =\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$, $\text{cos} A= \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{2}a} =\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$

Sasa, upande wa kushoto, $=2\text{sin} A\text{cos} A=2\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}=2\cdot\dfrac{1}{2}=1=$ upande wa kulia.

 $\therefore$ $2\text{sin} A\text{cos} A=1$ ni kweli.

Question: Thibitisha kwamba, $\text{tan}\theta+\text{cot}\theta=\text{sec}\theta\cdot\text{cosec}\theta$
Solution:
Upande wa kushoto $= \text{tan}\theta+\text{cot}\theta$

                $=\dfrac{\text{sin}\theta}{\text{cos}\theta}+\dfrac{\text{cos}\theta}{\text{sin}\theta}$

                $= \dfrac{\text{sin}^{2}\theta+\text{cos}^{2}\theta}{\text{sin}\theta\cdot\text{cos}\theta}$

                $= \dfrac{1}{\text{sin}\theta\cdot \text{cos}\theta}$  [$\because \text{sin}^{2}\theta+\text{cos}^{2}\theta=1$]

                 $= \dfrac{1}{\text{sin}\theta}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\text{cos}\theta}$

                $= \text{cosec}\theta\cdot\text{sec}\theta$

                $= \text{sec}\theta\cdot\text{cosec}\theta =$ Upande wa kulia (Imethibishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba, $\text{sec}^{2}\theta+\text{cosec}^{2}\theta=\text{sec}^{2}\theta\cdot\text{cosec}^{2}\theta$
Solution:
L.H.S. $=\text{sec}^{2}\theta +\text{cosec}^{2}\theta$

		$=  \dfrac{1}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta} +\dfrac{1}{\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

		$=  \dfrac{\text{sin}^{2}\theta +\text{cos}^{2}\theta}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta\cdot\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

       		$=  \dfrac{1}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta\cdot \text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

       		$=  \dfrac{1}{\text{cos}^{2}\theta}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\text{sin}^{2}\theta}$

       		$=  \text{sec}^{2}\theta\cdot\text{cosec}^{2}\theta$

		$=$ R.H.S (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba, $\dfrac{1}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{1+\text{cosec}^{2}\theta}=1$
Solution:
L.H.S. $= \dfrac{1}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{1+\text{cosec}^{2}\theta}$

		$= \dfrac{1}{1+\text{sin}^{2}\theta}+\dfrac{1}{1+\dfrac{1}{\text{sin}^{2}\theta}}$
