Kupewa, pembe kwa digrii ni $D^\circ$ na kwa mfumo wa duara ni $R^c$.
Kulingana na uhusiano kati ya digrii na radian, $1^\circ = \frac{\pi^c}{180}$
$\therefore D^\circ = \left(\frac{D\pi}{180}\right)^c$
Hivyo, $D \times \frac{\pi}{180} = R$
$\therefore \frac{D}{180} = \frac{R}{\pi}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Radi ya gurudumu ni mita 2 na sentimita 3; Tafuta thamani ya takriban ya mzingo wake hadi tarakimu nne za desimali.
Solution:
Kutokana na,
mwandamo wa gurudumu, $r = 2$ m. 3 cm.
$= 2.03$ m.
Tunajua, mzingo wa gurudumu $= 2\pi r$.
$= 2 \times 3.1416 \times 2.03$ m.
$= 12.7549$ m. (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Mzingo unaohitajika wa gurudumu
$= 12.7549$ m. (takriban.)
Jibu. $12.7549$ m. (takriban.)

Question: Mviringo wa gurudumu la gari una kipenyo cha mita $0.84$ na gurudumu hufanya mapinduzi 6 kwa sekunde. Tafuta kasi ya gari.
Solution:
Kupewa, kipenyo cha gurudumu $= 0.84$ m.
$\therefore$ Nusu kipenyo cha gurudumu, $r = \frac{0.84}{2}$ m. $= 0.42$ m.
$\therefore$ Mzingo wa gurudumu $= 2\pi r$
$= 2 \times 3.1416 \times 0.42$ m.
$= 2.6389$ m.
$\therefore$ Gurudumu linapita umbali wa $2.6389$ m. katika mzunguko 1.
Tena, linazunguka mara 6 kwa sekunde 1.
Kwa hiyo, umbali unaopita kwa sekunde 1 ni $2.6389 \times 6$ m.
$\therefore$ Umbali unaopita kwa saa 1
$= 2.6389 \times 6 \times 60 \times 60$ m.
$= 57000.24$ m.
$= \frac{57000.24}{1000}$ km.
$= 57.00024$ km.
$\therefore$ Kasi ya gari ni 57 km/saa. (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Kasi ni 57 km/saa. (takriban.)
Jibu. 57 km/saa (takriban.)

Question: Vipimo vya pembe za pembetatu viko katika uwiano wa $2:5:3$; vipimo vya duara vya pembe ndogo kabisa na kubwa kabisa ni vipi?
Solution:
Kutokana na tatizo, uwiano wa pembe za pembetatu $= 2:5:3$
Tuchilia pembe ziwe $2x^c$, $5x^c$ na $3x^c$ mtawalia.
Tunajua, jumla ya pembe tatu za pembetatu ni sawa na $\pi^c$
$\therefore 2x + 5x + 3x = \pi$
au, $10x = \pi$
$\therefore x = \frac{\pi}{10}$
$\therefore$ Pembe tatu hizo ni $2 \times \frac{\pi^c}{10}$, $5 \times \frac{\pi^c}{10}$ na $3 \times \frac{\pi^c}{10}$
yaani $\frac{\pi^c}{5}$, $\frac{\pi^c}{2}$, $\frac{3\pi^c}{10}$
$\therefore$ Pembe kubwa zaidi $= \frac{\pi^c}{2}$
na pembe ndogo zaidi $= \frac{\pi^c}{5}$
Jibu: Katika mfumo duara, pembe ndogo zaidi ni $\frac{\pi^c}{5}$ na pembe kubwa zaidi ni $\frac{\pi^c}{2}$

Question: Pembe za pembetatu huendelea kwa mpangilio wa hesabu na pembe kubwa zaidi ni mara mbili ya pembe ndogo zaidi. Je, ni vipimo vya pembe hizo kwa radian?
Solution:
Hebu, pembe ndogo kabisa $= A^c$
$\therefore$ Pembe kubwa kabisa $= 2A^c$
Kwa kuwa pembe ziko katika mpangilio wa hesabu,
$\therefore$ Pembe nyingine $= \frac{A^c + 2A^c}{2} = \frac{3}{2}A^c$
Tunajua, jumla ya pembe tatu za pembetatu ni sawa na $\pi^c$
$\therefore A + \frac{3A}{2} + 2A = \pi$
au, $\frac{9A}{2} = \pi$
$\therefore A = \frac{2\pi}{9}$
Kwa hiyo, $\frac{3A}{2} = \frac{3}{2} \times \frac{2\pi}{9} = \frac{\pi}{3}$
na $2A = 2 \times \frac{2\pi}{9} = \frac{4\pi}{9}$
Jibu. Pembe tatu ni $\frac{2\pi^c}{9}$, $\frac{\pi^c}{3}$, $\frac{4\pi^c}{9}$ mtiririko huo.

Question: Hebu tukio la uti ambao huunganisha Dhaka na Chattogram litoe pembe ya $5^\circ$ kwenye kituo cha dunia. Tukizingatia dunia kuwa tufe la arae ya $6440$ k.m. kokotoa umbali wa Chattogram kutoka Dhaka?
Solution:
Kupewa, radius, $r = 6440$ km.
Pembe inayotolewa katikati,
$\theta = 5^\circ$
$= 5 \times \frac{\pi}{180}$ radian
$= \frac{\pi}{36}$ radian
$\therefore$ Umbali kutoka Chattogram hadi Dhaka
$s = r\theta$.
$= 6440 \times \frac{\pi}{36}$ km.
$= \frac{6440 \times 3.1416}{36}$ km.
$= \frac{20231.904}{36}$ km.
$= 561.9973$ km.
$= 562$ km. (takriban)
Jibu. 562 km. (takriban)

Question: Njia panda inayounganisha Teknaf na Tetulia hutiza pembe ya $10^\circ6'3''$ kwenye kituo cha dunia. Kwa kudhani dunia ni tufe lenye radius ya kilometa 6440, tafuta umbali wa Tetulia na Teknaf.
Solution:
Kikwazo, radiusi, $r = 6440$ km.
Pembe inayotegwa kwenye kituo, $\theta = 10^\circ6'3''$
$= 10^\circ \left(6\frac{3}{60}\right)' = 10^\circ \left(6\frac{1}{20}\right)' \quad [\because 1' = 60'']$
$= 10^\circ \left(\frac{121}{20}\right)' = \left(10 + \frac{121}{20 \times 60}\right)^\circ$
$= \left(10 + \frac{121}{1200}\right)^\circ = \left(\frac{12121}{1200}\right)^\circ \quad [\because 1^\circ = 60']$
$= \frac{12121}{1200} \times \frac{\pi}{180}$ radian $\left[\because 1^\circ = \frac{\pi^c}{180}\right]$
$= \frac{12121\pi}{216000}$ radian
$\therefore$ Umbali kati ya Tetulia na Teknaf,
$s = r\theta$.
$= 6440 \times \frac{12121\pi}{216000}$ km.
$= \frac{78059240\pi}{216000}$ km.
$= \frac{78059240 \times 3.1416}{216000}$ km.
$= 1135.3$ km. (takriban.)
Jibu. 1135.3 km. (takriban.)

Question: Shahed anapitia kipande cha njia ya duara kwa sekunde 11 akiendesha baiskeli. Kipenyo cha njia ya duara ni mita 201 na pembe inayotegwa na kipande hicho kwenye kituo ni $30^\circ$; tafuta kasi ya Shahed.
Solution:
Kutokana na kipenyo cha mduara,
$D = 201$ m.
$\therefore$ Radiasi, $r = \frac{201}{2}$ m. $[\because D = 2r]$
$= 100.5$ m.
Pembe inayofungwa katikati, $\theta = 30^\circ = 30 \times \frac{\pi}{180}$ radian
$= \frac{\pi}{6}$ radian [Kwa kuwa, $1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180}$ radian]
Tunajua, urefu wa upinde,
$s = r\theta$
$= 100.5 \times \frac{\pi}{6}$ m.
$= \frac{100.5\pi}{6}$ m.
$= \frac{100.5 \times 3.1416}{6}$ m.
$= \frac{315.7308}{6}$ m.
$= 52.6218$ m.
Umbali uliofunikwa na Shahed katika sekunde 11 ni 52.6218 m.
$\therefore \quad \text{''}\quad \text{''}\quad \text{''}\quad 1 \quad \text{''}\quad \text{''}\quad \frac{52.6218}{11}$ m.
$= 4.7838$ m.
$= 4.78$ m.(takriban.)
$\therefore$ Kasi ya Shahed $= 4.78$ m./sek. (takriban.)
Jibu. 4.78 m./sek. (takriban.)

Question: Kuzingatia kwamba **redi** ya ardhi ni 6440 km. ni umbali gani kati ya maeneo mawili juu ya uso wa ardhi ambayo yana **pembe** ya nyuzi $32''$ kwenye kituo cha ardhi?
Solution:
Tunajua, ikiwa upinde wowote wenye urefu $s$ unatoa pembe $\theta$ kwenye kituo cha duara lenye radius r, basi $s=r\theta$.
Hapa, $\theta = 32''$
$= \frac{32}{60 \times 60} \quad [\because 1' = 60'' \text{ na } 1^\circ = 60']$
Kumbuka: Ubadilishaji sahihi wa dakika (') na sekunde ('') kuwa digrii unahitaji kugawanywa na 60 kwa kila hatua.
Kwa hiyo, $\theta$ kwa digrii ni $\frac{32}{3600}$ degrees.
$= \frac{32}{3600} \times \frac{\pi}{180}$ radian $\left[\because 1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180} \text{ radian}\right]$
na $r=6440$ km.
$\therefore s = r\theta$
$= 6440 \times \left(\frac{32}{3600} \times \frac{\pi}{180}\right)$ km.
$= 6440 \times \frac{32 \pi}{3600 \times 180}$ km.
$= \frac{6440 \times 32 \times 3.1416}{3600 \times 180}$ [Kwa kuwa, $\pi=3.1416$]
$= \frac{6697856}{648000}$ km.
$= 10.336$ km. $\approx 10.34$ km.
Jibu. Umbali kati ya maeneo mawili ni 10.34 km. (takriban).

Question:
Eleza kwa radian pembe kati ya mnara wa dakika na mnara wa saa wa saa wakati ni saa 9:30 AM.
[Vidokezo: Nafasi moja kwenye piga hupima pembe ya $\frac{360^\circ}{60} = 6^\circ$ digrii kwenye kituo. Saa 9:30 AM (au PM) mnara wa saa na mnara wa dakika wa saa uko $\left(15+\frac{1}{2}\right)$ au $17\frac{1}{2}$ nafasi kando]
Solution:
Kipande cha dakika hufunika sehemu 60 katika dakika 60 na kipande cha saa hufunika sehemu 5 katika dakika 60. Kwa hiyo, kipande cha saa hufunika $\frac{5}{60}$ au $\frac{1}{12}$ sehemu kwa dakika 1.
Tena, sehemu 60 za upigaji huunda pembe = 4 pembe za kulia au $360^\circ$ katikati.
$\therefore$ Sehemu 1 huunda pembe $= \frac{360^\circ}{60} = 6^\circ$ katikati.
Saa 9:30, nafasi ya kipande cha dakika iko kwenye 6 na nafasi ya kipande cha saa iko baada ya $\frac{30}{12}$ au $2\frac{1}{2}$ sehemu kutoka 9.
Kwa hiyo, umbali kati ya vipande viwili saa 9:30 ni (kutoka 6 hadi 9) sehemu 15 + sehemu $2\frac{1}{2}$ = sehemu $17\frac{1}{2}$.
Kwa kuwa, sehemu 1 huunda pembe $6^\circ$ katikati.
$\therefore$ Sehemu $17\frac{1}{2}$ huunda pembe $17\frac{1}{2} \times 6^\circ = 105^\circ$ katikati.
Tunajua, $1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180}$ radian
$ \therefore 105^\circ = \left( \frac{\pi}{180} \times 105 \right)^c $
=1.833 radian (takriban.)
Jibu. 1.833 radian (takriban.)

Question: Mtu anayekimbia kwa kasi ya $6$ km kwa saa kwenye njia ya mviringo, hupita sehemu ya njia hiyo katika sekunde $36$ ambayo huunda pembe ya $60^\circ$ katikati. Tafuta kipenyo cha njia hiyo ya mviringo.
Solution:
Suluhisho: Tuchukue, **jari** ya duara $= r$ m.
Tunajua, saa $1 = 3600$ sekunde
Tena, km $6 = 6 \times 1000$ m.
Katika sekunde $3600$ mtu hupita mita $6 \times 1000$ za njia
$\therefore$ Katika sekunde $36$ mtu hupita $= \frac{6 \times 1000 \times 36}{3600}$ za njia
$ = 60$ m. njia
Ikiwa njia ya duara aliyokimbia kwa sekunde $36$ ni AB, urefu wa AB, $s = 60$ m.
Imetolewa, pembe inayotegemeza katikati,
$\theta = 60^\circ$
$ = 60 \times \frac{\pi}{180}$ radian [Kwa kuwa, $1^\circ = \frac{\pi^c}{180}$]
$ = \frac{\pi}{3}$ radian
Tunajua, $s = r\theta$
au, $60 = r \times \frac{\pi}{3}$
au, $r = \frac{60 \times 3}{\pi}$
au, $r = \frac{60 \times 3}{3.1416}$
$\therefore r = 57.29564553$
$\therefore$ Kipenyo cha duara $= 2r$
$ = 2 \times 57.29564553$ m.
$ = 114.59$ m. (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Kipenyo $= 114.59$ m. (takriban.)
Jibu. $114.59$ m. (takriban.)

Question: Kiinimacho huonekana kwa pembe ya $8'$ kutoka sehemu yenye umbali wa kilomita $750$ kutoka mguuni mwake. Tafuta kimo cha kiinimacho.
Solution:
Tunajua, ikiwa upinde wenye urefu $s$ huzalisha pembe $\theta$ kwenye kituo cha duara lenye radius $r$, basi $s = r\theta$.
Hapa, $\theta = 8' = \frac{8^\circ}{60} = \frac{8}{60} \times \frac{\pi}{180}$ radian
na $r = 750$ km.
$\therefore$ Urefu wa kilima,
$s = r\theta$.
$ = 750 \times \frac{8}{60} \times \frac{\pi}{180}$ km.
$ = 1.745$ km. au $1745$ m.
$ = 1.745$ km. (takriban.) au $1745$ m. (takriban.)
$\therefore$ Urefu wa kilima $= 1.745$ km. (takriban.)
au $1745$ m. (takriban.)
Jibu. $1.745$ km. (takriban.) au $1745$ m. (takriban.)

Question:
Tathmini maadili yafuatayo bila kutumia kalkuleta:
$\frac{\cos \frac{\pi}{4}}{\cos \frac{\pi}{6}+\sin \frac{\pi}{3}}$
Solution:
$\frac{\cos \frac{\pi}{4}}{\cos \frac{\pi}{6}+\sin \frac{\pi}{3}}=\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}}{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}=\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}}{\frac{2\sqrt{3}}{2}}$
$=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \times \frac{2}{2\sqrt{3}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Tathmini maadili yafuatayo bila kutumia kikokotoo:
$\tan \frac{\pi}{4}+\tan \frac{\pi}{6} \cdot \tan \frac{\pi}{3}$
Solution:
$\tan \frac{\pi}{4}+\tan \frac{\pi}{6} \cdot \tan \frac{\pi}{3}=1+\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \cdot \sqrt{3}$
$=1+1=2$ (Jibu.)

Question: Ikiwa $\cos \theta=-\frac{4}{5}$ na $\pi<\theta<\frac{3\pi}{2}$ basi, tafuta thamani ya $\tan \theta$ na $\sin \theta$.
Solution:
Kupewa, $\cos \theta=-\frac{4}{5}$ na $\pi<\theta<\frac{3\pi}{2}$
Tathmini za $\tan \theta$ na $\sin \theta$ zitafahamishwa.
Hapa, $\cos \theta=-\frac{4}{5}$
au, $\cos ^{2} \theta=\left(-\frac{4}{5}\right)^{2}$ [kutunga pande zote]
au, $\cos ^{2} \theta=\frac{16}{25}$
au, $1-\sin ^{2} \theta=\frac{16}{25}$ [$\because \cos ^{2} \theta+\sin ^{2} \theta=1$]
au, $1-\frac{16}{25}=\sin ^{2} \theta$
au, $\frac{25-16}{25}=\sin ^{2} \theta$
au, $\sin ^{2} \theta=\frac{9}{25}$
au, $\sin \theta=\pm \sqrt{\frac{9}{25}}$
$\therefore \sin \theta=\pm \frac{3}{5}$
Kwa kuwa, $\pi<\theta<\frac{3\pi}{2}$, hivyo msimamo wa $\theta$ uko katika robo ya tatu na katika robo hiyo $\sin$ ni hasi.
Hivyo, $\sin \theta=-\frac{3}{5}$
Tena, $\tan \theta=\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta}=\frac{-\frac{3}{5}}{-\frac{4}{5}}=\frac{3}{4}$
Jibu. $\tan \theta=\frac{3}{4}, \sin \theta=-\frac{3}{5}$

Question: Ikiwa $\sin A=\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$ na $\frac{\pi}{2}<A<\pi$ basi, ni thamani ipi ya $\cos A$ na $\tan A$?
Solution:
Kutokana na, $\sin A=\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$
au, $\sin ^{2} A=\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\right)^{2}$ [kuweka mraba pande zote mbili]
au, $1-\cos ^{2} A=\frac{4}{5}$
au, $1-\frac{4}{5}=\cos ^{2} A$
au, $\frac{1}{5}=\cos ^{2} A$
au, $\cos A=\pm \sqrt{\frac{1}{5}}$
$\therefore \cos A=\pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}$
Kwa kuwa, $\frac{\pi}{2}<A<\pi$, hivyo msimamo wa $A$ uko katika robo ya pili na katika robo hiyo koini (cosine) ni hasi.
$\therefore \cos A=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}$ na $\tan A=\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}=\frac{\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}}{-\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}}=-2$
Jibu. $\cos A=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}, \tan A=-2$

Question: Hebu $\cos A=\frac{1}{2}$ na $\cos A$ na $\sin A$ vina ishara sawa. Bainisha thamani ya $\sin A$ na $\tan A$.
Solution:
Hapa, $\cos A=\frac{1}{2}$
au, $\cos ^{2} A=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2}$ [kupandisha pande zote mbili nguvu mbili]
au, $1-\sin ^{2} A=\frac{1}{4}$
au, $1-\frac{1}{4}=\sin ^{2} A$
au, $\frac{3}{4}=\sin ^{2} A$
au, $\sin A=\pm \sqrt{\frac{3}{4}}$
au, $\sin A=\pm \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
Kwa kuwa, $\cos A$ ni chanya
Hivyo, $\sin A$ itakuwa chanya.
$\therefore \sin A=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ na $\tan A=\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}=\frac{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}{\frac{1}{2}}=\sqrt{3}$
Jibu. $\sin A=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}, \tan A=\sqrt{3}$

Question: Hebu, $\tan A=-\frac{5}{12}$ na $\tan A$ na $\cos A$ zina ishara tofauti, tafuta thamani za $\sin A$ na $\cos A$.
Solution:
Hapa, $\tan A=-\frac{5}{12}$
au, $\tan ^{2} A=\left(-\frac{5}{12}\right)^{2}$ [kupanda pande zote mbili mraba]
au, $\sec ^{2} A-1=\frac{25}{144}$ [$\because \sec ^{2} A=1+\tan ^{2} A$]
au, $\sec ^{2} A=\frac{25}{144}+1$
au, $\sec ^{2} A=\frac{169}{144}$
au, $\sec A=\pm \sqrt{\frac{169}{144}}$
au, $\sec A=\pm \frac{13}{12}$
$\therefore \cos A=\pm \frac{12}{13}$
Kwa kuwa, $\tan A$ na $\cos A$ vina ishara tofauti
$\therefore \cos A=\frac{12}{13}$
Tena, $\tan A=\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}$
au, $\sin A=\tan A \cdot \cos A=-\frac{5}{12}\left(\frac{12}{13}\right)=-\frac{5}{13}$
$\therefore \sin A=-\frac{5}{13}$
Jibu. $\sin A=-\frac{5}{13}, \cos A=\frac{12}{13}$

Question:
Thibitisha mlinganyo ufuatao:
$\tan A+\cot A=\sec A \operatorname{cosec} A$
Solution:
L.S. $=\tan A+\cot A=\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}+\frac{\cos A}{\sin A}$
$=\frac{\sin ^{2} A+\cos ^{2} A}{\cos A \sin A}$
$=\frac{1}{\cos A \sin A}$ [$\because \sin ^{2} A+\cos ^{2} A=1$]
$=\frac{1}{\cos A} \cdot \frac{1}{\sin A}=\sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A=\text{R.S}$
$\therefore \tan A+\cot A=\sec A \operatorname{cosec} A$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Thibitisha mlinganyo ufuatao:
$\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos \theta}{1-\cos \theta}}=\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\cot \theta=\sqrt{\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\sec \theta-1}}$
Solution:
Hapa, $\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos \theta}{1-\cos \theta}}=\sqrt{\frac{(1+\cos \theta)(1+\cos \theta)}{(1-\cos \theta)(1+\cos \theta)}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(1+\cos \theta)^{2}}{1-\cos ^{2} \theta}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(1+\cos \theta)^{2}}{\sin ^{2} \theta}}$ [$\because \sin ^{2} \theta+\cos ^{2} \theta=1$]
$=\frac{1+\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}$
$=\frac{1}{\sin \theta}+\frac{\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}$
$=\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\cot \theta$
Tena, $\sqrt{\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\sec \theta-1}}=\sqrt{\frac{(\sec \theta+1)(\sec \theta+1)}{(\sec \theta-1)(\sec \theta+1)}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(\sec \theta+1)^{2}}{\sec ^{2} \theta-1}}=\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\sqrt{\tan ^{2} \theta}}=\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\tan \theta}$
$=\frac{\sec \theta}{\tan \theta}+\frac{1}{\tan \theta}=\frac{1}{\cos \theta} \cdot \frac{\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}+\cot \theta$
$=\frac{1}{\sin \theta}+\cot \theta=\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\cot \theta$
$\therefore \sqrt{\frac{1+\cos \theta}{1-\cos \theta}}=\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\cot \theta=\sqrt{\frac{\sec \theta+1}{\sec \theta-1}}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Thibitisha mlinganyo ufuatao:
$\sqrt{\frac{1-\sin A}{1+\sin A}}=\sec A-\tan A$
Solution:
L.S. $=\sqrt{\frac{1-\sin A}{1+\sin A}}=\sqrt{\frac{(1-\sin A)(1-\sin A)}{(1+\sin A)(1-\sin A)}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(1-\sin A)^{2}}{1-\sin ^{2} A}}$
$=\sqrt{\frac{(1-\sin A)^{2}}{\cos ^{2} A}}$ [$\because \sin ^{2} A+\cos ^{2} A=1$]
$=\frac{1-\sin A}{\cos A}=\frac{1}{\cos A}-\frac{\sin A}{\cos A}$
$=\sec A-\tan A=\text{R.S}$
$\therefore \sqrt{\frac{1-\sin A}{1+\sin A}}=\sec A-\tan A$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Thibitisha milinganyo ifuatayo:
$\sec ^{4} \theta-\sec ^{2} \theta=\tan ^{4} \theta+\tan ^{2} \theta$
Solution:
L.S $=\sec ^{4} \theta-\sec ^{2} \theta$
$=\left(\sec ^{2} \theta\right)^{2}-\sec ^{2} \theta$
$=\left(1+\tan ^{2} \theta\right)^{2}-\left(1+\tan ^{2} \theta\right)$ [$\because \sec ^{2} \theta=1+\tan ^{2} \theta$]
$=1+2 \tan ^{2} \theta+\tan ^{4} \theta-1-\tan ^{2} \theta$
$=\tan ^{4} \theta+\tan ^{2} \theta$
$=$ R.S
$\therefore \sec ^{4} \theta-\sec ^{2} \theta=\tan ^{4} \theta+\tan ^{2} \theta$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Thibitisha mlinganyo ufuatao:
$(\sec \theta-\cos \theta)(\operatorname{cosec} \theta-\sin \theta)(\tan \theta+\cot \theta)=1$
Solution:
K.U. $=(\sec \theta-\cos \theta)(\operatorname{cosec} \theta-\sin \theta)(\tan \theta+\cot \theta)$
$=\left(\frac{1}{\cos \theta}-\cos \theta\right)\left(\frac{1}{\sin \theta}-\sin \theta\right)\left(\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta}+\frac{\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}\right)$
$=\left(\frac{1-\cos ^{2} \theta}{\cos \theta}\right)\left(\frac{1-\sin ^{2} \theta}{\sin \theta}\right)\left(\frac{\sin ^{2} \theta+\cos ^{2} \theta}{\cos \theta \sin \theta}\right)$
$=\left(\frac{\sin ^{2} \theta}{\cos \theta}\right)\left(\frac{\cos ^{2} \theta}{\sin \theta}\right)\left(\frac{1}{\cos \theta \sin \theta}\right)$ [$\because \sin ^{2} \theta+\cos ^{2} \theta=1$]
$=\frac{\sin ^{2} \theta \cdot \cos ^{2} \theta}{\cos ^{2} \theta \cdot \sin ^{2} \theta}$
$=1=$ U.K.
$\therefore(\sec \theta-\cos \theta)(\operatorname{cosec} \theta-\sin \theta)(\tan \theta+\cot \theta)=1$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Thibitisha mlinganyo wafuatao:
$\frac{\tan \theta+\sec \theta-1}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}=\tan \theta+\sec \theta$
Solution:
L.S = $\frac{\tan \theta+\sec \theta-1}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}$
$=\frac{(\sec \theta+\tan \theta)-\left(\sec ^{2} \theta-\tan ^{2} \theta\right)}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}$
$=\frac{(\sec \theta+\tan \theta)-(\sec \theta+\tan \theta)(\sec \theta-\tan \theta)}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}$
$=\frac{(\sec \theta+\tan \theta)(1-\sec \theta+\tan \theta)}{(1-\sec \theta+\tan \theta)}$
$=\sec \theta+\tan \theta$
= R.S
$\therefore \frac{\tan \theta+\sec \theta-1}{\tan \theta-\sec \theta+1}=\tan \theta+\sec \theta$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Ikiwa $\operatorname{cosec} A=\frac{a}{b}$ ambapo $a>b>0$, basi thibitisha kwamba, $\tan A=\frac{\pm b}{\sqrt{a^{2}-b^{2}}}$
Solution:
Kupewa, $\operatorname{cosec} A=\frac{a}{b}$
au, $\operatorname{cosec}^{2} A=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}$ [kupaza pande zote mbili]
au, $1+\cot ^{2} A=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}$ [kwa kuwa, $\operatorname{cosec}^{2} A-\cot ^{2} A=1$]
au, $\cot ^{2} A=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}-1$
au, $\frac{1}{\tan ^{2} A}=\frac{a^{2}-b^{2}}{b^{2}}$
au, $\tan ^{2} A=\frac{b^{2}}{a^{2}-b^{2}}$
au, $\tan A=\pm \sqrt{\frac{b^{2}}{a^{2}-b^{2}}}$
$\therefore \tan A=\frac{\pm b}{\sqrt{a^{2}-b^{2}}}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Kama $\cos \theta-\sin \theta=\sqrt{2} \sin \theta$, basi thibitisha kwamba, $\cos \theta+\sin \theta=\sqrt{2} \cos \theta$
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$\cos \theta-\sin \theta=\sqrt{2} \sin \theta$
au, $\cos \theta=\sqrt{2} \sin \theta+\sin \theta$
au, $\cos \theta=(\sqrt{2}+1) \sin \theta$
au, $(\sqrt{2}-1) \cos \theta=(\sqrt{2}-1)(\sqrt{2}+1) \sin \theta$ [kuzidisha pande zote mbili kwa $(\sqrt{2}-1)$]
au, $(\sqrt{2}-1) \cos \theta=(2-1) \sin \theta$
au, $\sqrt{2} \cos \theta-\cos \theta=\sin \theta$
$\therefore \cos \theta+\sin \theta=\sqrt{2} \cos \theta$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Iwapo $\tan \theta=\frac{x}{y}, x \neq y$, basi tafuta thamani ya $\frac{x \sin \theta+y \cos \theta}{x \sin \theta-y \cos \theta}$
Solution:
Imepewa, $\tan \theta=\frac{x}{y}$
au, $\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta}=\frac{x}{y}$
au, $\frac{x \sin \theta}{y \cos \theta}=\frac{x}{y} \cdot \frac{x}{y}$ [kuzidisha pande zote kwa $\frac{x}{y}$]
au, $\frac{x \sin \theta}{y \cos \theta}=\frac{x^{2}}{y^{2}}$
$\therefore \frac{x \sin \theta+y \cos \theta}{x \sin \theta-y \cos \theta}=\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{x^{2}-y^{2}}$ [kwa kutumia componendo-dividendo]
Jibu. $\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{x^{2}-y^{2}}$

Question: Ikiwa $\tan\theta + \sec\theta = x$, basi onesha kwamba, $\sin\theta = \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}$
Solution:
Tumepewa, $\tan\theta + \sec\theta = x$
au, $\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} + \frac{1}{\cos\theta} = x$
au, $\frac{1+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = x$
au, $\frac{(1+\sin\theta)^2}{\cos^2\theta} = x^2$ [kupimwa pande zote mbili]
au, $\frac{(1+\sin\theta)^2}{1-\sin^2\theta} = x^2$ [$\because \cos^2\theta = 1-\sin^2\theta$]
au, $\frac{(1+\sin\theta)(1+\sin\theta)}{(1+\sin\theta)(1-\sin\theta)} = x^2$
au, $\frac{1+\sin\theta}{1-\sin\theta} = x^2$
au, $\frac{1+\sin\theta + 1-\sin\theta}{1+\sin\theta - (1-\sin\theta)} = \frac{x^2+1}{x^2-1}$ [kwa kutumia componendo-dividendo]
au, $\frac{2}{2\sin\theta} = \frac{x^2+1}{x^2-1}$
$\therefore \sin\theta = \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa $a\cos\theta - b\sin\theta = c$, basi onyesha kwamba, $a\sin\theta + b\cos\theta = \pm\sqrt{a^2+b^2-c^2}$
Solution:
Imepewa, $a\cos\theta - b\sin\theta = c$
au, $(a\cos\theta - b\sin\theta)^2 = c^2$ [kutia pande zote mbili mraba]
au, $a^2\cos^2\theta - 2a\cos\theta. b\sin\theta + b^2\sin^2\theta = c^2$
au, $a^2 (1 - \sin^2\theta) - 2a\cos\theta.b\sin\theta + b^2 (1 - \cos^2\theta) = c^2$
au, $a^2 - a^2\sin^2\theta - 2a\cos\theta.b\sin\theta + b^2 - b^2\cos^2\theta = c^2$
au, $- (a^2\sin^2\theta + 2a\cos\theta.b\sin\theta + b^2\cos^2\theta) = - (a^2+b^2-c^2)$
au, $a^2\sin^2\theta + 2a\cos\theta.b\sin\theta + b^2\cos^2\theta = a^2+b^2-c^2$
au, $(a\sin\theta)^2 + 2a\sin\theta.b\cos\theta + (b\cos\theta)^2 = a^2+b^2-c^2$
au, $(a\sin\theta + b\cos\theta)^2 = a^2+b^2-c^2$
$\therefore a\sin\theta + b\cos\theta = \pm\sqrt{a^2+b^2-c^2}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Kokotoa thamani ya:
$\sin^2 \frac{\pi}{6} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3} + \cot^2 \frac{\pi}{6}$
Solution:
$\sin^2 \frac{\pi}{6} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3} + \cot^2 \frac{\pi}{6}$
$= (\frac{1}{2})^2 + (\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}})^2 + (\sqrt{3})^2 + (\sqrt{3})^2$
$= \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{2} + 3 + 3$
$= \frac{1+2+12+12}{4}$
$= \frac{27}{4}$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= \frac{27}{4}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Kokotoa thamani ya:
$3\tan^2\frac{\pi}{4} - \sin^2\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{1}{2}\cot^2\frac{\pi}{6} + \frac{1}{3}\sec^2\frac{\pi}{4}$
Solution:
$3\tan^2\frac{\pi}{4} - \sin^2\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{1}{2}\cot^2\frac{\pi}{6} + \frac{1}{3}\sec^2\frac{\pi}{4}$
$= 3(1)^2 - \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{1}{2}(\sqrt{3})^2 + \frac{1}{3}(\sqrt{2})^2$
$= 3 - \frac{3}{4} - \frac{3}{2} + \frac{2}{3} = \frac{36 - 9 - 18 + 8}{12} = \frac{17}{12}$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= \frac{17}{12}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Tatua thamani ya:
$\tan^2 \frac{\pi}{4} - \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{3} \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{6} \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3} \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{4}$
Solution:
$\tan^2 \frac{\pi}{4} - \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{3} \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{6} \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3} \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{4}$
$= 1^2 - (\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})^2 \cdot (\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}})^2 \cdot (\sqrt{3})^2 \cdot (\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}})^2$
$= 1 - \frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{3} \cdot 3 \cdot \frac{1}{2}$
Kurahisisha zaidi, tunapata:
$= 1 - \frac{3}{8}$
$= \frac{8-3}{8}$
$= \frac{5}{8}$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= \frac{5}{8}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Tathmini thamani ya:
$\frac{\tan\frac{\pi}{3} - \tan\frac{\pi}{6}}{1 + \tan\frac{\pi}{3}\tan\frac{\pi}{6}} + \cos\frac{\pi}{3}\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + \sin\frac{\pi}{3}\sin\frac{\pi}{6}$
Solution:
$\frac{\tan\frac{\pi}{3} - \tan\frac{\pi}{6}}{1 + \tan\frac{\pi}{3}\tan\frac{\pi}{6}} + \cos\frac{\pi}{3}\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + \sin\frac{\pi}{3}\sin\frac{\pi}{6}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{3} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}{1 + \sqrt{3} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}} + \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2}$
$= \frac{\frac{3-1}{\sqrt{3}}}{1+1} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}$
$= \frac{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}}{2} + \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{4}$
$= \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \times \frac{1}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{2+3}{2\sqrt{3}} = \frac{5}{2\sqrt{3}} = \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2\sqrt{3}\cdot\sqrt{3}} = \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2\cdot 3} = \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{6}$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{6}$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Simplifisha:
$\frac{1-\sin^2\frac{\pi}{6}}{1+\sin^2\frac{\pi}{4}} \times \frac{\cos^2\frac{\pi}{3}+\cos^2\frac{\pi}{6}}{\text{cosec}^2\frac{\pi}{2}-\cot^2\frac{\pi}{2}} \div \left(\sin\frac{\pi}{3}\tan\frac{\pi}{6}\right) + \left(\sec^2\frac{\pi}{6}-\tan^2\frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
Solution:
$\frac{1-\sin^2\frac{\pi}{6}}{1+\sin^2\frac{\pi}{4}} \times \frac{\cos^2\frac{\pi}{3}+\cos^2\frac{\pi}{6}}{\text{cosec}^2\frac{\pi}{2}-\cot^2\frac{\pi}{2}} \div \left(\sin\frac{\pi}{3}\tan\frac{\pi}{6}\right) + \left(\sec^2\frac{\pi}{6}-\tan^2\frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= \frac{1-(\frac{1}{2})^2}{1+(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}})^2} \times \frac{(\frac{1}{2})^2 + (\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})^2}{1-0} \div \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) + \left\{\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2 - \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2\right\}$
$= \frac{1-\frac{1}{4}}{1+\frac{1}{2}} \times \left(\frac{1}{4}+\frac{3}{4}\right) \div \frac{1}{2} + \left(\frac{4}{3}-\frac{1}{3}\right)$
$= \frac{\frac{3}{4}}{\frac{3}{2}} \times \frac{4}{4} \div \frac{1}{2} + \frac{3}{3} = \frac{3}{4} \times \frac{2}{3} \times 2 + \frac{3}{3} = 1+1=2$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika ya kurahisisha $= 2$ (Jibu.)

Question: Rahisisha: $\sin 7\pi$
Solution:
$\sin 7\pi = \sin \left(14 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right)$. Hapa, $n=14$ ni namba genge. Kwa hiyo, $\sin$ itabaki haibadiliki na ishara ya $\sin$ itakuwa hasi, kwani pembe ipo katika robo ya tatu.
$\therefore \sin \left(14 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right) = -\sin 0^{\circ} = 0$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= 0$

Question: Rahisisha: $\cos \frac{11\pi}{2}$
Solution:
$\cos \frac{11\pi}{2} = \cos \left(11 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right)$
Hapa, $n=11$ ni namba isiyo ya jozi. Kwa hiyo, $\cos$ itabadilishwa kuwa $\sin$, na ishara ya $\cos$ itakuwa chanya, kwani pembe iko katika robo ya nne.
$\cos \frac{11\pi}{2} = \cos \left(11 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right) = \sin 0 = 0$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= 0$

Question: Rahisisha: $\cot 11\pi$
Solution:
$\cot 11\pi = \cot \left(22 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right)$
Hapa, $n=22$ ni namba ya genge. Kwa hivyo, $\cot$ itabaki bila kubadilika na ishara ya $\cot$ itakuwa chanya, kwa kuwa pembe iko katika robo ya kwanza au ya tatu. Hata hivyo, $\cot$ ni kipengezi cha kipindi cha $\pi$. Kwa hivyo,
$\therefore \cot 11\pi = \cot \left(\frac{11\pi}{\pi} \cdot \pi\right) = \cot (11 \cdot \pi) = \cot(0) = \text{Haijulikani.}$

Question: Simplifisha: $\tan \left(-\frac{23\pi}{6}\right)$
Solution:
$-\tan \frac{23\pi}{6}$ [kama, $\tan (-\theta) = -\tan \theta$]
$= -\tan \left(4\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= -\tan \left(8 \times \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
Hapa, $n=8$ ni namba ya jozi, hivyo $\tan$ itabaki bila kubadilika na ishara ya $\tan$ itakuwa hasi, kwa sababu pembe iko katika robo ya nne.
$\therefore -\tan \left(8 \times \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = -\left(-\tan \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \tan \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$

Question: Rahisisha: $\text{cosec } \frac{19\pi}{3}$
Solution:
$\text{cosec } \frac{19\pi}{3} = \text{cosec } \left(6\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
$= \text{cosec } \left(12 \times \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
Hapa, $n=12$, ni namba genge, hivyo cosec itabaki haijabadilika na ishara ya cosec itakuwa chanya, kwani pembe iko katika robo ya 1.
$\therefore \text{cosec } \frac{19\pi}{3} = \text{cosec } \left(12 \times \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \text{cosec } \frac{\pi}{3}$
$= \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \left[\therefore \text{cosec } \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right]$
Jibu: $\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}$

Question: Rahisisha: $\sec \left(-\frac{25\pi}{2}\right)$
Solution:
$\sec \left(-\frac{25\pi}{2}\right) = \sec \left(\frac{25\pi}{2}\right) \left[\because \sec (-\theta) = \sec \theta\right]$
$= \sec \left(24 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$
Hapa, $n=24$ ni namba ya jozi na pembe iko katika robo ya 1.
$\therefore \sec \left(-\frac{25\pi}{2}\right) = \sec \frac{\pi}{2} = \text{Haijulikani kufafanuliwa.}$

Question: Kokotoa: $\sin \frac{31\pi}{6}$
Solution:
$\sin \frac{31\pi}{6} = \sin \left(5\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \sin \left(10 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
Hapa $n=10$ ni namba yenye pazia. Kwa hiyo, $\sin$ itabaki bila kubadilika na alama ya $\sin$ itakuwa hasi, kwa kuwa pembe iko katika robo ya tatu.
$\therefore \sin \left(10 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = -\sin \frac{\pi}{6} = -\frac{1}{2}$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= -\frac{1}{2}$

Question: Rahisisha: $\cos \left(-\frac{25\pi}{6}\right)$
Solution:
$\cos \left(-\frac{25\pi}{6}\right) = \cos \frac{25\pi}{6}$
$\left[\because \cos (-\theta) = \cos \theta\right]$
$= \cos \left(4\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \cos \left(8 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
Hapa, $n=8$ ni namba genge. Kwa hiyo, $\cos$ itabaki haibadiliki na ishara ya $\cos$ itakuwa chanya, kwani pembe iko katika robo ya kwanza.
$\therefore \cos \left(8 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \cos \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$

Question: Serehesha: $\cos \frac{17\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{13\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{9\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{\pi}{10} = 0$
Solution:
K.B. $= \cos \frac{17\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{13\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{9\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{\pi}{10}$
$= \cos \left(2\pi-\frac{3\pi}{10}\right) + \cos \left(\pi+\frac{3\pi}{10}\right) + \cos \left(\pi-\frac{\pi}{10}\right) + \cos \frac{\pi}{10}$
$= \cos \frac{3\pi}{10} - \cos \frac{3\pi}{10} - \cos \frac{\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{\pi}{10}$
$= 0 = \text{U.B}$
$\therefore \cos \frac{17\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{13\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{9\pi}{10} + \cos \frac{\pi}{10} = 0 \text{ (Imethibitishwa)}$

Question: Sahilisha: $\tan \frac{\pi}{12} \tan \frac{5\pi}{12} \tan \frac{7\pi}{12} \tan \frac{11\pi}{12} = 1$
Solution:
L.S. $= \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \tan \frac{5\pi}{12} \tan \frac{7\pi}{12} \tan \frac{11\pi}{12}$
$= \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{12}\right) \tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{12}\right) \tan \left(2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{12}\right)$
$= \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \cot \frac{\pi}{12} \left(-\cot \frac{\pi}{12}\right) \left(-\tan \frac{\pi}{12}\right)$
$= \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \cdot \frac{1}{\tan \frac{\pi}{12}} \cdot \frac{1}{\tan \frac{\pi}{12}} \cdot \tan \frac{\pi}{12} = 1 = \text{R.S}$
$\therefore \tan \frac{\pi}{12} \tan \frac{5\pi}{12} \tan \frac{7\pi}{12} \tan \frac{11\pi}{12} = 1 \text{ (imethibitishwa)}$

Question: Tanzua:  $\sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{14} + \sin^2 \frac{8\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{9\pi}{14} = 2$
Solution:
K.M. $= \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{14} + \sin^2 \frac{8\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{9\pi}{14}$
$= \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \left\{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{7}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\sin \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{7}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{7}\right)\right\}^2$
$= \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \left(\cos \frac{\pi}{7}\right)^2 + \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{7}\right)^2 + \left(\cos \frac{\pi}{7}\right)^2$
$= \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{7} + \cos^2 \frac{2\pi}{7}$
$= 2\left(\sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \cos^2 \frac{2\pi}{7}\right) = 2 = \text{M.N.}$
$\therefore \sin^2 \frac{2\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{14} + \sin^2 \frac{8\pi}{7} + \sin^2 \frac{9\pi}{14} = 2 \text{ (imehakikishwa)}$

Question: Tanzua: $\sin \frac{7\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \cos \frac{5\pi}{3} \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} = 1$
Solution:
K.K. $= \sin \frac{7\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \cos \frac{5\pi}{3} \sin \frac{11\pi}{6}$
$= \sin \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \cos \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) - \cos \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \sin \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{6} - \cos \frac{\pi}{3} \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{6} + \cos \frac{\pi}{3} \sin \frac{\pi}{6}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2}$
$= \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3+1}{4} = \frac{4}{4} = 1 = \text{K.K.}$
$\therefore \sin \frac{7\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \cos \frac{5\pi}{3} \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} = 1 \text{ (Imethibitishwa)}$

Question: Simplisha: $\sin \frac{13\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} \cos \left(\frac{5\pi}{3}\right) = 1$
Solution:
L.S. $= \sin \frac{13\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} \cos \left(\frac{5\pi}{3}\right)$
$= \sin \left(4\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \cos \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) - \sin \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \cos \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
$\left[\because \cos (-\theta) = \cos \theta\right]$
$= \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{6} - \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \cos \frac{\pi}{3}$
$= \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{6} + \sin \frac{\pi}{6} \cos \frac{\pi}{3}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2}$
$= \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3+1}{4} = \frac{4}{4} = 1 = \text{R.S}$
$\therefore \sin \frac{13\pi}{3} \cos \frac{13\pi}{6} - \sin \frac{11\pi}{6} \cos \left(\frac{5\pi}{3}\right) = 1 \text{ (imeonelezwa)}$

Question:
Iwapo $\tan \theta = \frac{3}{4}$ na $\sin \theta$ ni hasi, onyesha kwamba,
$\frac{\sin \theta + \cos \theta}{\sec \theta + \tan \theta} = \frac{14}{5}$
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$\tan \theta = \frac{3}{4}$ na $\sin \theta$ ni hasi
au, $\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \frac{3}{4}$
au, $3\cos \theta = 4\sin \theta$
au, $9\cos^2 \theta = 16\sin^2 \theta$ [kupa pande zote mbili]
au, $9(1-\sin^2 \theta) = 16\sin^2 \theta$
au, $9 - 9\sin^2 \theta - 16\sin^2 \theta = 0$
au, $-25\sin^2 \theta = -9$
au, $\sin^2 \theta = \frac{9}{25}$
au, $\sin \theta = \pm \frac{3}{5}$
$\therefore \sin \theta = -\frac{3}{5}$ [$\therefore \sin \theta$ ni hasi]
Tena, $\tan \theta = \frac{3}{4}$
au, $\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \frac{3}{4}$
au, $3\cos \theta = 4\sin \theta$
$\therefore \cos \theta = \frac{4}{3} \times \left(-\frac{3}{5}\right) = -\frac{4}{5}$
na $\sec \theta = \frac{1}{\cos \theta} = \frac{1}{-\frac{4}{5}} = -\frac{5}{4}$
Upande wa Kushoto $= \frac{\sin \theta + \cos \theta}{\sec \theta + \tan \theta}$
$= \frac{-\frac{3}{5} + \left(-\frac{4}{5}\right)}{-\frac{5}{4} + \frac{3}{4}} = \frac{\frac{-3-4}{5}}{\frac{-5+3}{4}} = \frac{\frac{-7}{5}}{\frac{-2}{4}}$
$= -\frac{7}{5} \times -\frac{2}{1} = \frac{14}{5} = \text{Upande wa Kulia}$
$\therefore \frac{\sin \theta + \cos \theta}{\sec \theta + \tan \theta} = \frac{14}{5} \text{ (Imethibitishwa)}$

Question: Kokotoa: $\cos \frac{9\pi}{4} + \cos \frac{5\pi}{4} + \sin \frac{31\pi}{36} - \sin \frac{5\pi}{36}$
Solution:
$\cos \frac{9\pi}{4} + \cos \frac{5\pi}{4} + \sin \frac{31\pi}{36} - \sin \frac{5\pi}{36}$
$= \cos \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + \cos \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + \sin \left(\pi - \frac{5\pi}{36}\right) - \sin \frac{5\pi}{36}$
$= \cos \frac{\pi}{4} - \cos \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin \frac{5\pi}{36} - \sin \frac{5\pi}{36}$
$= 0$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= 0$

Question: Rahisisha: $\cot \frac{\pi}{20} \cot \frac{3\pi}{20} \cot \frac{5\pi}{20} \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \cot \frac{9\pi}{20}$
Solution:
$\cot \frac{\pi}{20} \cot \frac{3\pi}{20} \cot \frac{5\pi}{20} \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \cot \frac{9\pi}{20}$
$= \cot \frac{\pi}{20} \cot \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{7\pi}{20}\right) \cot \frac{\pi}{4} \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \cot \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{20}\right)$
$= \cot \frac{\pi}{20} \tan \frac{7\pi}{20} \cdot 1 \cdot \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \tan \frac{\pi}{20}$
$= \cot \frac{\pi}{20} \cdot \frac{1}{\cot \frac{7\pi}{20}} \cdot \cot \frac{7\pi}{20} \cdot \frac{1}{\cot \frac{\pi}{20}} = 1$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= 1$

Question: Simplifisha: $\sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{3\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{7\pi}{4}$
Solution:
$\sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{3\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{7\pi}{4}$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + \sin^2 \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + \sin^2 \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\right)$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{4}\right)^2 + \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{4}\right)^2$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4}$
$= 4 \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{4} = 4 \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^2 = 4 \cdot \frac{1}{2} = 2$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= 2$

Question: Rahisisha:  $\cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{5\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{7\pi}{8}$
Solution:
$\cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{5\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{7\pi}{8}$
$= \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{8}\right) + \cos^2 \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{3\pi}{8}\right)$
$= \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \left(-\sin \frac{\pi}{8}\right)^2 + \left(-\sin \frac{3\pi}{8}\right)^2$
$= \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{8} + \sin^2 \frac{3\pi}{8}$
$= 1+1=2$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= 2$

Question: Serafisha: $\sin^2 \frac{17\pi}{18} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{37\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{18}$
Solution:
$\sin^2 \frac{17\pi}{18} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{37\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{18}$
$= \left(\sin \frac{17\pi}{18}\right)^2 + \left(\sin \frac{5\pi}{18}\right)^2 + \left(\cos \frac{37\pi}{18}\right)^2 + \left(\cos \frac{3\pi}{18}\right)^2$
$= \sin^2 \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{18}\right) + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{18}\right) + \cos^2 \frac{3\pi}{18}$
$= \left\{\sin \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{18}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{4\pi}{18}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\cos \left(2\pi + \frac{\pi}{18}\right)\right\}^2 + \left\{\cos \left(\pi - \frac{5\pi}{18}\right)\right\}^2$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{4\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{5\pi}{18}$
$= \sin^2 \frac{\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{\pi}{18} + \sin^2 \frac{5\pi}{18} + \cos^2 \frac{5\pi}{18}$
$= 1 + 1 \left[\because \sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta = 1\right]$
$= 2$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= 2$

Question: Kama $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$ basi thibitisha utambulisho wafuatao: $\sin 2\theta = 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = \frac{2 \tan \theta}{1+\tan^2 \theta}$
Solution:
Imepewa, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$
Sasa, $\sin 2\theta = \sin 2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= \sin \frac{2\pi}{3}$
$= \sin \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \sin \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
Na $2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = 2 \sin \frac{\pi}{3} \cos \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= 2 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
Tena, $\frac{2 \tan \theta}{1 + \tan^2 \theta} = \frac{2 \tan \frac{\pi}{3}}{1 + \tan^2 \frac{\pi}{3}} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= \frac{2 \cdot \sqrt{3}}{1 + (\sqrt{3})^2}$
$= \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{1+3} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$\therefore \sin 2\theta = 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta = \frac{2 \tan \theta}{1 + \tan^2 \theta} \text{ (Imethibitishwa)}$

Question: Ikiwa $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$ basi thibitisha utambulisho wafuatayo: $\sin 3\theta = 3\sin \theta - 4\sin^3 \theta$
Solution:
Imepewa, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$
K.S. $= \sin 3\theta = \sin \left(3 \cdot \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= \sin \pi = \sin (2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0)$
$= \sin 0 = 0$
K.N. $= 3\sin \theta - 4\sin^3 \theta$
$= 3\sin \frac{\pi}{3} - 4\sin^3 \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= 3 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - 4 \cdot \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^3 = \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} - 4 \cdot \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{8}$
$= \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} - \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} = 0$
$\therefore \sin 3\theta = 3 \sin \theta - 4 \sin^3 \theta \text{ (Imethibitishwa)}$

Question: Ikiwa $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$ basi onyesha kwamba utambulisho ufuatao ni kweli: $\cos 3\theta = 4\cos^3 \theta - 3\cos \theta$.
Solution:
Kumetolewa, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$
K.K. $= \cos 3\theta$
$= \cos 3 \cdot \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= \cos \pi$
$= \cos \left(2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 0\right)$
$= -\cos 0^\circ = -1$
K.K. $= 4 \cos^3 \theta - 3 \cos \theta$
$= 4 \cos^3 \frac{\pi}{3} - 3 \cos \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}\right]$
$= 4 \cdot \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 - 3 \cdot \frac{1}{2} = 4 \cdot \frac{1}{8} - \frac{3}{2} = \frac{1}{2} - \frac{3}{2}$
$= \frac{1-3}{2} = \frac{-2}{2} = -1$
$\therefore \cos 3\theta = 4 \cos^3 \theta - 3 \cos \theta$. (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Tathmini thamani ya $\alpha$ inayokidhi masharti yafuatayo: $\cot \alpha = -\sqrt{3} \, ; \, \frac{3\pi}{2} < \alpha < 2\pi$
Solution:
Katika robo ya nne,
$\cot \alpha = -\sqrt{3}$
au, $\cot \alpha = -\cot \frac{\pi}{6}$
$= \cot \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$
$= \cot \left(\frac{12\pi - \pi}{6}\right) = \cot \frac{11\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{11\pi}{6}$ inakubaliwa, kwa kuwa $\frac{3\pi}{2} < \alpha < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika ni $\alpha = \frac{11\pi}{6}$

Question: Tathmini thamani ya $\alpha$ inayoridhisha masharti yaliyotolewa: $\cos \alpha = -\frac{1}{2} \, ; \, \frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
Solution:
Katika robo ya pili, $\cos \alpha = -\frac{1}{2}$
au, $\cos \alpha = -\cos \frac{\pi}{3}$
au, $\cos \alpha = \cos \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
au, $\alpha = \frac{3\pi - \pi}{3}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{2\pi}{3}$
ambayo inakidhi sharti la $\frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
Tena, katika robo ya tatu, $\cos \alpha = -\frac{1}{2}$
au, $\cos \alpha = -\cos \frac{\pi}{3}$
au, $\cos \alpha = \cos \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
au, $\alpha = \frac{3\pi + \pi}{3}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{4\pi}{3}$
ambayo inakidhi sharti, $\frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
$\therefore$ Thamani zinazohitajika, $\alpha = \frac{2\pi}{3} \text{ na } \frac{4\pi}{3}$

Question: Tathmini thamani ya $\alpha$ inayokidhi masharti yaliyotolewa: $\sin \alpha = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \, ; \, \frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
Solution:
$\sin \alpha = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
au, $\sin \alpha = -\sin \frac{\pi}{3}$
au, $\sin \alpha = \sin \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \left[\therefore \text{sin ni hasi katika robo ya tatu}\right]$
au, $\alpha = \pi + \frac{\pi}{3}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{4\pi}{3}$, ambayo inakidhi sharti la $\frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= \frac{4\pi}{3}$

Question: Tathmini ya thamani ya $\alpha$ inayoridhisha masharti yaliyotolewa: $\cot \alpha = -1 \, ; \, \pi < \alpha < 2\pi$
Solution:
$\cot \alpha = -1$
au, $\cot \alpha = -\cot \frac{\pi}{4}$
au, $\cot \alpha = \cot \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) \, ; \, \left[\because \text{ cot ni hasi katika robo ya nne}\right]$
au, $\alpha = 2\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}$
$\therefore \alpha = \frac{7\pi}{4}$, ambayo inatimiza sharti, $\pi < \alpha < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Thamani inayohitajika $= \frac{7\pi}{4}$

Question: Tatua: $\left(\text{ambapo } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$$2 \cos^2 \theta = 1 + 2 \sin^2 \theta$
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba,
$2 \cos^2 \theta = 1 + 2 \sin^2 \theta$
au, $2 \cos^2 \theta - 2 \sin^2 \theta = 1$
au, $2(1-\sin^2 \theta) - 2 \sin^2 \theta = 1 \left[\therefore \cos^2 \theta = 1 - \sin^2 \theta\right]$
au, $2 - 2\sin^2 \theta - 2\sin^2 \theta = 1$
au, $2 - 4 \sin^2 \theta = 1$
au, $-4\sin^2 \theta = -1$
au, $\sin^2 \theta = \frac{1}{4}$
au, $\sin \theta = \pm \frac{1}{2}$
Kwa kuwa $0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}$, hivyo basi $\sin \theta = -\frac{1}{2}$ hakikubaliwi.
$\therefore \sin \theta = \frac{1}{2}$
au, $\sin \theta = \sin \frac{\pi}{6} \left[\because \sin \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\right]$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$

Question: Tatua: $\left(\text{ambapo } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ $2 \sin^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta = 0$
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba,
$2 \sin^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta = 0$
au, $2(1-\cos^2 \theta) - 3 \cos \theta = 0$
au, $2 - 2\cos^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta = 0$
au, $-(2\cos^2 \theta + 3\cos \theta - 2) = 0$
au, $2 \cos^2 \theta + 3\cos \theta - 2 = 0$
au, $2 \cos^2 \theta + 4 \cos \theta - \cos \theta - 2 = 0$
au, $2 \cos \theta (\cos \theta + 2) - 1 (\cos \theta + 2) = 0$
au, $(2 \cos \theta - 1)(\cos \theta + 2) = 0$
Hapa, $\cos \theta + 2 \neq 0$ kwa sababu, ikiwa $\cos \theta + 2 = 0$ basi $\cos \theta = -2$, ambacho hakikubaliki, kwa sababu thamani ya $\cos \theta$ haiwezi kamwe kuwa kubwa kuliko 1 na ndogo kuliko -1.
$\therefore 2 \cos \theta - 1 = 0$ wakati $0^\circ < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}$
au, $2 \cos \theta = 1$
au, $\cos \theta = \frac{1}{2}$
au, $\cos \theta = \cos \frac{\pi}{3}$,
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$

Question: Tatua: $\left(\text{ambapo } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$$6 \sin^2 \theta - 11\sin \theta + 4 = 0$
Solution:
Imepewa,
$6 \sin^2 \theta - 11\sin \theta + 4 = 0$
au, $6 \sin^2 \theta - 8\sin \theta - 3 \sin \theta + 4 = 0$
au, $2 \sin \theta (3 \sin \theta - 4) - 1(3\sin \theta - 4) = 0$
au, $(2 \sin \theta - 1)(3\sin \theta - 4) = 0$
Hapa, $3\sin \theta - 4 \neq 0$ kwa sababu, ikiwa $3\sin \theta - 4 = 0$ basi $\sin \theta = \frac{4}{3}$, ambayo haikubaliki. Kwa sababu thamani ya $\sin \theta$ haiwezi kuwa kubwa kuliko 1 na ndogo kuliko -1.
$\therefore 2\sin \theta - 1 = 0$
au, $\sin \theta = \frac{1}{2}$
au, $\sin \theta = \sin \frac{\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$

Question: Tatua: $\left(\text{wakati } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ $\tan \theta + \cot \theta = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$\tan \theta + \cot \theta = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$
au, $\tan \theta + \frac{1}{\tan \theta} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$
au, $\frac{\tan^2 \theta + 1}{\tan \theta} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$
au, $\sqrt{3} (\tan^2 \theta + 1) = 4 \tan \theta$
au, $\sqrt{3} \tan^2 \theta + \sqrt{3} = 4 \tan \theta$
au, $\sqrt{3} \tan^2 \theta - 4 \tan \theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
au, $\sqrt{3} \tan^2 \theta - 3 \tan \theta - \tan \theta + \sqrt{3} = 0$
au, $\sqrt{3} \tan \theta (\tan \theta - \sqrt{3}) - 1 (\tan \theta - \sqrt{3}) = 0$
au, $(\tan \theta - \sqrt{3}) (\sqrt{3} \tan \theta - 1) = 0$
Au, $\tan \theta - \sqrt{3} = 0$ au, $\sqrt{3} \tan \theta - 1 = 0$
au, $\tan \theta = \sqrt{3}$ au, $\tan \theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
au, $\tan \theta = \tan \frac{\pi}{3}$ au, $\tan \theta = \tan \frac{\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3} \left[\therefore \tan \frac{\pi}{3} = \sqrt{3}\right]$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6} \left[\therefore \tan \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right]$
ambayo inatimiza sharti, $0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{3$

Question: Tatua: $\left(\text{ambapo } 0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ $2\sin^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta = 3$
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$2\sin^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta = 3$
au, $2(1-\cos^2 \theta) + 3 \cos \theta - 3 = 0$
au, $2 - 2\cos^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta - 3 = 0$
au, $-2\cos^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta - 1 = 0$
au, $-(2\cos^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta + 1) = 0$
au, $2\cos^2 \theta - 3 \cos \theta + 1 = 0$
au, $2\cos^2 \theta - 2 \cos \theta - \cos \theta + 1 = 0$
au, $2 \cos \theta (\cos \theta - 1) - 1 (\cos \theta - 1) = 0$
au, $(2 \cos \theta - 1) (\cos \theta - 1) = 0$
$\therefore$ Ama, $2\cos \theta - 1 = 0$ au, $\cos \theta - 1 = 0$
au, $\cos \theta = \frac{1}{2}$ au, $\cos \theta = 1$
au, $\cos \theta = \cos \frac{\pi}{3}$ au, $\cos \theta = \cos 0$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$ $\therefore \theta = 0$
Lakini $0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}$
$\therefore \theta \neq 0^\circ$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika, $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$

Question: Tatua: (ambapo $0 < \theta < 2\pi$)$2 \sin^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta = 0$
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$2 \sin^2 \theta + 3 \cos \theta = 0$
au, $2 (1-\cos^2\theta) + 3 \cos\theta = 0$
au, $2 - 2 \cos^2\theta + 3 \cos\theta = 0$
au, $2 \cos^2\theta - 3 \cos\theta - 2 = 0$ [kuzidisha pande zote kwa $(-1)$]
au, $2 \cos^2\theta - 4 \cos\theta + \cos\theta - 2 = 0$
au, $2 \cos\theta ( \cos\theta - 2) + 1 (\cos\theta - 2) = 0$
au, $(2 \cos \theta + 1) (\cos \theta - 2) = 0$
Lakini, $\cos\theta - 2 \ne 0$ kwa sababu, kama $\cos\theta - 2 = 0$ basi $\cos\theta = 2$, jambo ambalo haliwezekani.
Hivyo basi, $2\cos\theta + 1 = 0$
au, $\cos\theta = -\frac{1}{2}$
au, $\cos\theta = -\frac{1}{2} = -\cos\frac{\pi}{3}$
au, $\cos\theta = \cos \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{3} \right)$, $\cos \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{3} \right)$
[kulingana na sharti $0 < \theta < 2\pi$]
au, $\cos\theta = \cos\frac{2\pi}{3}$, $\cos\frac{4\pi}{3}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{2\pi}{3}, \frac{4\pi}{3}$, ambavyo vinatosheleza sharti, $0 < \theta < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika: $\theta = \frac{2\pi}{3}, \frac{4\pi}{3}$

Question: Tatua: (ambapo $0 < \theta < 2\pi$)$4 (\cos^2\theta + \sin\theta) = 5$
Solution:
Imepewa,
$4 (\cos^2\theta + \sin\theta) = 5$
au, $4 (1 - \sin^2\theta + \sin\theta) = 5$
au, $4 - 4 \sin^2\theta + 4 \sin \theta = 5$
au, $4 \sin^2\theta - 4 \sin \theta + 1 = 0$ [kuzidisha pande zote kwa $(-1)$]
au, $(2 \sin \theta - 1)^2 = 0$
au, $2\sin \theta - 1 = 0$ [kuchukua mzizi wa mraba]
au, $\sin \theta = \frac{1}{2}$
au, $\sin \theta = \sin\frac{\pi}{6}$, $\sin\left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$ [kulingana na sharti]
au, $\sin\theta = \sin\frac{\pi}{6}$, $\sin\frac{5\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}$, ambazo zinatimiza sharti, $0 < \theta < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika: $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}$

Question: Tatua: (wakati $0 < \theta < 2\pi$) $\tan^2\theta + \cot^2\theta = 2$
Solution:
Kupatiwa,
$\tan^2\theta + \cot^2\theta = 2$
au, $\tan^2\theta + \frac{1}{\tan^2\theta} = 2$
au, $\tan^4\theta + 1 = 2 \tan^2\theta$ [kuzidisha pande zote mbili kwa $\tan^2\theta$]
au, $\tan^4\theta - 2 \tan^2\theta + 1 = 0$
au, $(\tan^2\theta - 1)^2 = 0$
au, $\tan^2\theta - 1 = 0$
au, $\tan^2\theta = 1$
au, $\tan \theta = \pm 1$
Sasa, kwa kuchukua $\tan \theta = 1$ tunapata,
$\tan\theta = \tan\frac{\pi}{4}$, $\tan \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)$ [kulingana na sharti]
au, $\tan\theta = \tan\frac{\pi}{4}$, $\tan\frac{5\pi}{4}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{5\pi}{4}$
Tena kwa kuchukua $\tan\theta = -1$ tunapata,
$\tan\theta = -\tan\frac{\pi}{4}$
au, $\tan\theta = \tan \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4} \right)$, $\tan \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{4} \right)$
[kulingana na sharti]
au, $\tan\theta = \tan\frac{3\pi}{4}$, $\tan\frac{7\pi}{4}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{3\pi}{4}, \frac{7\pi}{4}$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika: $\theta = \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{3\pi}{4}, \frac{5\pi}{4}, \frac{7\pi}{4}$

Question: Tatua: (wakati $0 < \theta < 2\pi$) $\sec^2\theta + \tan^2\theta = \frac{5}{3}$
Solution:
Kupatia,
$(\sec^2\theta + \tan^2\theta) = \frac{5}{3}$
au, $3 (1 + \tan^2\theta + \tan^2\theta) = 5$
au, $3 + 6 \tan^2\theta - 5 = 0$
au, $6 \tan^2\theta = 2$
au, $\tan^2\theta = \frac{1}{3}$
$\therefore \tan \theta = \pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$
Sasa, kwa kuchukua $\tan \theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$ tunapata,
$\tan\theta = \tan\frac{\pi}{6}$, $\tan \left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{6} \right)$ [kulingana na sharti]
au, $\tan\theta = \tan\frac{\pi}{6}$, $\tan\frac{7\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{7\pi}{6}$
Tena, kwa kuchukua $\tan\theta = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$ tunapata,
au, $\tan\theta = -\tan\frac{\pi}{6}$
au, $\tan\theta = \tan \left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{6} \right)$, $\tan \left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6} \right)$ [kulingana na sharti]
au, $\tan\theta = \tan\frac{5\pi}{6}$, $\tan\frac{11\pi}{6}$
$\therefore \theta = \frac{5\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika: $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}, \frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}$

Question: Tatua: (ambapo $0 < \theta < 2\pi$) $5\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta - 7 \cot\theta \operatorname{cosec}\theta - 2 = 0$
Solution:
Imepewa,
$5\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta - 7 \cot\theta \operatorname{cosec}\theta - 2 = 0$
au, $5\frac{1}{\sin^2\theta} - 7\frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} \frac{1}{\sin\theta} - 2 = 0$
au, $5 - 7\cos\theta - 2\sin^2\theta = 0$
au, $5 - 7\cos\theta - 2(1 - \cos^2\theta) = 0$
au, $5 - 7\cos\theta - 2 + 2\cos^2\theta = 0$
au, $2\cos^2\theta - 7\cos\theta + 3 = 0$
au, $2\cos^2\theta - 6\cos\theta - \cos\theta + 3 = 0$
au, $2\cos\theta(\cos\theta - 3) - 1(\cos\theta - 3) = 0$
au, $(2\cos\theta - 1)(\cos\theta - 3) = 0$
Ama, $2\cos\theta - 1 = 0$ au, $\cos\theta - 3 = 0$
$\therefore \cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}$ $\therefore \cos\theta = 3$
Lakini, thamani ya $\cos\theta$ haiwezi kuwa kubwa kuliko 1.
$\therefore \cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
$\cos\theta = \cos\frac{\pi}{3}$, $\cos\left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$ [kulingana na masharti]
$\therefore \theta = \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{3}$, ambazo ziko ndani ya kikomo kilichopewa, $0 < \theta < 2\pi$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika: $\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{3}$

Question: Tatua: $2\sin x \cos x = \sin x$ ($0 \le x \le 2\pi$).
Solution:
$2\sin x \cos x = \sin x$
au, $2\sin x \cos x - \sin x = 0$
au, $\sin x (2\cos x - 1) = 0$
Ama, $\sin x = 0$ au $2\cos x - 1 = 0$
$\therefore \cos x = \frac{1}{2}$
Ikiwa $\sin x = 0$, basi $\sin x = \sin 0$, $\sin\pi$, $\sin 2\pi$
$\therefore x = 0, \pi, 2\pi$
Ikiwa $\cos x = \frac{1}{2}$, basi $\cos x = \cos\frac{\pi}{3}$, $\cos\left(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$
au, $\cos x = \cos\frac{\pi}{3}, \cos\frac{5\pi}{3}$
$\therefore x = \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{3}$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika: $\theta = 0, \frac{\pi}{3}, \pi, \frac{5\pi}{3}, 2\pi$

Question: Wacha **radius** ya Dunia kiwe $6440 \text{ km}$. Dhaka na Panchagarh huunda pembe ya $3.5^\circ$ kwenye kituo cha Dunia. Mtu anataka kufurahia mandhari nzuri ya Panchagarh wakati wa baridi. Alifika Panchagarh na gari lenye gurudumu la kipenyo cha $0.84\text{m}$. Je, ni pembe gani kwa radia ambazo Dhaka na Panchagarh huunda kwenye kituo cha Dunia?
Solution:
Pembe kati ya Dhaka na Panchagarh $= 3.5^\circ$
Tunajua, $1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180}$
$\therefore 3.5^\circ = \frac{3.5\pi}{180} = \frac{7\pi}{360}$ (Jibu.)

Question: Kipenyo cha Dunia ni kilomita $6440$. Miji ya Dhaka na Panchagarh hutengeneza pembe ya $3.5^\circ$ katikati ya Dunia. Mtu anataka kufurahia mandhari nzuri ya Panchagarh wakati wa baridi. Alifika Panchagarh kwa gari lenye gurudumu la kipenyo cha $0.84\text{m}$. Umbali kati ya Dhaka na Panchagarh ni upi?
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba,
Kipenyo cha dunia, $r = 6440 \text{ kilomita}$
Pembe kati ya Dhaka na Panchagarh, $\theta = 3.5^\circ$
$= \frac{3.5 \times \pi}{180}$
$= \frac{7\pi}{360}$
$\therefore$ Umbali kati ya Dhaka na Panchagarh, $S = r\theta$
$= (6440 \times \frac{7\pi}{360}) \text{ kilomita}$
$= 393.4 \text{ kilomita (takribani) (Jibu.)}$

Question:
Yapo haya:
Mgo **wa** Dunia una **rediasi** ya kilomita $6440 \text{ km}$. Dhaka na Panchagarh huunda pembe ya $3.5^\circ$ kwenye kituo cha Dunia. Mtu anataka kufurahia uzuri wa asili wa Panchagarh wakati wa baridi. Alifika Panchagarh kwa gari lenye gurudumu la kipenyo cha $0.84\text{m}$. Ni mizunguko mingapi gurudumu litafanya wakati wa kusafiri kutoka Dhaka hadi Panchagarh?
Solution:
Kutokana na kwamba,
Kipenyo cha gurudumu $= \frac{0.84}{2} \text{ mita} = 0.42 \text{ mita}$
Tunajua, Katika mzunguko mmoja gurudumu husafiri umbali sawa na mzingo wake.
$\therefore$ Mzingo wa gurudumu $= 2 \times 0.42 \times \pi$
$= 0.84\pi \text{ mita}$
$393.4 \text{ km} = 393.4 \times 1000 \text{ mita}$
$= 393400 \text{ mita}$
$\therefore$ Idadi inayohitajika ya mzunguko wa gurudumu ni
$= \frac{393400}{0.84 \pi} \text{ mara}$
$\approx 149075 \text{ mara (takriban)}$

Question: Kwenye mchoro, ABC ni gurudumu la duara na urefu wa upinde AB ni $25 \text{ cm}$. Pata thamani ya $\theta$. Ni umbali gani gurudumu litafunika katika mzunguko mmoja?
Solution:
Kupewa, urefu wa upinde AB wa gurudumu, $S = 25 \text{ cm}$.
Kutokana na mchoro tunapata, **mwandamo** (radius), $r = x^2 + 1 \text{ cm}$.
Trigonometry
Sasa tunajua, $S = r\theta$
au, $\theta = \frac{S}{r}$
au, $\theta = \frac{25}{x^2+1}$ radian
$\therefore \theta = \frac{25}{x^2+1}$ (Jibu.)Tunajua, baada ya kuzunguka mara moja, gurudumu husafiri umbali ambao ni sawa na **mzingo** wake.
Hiyo ni, $2\pi r \text{ cm}$
$= 2\pi (x^2+1)$ (Jibu.)$\therefore$ Baada ya kuzunguka mara moja, gurudumu husafiri umbali $= 2\pi (x^2+1)$ (Jibu.)

Question: Ni kasi ya gurudumu ABC iwapo linazunguka mara 5 kwa sekunde?
Solution:
1 saa $= 60 \text{ dakika} = 60 \times 60 \text{ sekunde}$
$= 3600 \text{ sekunde}$
Gurudumu ABC huchukua sekunde 1 kwa mapinduzi 5.
$\therefore$ Gurudumu huzunguka katika saa 1 $= (3600 \times 5) \text{ mara}$
$= 18000 \text{ mara}$.
$\therefore$ Gurudumu husafiri umbali katika saa 1
$= (18000 \times 1.57) \text{ m.}$
$= 28260 \text{ m.}$
$= 28.26 \text{ km. (takribani)}$
Kasi ya gurudumu ni $28.26 \text{ km/saa (takribani)}$
Jibu. $28.26 \text{ Km saa. (takribani)}$

Question: Kwenye mchoro, tafuta thamani ya $\sin\theta$ kutoka $\triangle BOD$, ili kuthibitisha kwamba, $\tan\theta + \sec\theta = x$.
Solution:
Kutoka kwenye kielelezo tunapata, $\sin\theta = \frac{BD}{BO}$
au, $\sin \theta = \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}$
$\therefore \cos \theta = \sqrt{1 - \sin^2\theta}$
$= \sqrt{1 - \left(\frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}\right)^2} = \sqrt{1 - \frac{(x^2-1)^2}{(x^2+1)^2}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{(x^2+1)^2 - (x^2-1)^2}{(x^2+1)^2}}$
$= \sqrt{\frac{4x^2}{(x^2+1)^2}}$
$= \frac{2x}{x^2+1}$
Sasa, $\tan\theta + \sec\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} + \frac{1}{\cos\theta}$
$= \frac{\frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}}{\frac{2x}{x^2+1}} + \frac{1}{\frac{2x}{x^2+1}}$
$= \frac{x^2-1}{2x} + \frac{x^2+1}{2x}$
$= \frac{x^2-1+x^2+1}{2x}$
$= \frac{2x^2}{2x} = x$
$\therefore \tan\theta + \sec\theta = x$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Katika pembetatu yenye pembe ya kulia, ikiwa urefu wa upande mfupi zaidi ni $7 \text{ cm}$ na pembe ndogo zaidi ni $15^\circ$, basi urefu wa hipotenusi ni upi?
Solution:
Katika $\triangle ABC$, $\sin \angle ACB = \frac{AB}{AC}$
au, $\sin 15^\circ = \frac{7}{AC}$ $7 \text{ cm}$
au, $0.2588 = \frac{7}{AC}$
au, $AC = \frac{7}{0.2588}$
$\therefore AC = 27.05 \text{ cm (takribani.) (Jibu.)}$

Question: Thibitisha kwamba, $\left(a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right)^p = a^{\frac{mp}{n}}$, ambapo $m,p \in \mathbb{Z}$ na $n \in \mathbb{N}$.
Solution:
L.H.S. $= \left(a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right)^p$
$= \left\{\left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m\right\}^p \quad \left[\because a^{\frac{m}{n}} = \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m\right]$
$= \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^{mp} \quad \left[\because (a^m)^n = a^{mn}\right]$
$= a^{\frac{mp}{n}} \quad \left[\because \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m = a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right]$
$=$ R.H.S.
$\therefore \left(a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right)^p = a^{\frac{mp}{n}}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba, $\left(a^{\frac{1}{m}}\right)^{\frac{1}{n}} = a^{\frac{1}{mn}}$, ambapo $m, n \in \mathbb{Z}$, $m \ne 0$, $n \ne 0$.
Solution:
Suluhisho: Tuseme, $(a^{\frac{1}{m}})^{\frac{1}{n}} = x$

au, $a^{\frac{1}{m}} = x^n$ [kwa kuwa $\sqrt[n]{a^m} = x, a^m = x^n$]

au, $a = (x^n)^m$

au, $a = x^{mn} \quad [\therefore (a^m)^n = a^{mn}]$

$\therefore x = a^{\frac{1}{mn}}$

yaani, $(a^{\frac{1}{m}})^{\frac{1}{n}} = a^{\frac{1}{mn}} \quad [\therefore x = (a^{\frac{1}{m}})^{\frac{1}{n}}]$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Thibitisha kwamba, $(ab)^{\frac{m}{n}} = a^{\frac{m}{n}} b^{\frac{m}{n}}$, ambapo $m \in \mathbb{Z}, n \in \mathbb{N}$.
Solution:
Hebu, $(ab)^{\frac{1}{n}} = x, a^{\frac{1}{n}} = y, b^{\frac{1}{n}} = z$
$\therefore x^n = ab, y^n = a, z^n = b$
Sasa, $x^n = ab$
au, $x^n = y^n z^n$ [kwa kubadilisha maadili ya a na b]
au, $x^n = (yz)^n \quad [\therefore (ab)^n = a^n b^n]$
$\therefore x = yz$
yaani, $(ab)^{\frac{1}{n}} = a^{\frac{1}{n}} b^{\frac{1}{n}}$
$\therefore \left\{(ab)^{\frac{1}{n}}\right\}^m = \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}b^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m$
[kwa kuchukua m kama nguvu pande zote mbili]
au, $(ab)^{\frac{m}{n}} = \left\{(a)^{\frac{1}{n}}\right\}^m \left\{(b)^{\frac{1}{n}}\right\}^m$
$[\therefore (a^{\frac{1}{n}})^m = a^{\frac{m}{n}} \text{ na } (ab)^n = a^n b^n]$
$\therefore (ab)^{\frac{m}{n}} = a^{\frac{m}{n}} b^{\frac{m}{n}}$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question:
Onyesha kwamba,
$(a^{\frac{1}{3}} - b^{\frac{1}{3}}) (a^{\frac{2}{3}} + a^{\frac{1}{3}} b^{\frac{1}{3}} + b^{\frac{2}{3}}) = a - b$
Solution:
Suluhisho:
(1) Upande wa kushoto (L.H.S.) = $(a^{\frac{1}{3}} - b^{\frac{1}{3}}) (a^{\frac{2}{3}} + a^{\frac{1}{3}} b^{\frac{1}{3}} + b^{\frac{2}{3}})$
$= \left(a^{\frac{1}{3}} - b^{\frac{1}{3}}\right) \left\{ \left(a^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 + a^{\frac{1}{3}} b^{\frac{1}{3}} + \left(b^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 \right\}$
$= \left(a^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 - \left(b^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 \quad [\therefore (x-y)(x^2+xy+y^2)=x^3-y^3]$
$= a^{\frac{3}{3}} - b^{\frac{3}{3}} \quad \left[\therefore \left(a^{\frac{1}{n}}\right)^m = a^{\frac{m}{n}}\right]$
$= a^1 - b^1$
$= a - b$
$= Upande wa kulia (R.H.S.)..$
$\therefore (a^{\frac{1}{3}} - b^{\frac{1}{3}}) (a^{\frac{2}{3}} + a^{\frac{1}{3}} b^{\frac{1}{3}} + b^{\frac{2}{3}}) = a - b$ (Umeonyeshwa)

Question:
Tengeneza maelezo yafuatayo kwa njia fupi zaidi:
 $\frac{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}}}{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}}}$
Solution:
$= \frac{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b}}}{\left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{b}{a-b}}}$
$= \left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b} - \frac{b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a}{a-b} - \frac{b}{a-b}} \left[ \therefore \frac{a^r}{a^s} = a^{r-s} \right]$
$= \left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^{\frac{a-b}{a-b}} \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^{\frac{a-b}{a-b}}$
$= \left(\frac{a+b}{b}\right)^1 \times \left(\frac{a-b}{a}\right)^1$
$= \frac{a+b}{b} \times \frac{a-b}{a} = \frac{a^2-b^2}{ab}$
Jibu: $\frac{a^2-b^2}{ab}$

Question:
**Rahisisha:**
$\frac{a^{3/2} + ab}{ab - b^3} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$
Solution:
$\frac{a^{3/2} + ab}{ab - b^3} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$
$= \frac{a(\sqrt{a} + b)}{b(a - b^2)} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b} \quad \left[ \therefore a^{3/2} = a \cdot a^{1/2} = a\sqrt{a} \right]$
$= \frac{a(\sqrt{a} + b)}{b((\sqrt{a})^2 - (b)^2)} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$
$= \frac{a(\sqrt{a} + b)}{b(\sqrt{a} + b)(\sqrt{a} - b)} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b}$
$= \frac{a}{b(\sqrt{a} - b)} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a} - b} = \frac{a - b\sqrt{a}}{b(\sqrt{a} - b)}$
$= \frac{\sqrt{a}(\sqrt{a} - b)}{b(\sqrt{a} - b)} \quad \left[ \therefore a = a^{1/2} \cdot a^{1/2} = \sqrt{a} \cdot \sqrt{a} \right]$
$= \frac{\sqrt{a}}{b}$
Jibu. $\frac{\sqrt{a}}{b}$

Question:
Rahisisha:
 $\left\{\left(x^{\frac{1}{a}}\right)^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{a-b}}\right\}^{\frac{a}{a+b}}$
Solution:
$\left\{\left(x^{\frac{1}{a}}\right)^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{a-b}}\right\}^{\frac{a}{a+b}} = \left(x^{\frac{1}{a}}\right)^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{a-b} \cdot \frac{a}{a+b}} \quad \left[\therefore (a^r)^s = a^{rs}\right]$
$= x^{\frac{1}{a} \cdot \frac{a^2-b^2}{a-b} \cdot \frac{a}{a+b}}$
$= x^{\frac{1}{a} \cdot \frac{(a+b)(a-b)}{ (a-b)} \cdot \frac{a}{(a+b)}}$
$= x^1 = x$
Jibu. $x$

Question:
Kokotoa kwa urahisi:
 $\frac{1}{1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p} + \frac{1}{1+b^{-n}c^p+b^{-n}a^m} + \frac{1}{1+c^{-p}a^m+c^{-p}b^n}$
Solution:
$\frac{1}{1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p} + \frac{1}{1+b^{-n}c^p+b^{-n}a^m} + \frac{1}{1+c^{-p}a^m+c^{-p}b^n}$
    Hapa, sehemu ya kwanza $= \frac{1}{1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p}$
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m(1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p)}$
[kuzidisha kiga zao na kipande kwa $a^m$]
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m+m}c^p}$
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m+a^0b^n+a^0c^p}$
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m+b^n+c^p} \quad [\therefore a^0=1]$
Vilevile, sehemu ya pili $= \frac{b^n}{a^m+b^n+c^p}$
na sehemu ya tatu $= \frac{c^p}{a^m+b^n+c^p}$
$\therefore$ Maneno yaliyotolewa $= \frac{1}{1+a^{-m}b^n+a^{-m}c^p} + \frac{1}{1+b^{-n}c^p+b^{-n}a^m} + \frac{1}{1+c^{-p}a^m+c^{-p}b^n}$
$= \frac{a^m}{a^m+b^n+c^p} + \frac{b^n}{a^m+b^n+c^p} + \frac{c^p}{a^m+b^n+c^p}$
$= \frac{a^m+b^n+c^p}{a^m+b^n+c^p} = 1$
Jibu. 1

Question:
Rahisisha:
$bc\sqrt{\frac{x^{b/c}}{x^{c/b}}} \times ca\sqrt{\frac{x^{c/a}}{x^{a/c}}} \times ab\sqrt{\frac{x^{a/b}}{x^{b/a}}}$
Solution:
$bc\sqrt{\frac{x^{b/c}}{x^{c/b}}} \times ca\sqrt{\frac{x^{c/a}}{x^{a/c}}} \times ab\sqrt{\frac{x^{a/b}}{x^{b/a}}}$
$= \left(x^{b/c - c/b}\right)^{bc} \times \left(x^{c/a - a/c}\right)^{ca} \times \left(x^{a/b - b/a}\right)^{ab} \quad \left[\therefore \frac{x^r}{x^s} = x^{r-s}\right]$
$= \left(x^{\frac{b^2-c^2}{bc}}\right)^{bc} \times \left(x^{\frac{c^2-a^2}{ca}}\right)^{ca} \times \left(x^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{ab}}\right)^{ab}$
$= x^{\frac{b^2-c^2}{bc} \cdot bc} \cdot x^{\frac{c^2-a^2}{ca} \cdot ca} \cdot x^{\frac{a^2-b^2}{ab} \cdot ab} \quad \left[\therefore (x^r)^s = x^{rs}\right]$
$= x^{b^2-c^2} \cdot x^{c^2-a^2} \cdot x^{a^2-b^2}$
$= x^{b^2-c^2+c^2-a^2+a^2-b^2}$
$= x^0$
$= 1$
Jibu. $1$

Question:
Tafsiri ya Kiswahili:

Rahisisha:
 $\frac{(a^2-b^{-2})^a (a-b^{-1})^{b-a}}{(b^2-a^{-2})^b (b+a^{-1})^{a-b}}$
Solution:
$\frac{(a^2-b^{-2})^a (a-b^{-1})^{b-a}}{(b^2-a^{-2})^b (b+a^{-1})^{a-b}}$
$= \frac{\left(a^2 - \frac{1}{b^2}\right)^a \left(a - \frac{1}{b}\right)^{b-a}}{\left(b^2 - \frac{1}{a^2}\right)^b \left(b + \frac{1}{a}\right)^{a-b}}$
$= \frac{\left\{\left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)\left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)\right\}^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^{b-a}}{\left\{\left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)\left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)\right\}^b \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^{a-b}}$
$= \frac{\left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^{b-a}}{\left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^b \left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)^b \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^{a-b}}$
$= \frac{\left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^{a+b-a}}{\left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)^b \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^{b+a-b}}$
$= \frac{\left(a+\frac{1}{b}\right)^a \left(a-\frac{1}{b}\right)^b}{\left(b-\frac{1}{a}\right)^b \left(b+\frac{1}{a}\right)^a}$
$= \frac{\left(\frac{ab+1}{b}\right)^a \left(\frac{ab-1}{b}\right)^b}{\left(\frac{ab-1}{a}\right)^b \left(\frac{ab+1}{a}\right)^a}$
$= \frac{\left(\frac{ab+1}{b}\right)^a}{\left(\frac{ab+1}{a}\right)^a} \times \frac{\left(\frac{ab-1}{b}\right)^b}{\left(\frac{ab-1}{a}\right)^b}$
$= \left(\frac{ab+1}{b} \times \frac{a}{ab+1}\right)^a \times \left(\frac{ab-1}{b} \times \frac{a}{ab-1}\right)^b$
$= \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^a \times \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^b$
$= \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{a+b}$
Jibu. $\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{a+b}$

Question:
Onyesha kwamba
1) Ikiwa $x=a^{q+r}b^p$, $y=a^{r+p}b^q$, $z=a^{p+q}b^r$, basi $x^{q-r} \cdot y^{r-p} \cdot z^{p-q}=1$
Solution:
Kutokana na $x=a^{q+r}b^p$, $y=a^{r+p}b^q$, $z=a^{p+q}b^r$
Upande wa Kushoto (L.H.S.)$= x^{q-r} \cdot y^{r-p} \cdot z^{p-q}$
$= (a^{q+r}b^p)^{q-r} (a^{r+p}b^q)^{r-p} (a^{p+q}b^r)^{p-q}$
[Kwa kubadilisha maadili ya $x, y \; \& \; z$]
$= a^{(q+r)(q-r)} b^{p(q-r)} a^{(r+p)(r-p)} b^{q(r-p)} a^{(p+q)(p-q)} b^{r(p-q)}$
$= a^{q^2-r^2} \cdot b^{pq-pr} \cdot a^{r^2-p^2} \cdot b^{qr-pq} \cdot a^{p^2-q^2} \cdot b^{rp-qr}$
$= a^{q^2-r^2+r^2-p^2+p^2-q^2} \cdot b^{pq-pr+qr-pq+rp-qr}$
$= a^0 \cdot b^0$
$= 1 \cdot 1 \quad [\therefore a^0=1]$
$= 1 = \text{Upande wa Kulia (R.H.S.)}$
$\therefore x^{q-r} \cdot y^{r-p} \cdot z^{p-q}=1$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: 2) Onyesha kwamba kama $a^p=b^q$, $b^q=c^r$ na $c^r=a$, basi $pqr=1$
Solution:
Kutokana na, $a^p=b$, $b^q=c$, $c^r=a$
Hapa, $c^r = a$
au, $(b^q)^r = a \quad [\therefore b^q = c]$
au, $b^{qr} = a \quad [\therefore (a^r)^s = a^{rs}]$
au, $(a^p)^{qr} = a \quad [\therefore a^p = b]$
au, $a^{pqr} = a \quad [\therefore (a^r)^s = a^{rs}]$
au, $a^{pqr} = a^1$
$\therefore pqr=1$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: 3) Ikiwa $a^x=p$, $a^y=q$ na $a^z=(p^yq^x)^2$, basi $xyz=1$
Solution:
Zimetolewa $a^x=p$, $a^y=q$ na $a^z = (p^y q^x)^2$
Hapa, $(p^y q^x)^z = a^2$
au, $\{(a^x)^y (a^y)^x\}^z = a^2 \quad [\therefore p=a^x, q=a^y]$
au, $(a^{xy} a^{xy})^z = a^2 \quad [\therefore (a^r)^s = a^{rs}]$
au, $(a^{xy+xy})^z = a^2 \quad [\therefore a^r \cdot a^s = a^{r+s}]$
au, $(a^{2xy})^z = a^2$
au, $a^{2xyz} = a^2 \quad [\therefore (a^r)^s = a^{rs}]$
au, $2xyz = 2$
$\therefore xyz = 1$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question:
Kama $x\sqrt[3]{a} + y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c} = 0$ na $a^2 = bc$,
basi onyesha kwamba, $ax^3 + by^3 + cz^3 = 3xyz\sqrt[3]{abc}$
Solution:
Kufuatana na,
$x\sqrt[3]{a} + y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c} = 0$ na $a^2 = bc$
Hapa, $x\sqrt[3]{a} + y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c} = 0$
au, $x\sqrt[3]{a} = -(y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c})$
au, $(x\sqrt[3]{a})^3 = -(y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c})^3$ [kuchukua umbi la tatu pande zote]
au, $x^3 a = -(y^3 b + z^3 c + 3yz\sqrt[3]{b}\sqrt[3]{c}(y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c}))$
$[\therefore (p+q)^3 = p^3+q^3+3pq(p+q)]$
au, $ax^3 = -by^3 - cz^3 - 3yz\sqrt[3]{bc}(-(x\sqrt[3]{a}))$
$[ \therefore x\sqrt[3]{a} = -(y\sqrt[3]{b} + z\sqrt[3]{c}) ]$
au, $ax^3 = -by^3 - cz^3 + 3xyz\sqrt[3]{bc}\sqrt[3]{a}$
[$\therefore a^2 = bc \implies \sqrt[3]{bc} = \sqrt[3]{a^2} = a^{\frac{2}{3}}$]
au, $ax^3 = -by^3 - cz^3 + 3xyz a^{\frac{2}{3}} a^{\frac{1}{3}}$
au, $ax^3+by^3+cz^3 = 3xyz a^{\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{3}}$
au, $ax^3+by^3+cz^3 = 3xyz a^1$
$\therefore ax^3+by^3+cz^3 = 3axyz$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question:
Iwapo $x=(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}$ na $a^2-b^2=c^3$,
basi onyesha kwamba, $x^3 - 3cx - 2a = 0$
Solution:
Kutokana na $x=(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}$ na $a^2-b^2=c^3$
Hapa, $x=(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}$
au, $x^3 = \left\{(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}\right\}^3$ [kuchukua kipeo cha tatu pande zote]
au, $x^3 = \left\{(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}}\right\}^3 + \left\{(a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}\right\}^3$
$+ 3 \cdot (a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}} \left\{(a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}}\right\}$
$[\therefore (x+y)^3 = x^3+y^3+3xy(x+y)]$
au, $x^3 = a+b+a-b+3(a^2-b^2)^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot x$
$[\therefore (a+b)^{\frac{1}{3}} + (a-b)^{\frac{1}{3}} = x]$
au, $x^3 = 2a + 3 \cdot (c^3)^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot x \quad [\therefore a^2-b^2=c^3]$
au, $x^3 = 2a + 3cx$
$\therefore x^3 - 3cx - 2a = 0$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Kama $a = 2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}$, basi onyesha kwamba, $2a^3 - 6a = 5$
Solution:
Kupewa, $a = 2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}$
au, $a^3 = \left(2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3$ [kuchukua ujazo pande zote mbili]
au, $a^3 = \left(2^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 + \left(2^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 + 3 \cdot 2^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 2^{-\frac{1}{3}} \left(2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)$
$\left[\therefore (x+y)^3 = x^3 + y^3 + 3xy(x+y)\right]$
au, $a^3 = 2^1 + 2^{-1} + 3 \cdot 2^0 \cdot a$
$\left[\therefore 2^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 2^{-\frac{1}{3}} = 2^{\frac{1}{3}-\frac{1}{3}} = 2^0 \text{ na } 2^{\frac{1}{3}} + 2^{-\frac{1}{3}} = a\right]$
au, $a^3 = 2 + \frac{1}{2} + 3a$
au, $a^3 = \frac{4+1+6a}{2}$
au, $2a^3 = 4+1+6a$
$\therefore 2a^3 - 6a = 5$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Kama $a^2 + 2 = 3^{\frac{2}{3}} + 3^{-\frac{2}{3}}$ na $a \ge 0$, basi onyesha kwamba, $3a^3 + 9a = 8$
Solution:
Kutokana na,
$a^2 + 2 = 3^{\frac{2}{3}} + 3^{-\frac{2}{3}}$
au, $a^2 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 + \left(3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 - 2$
au, $a^2 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 + \left(3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2 - 2 \cdot 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}$
$\left[\therefore 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 3^{-\frac{1}{3}} = 3^0 = 1\right]$
au, $a^2 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^2$
au, $a = 3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}$ [kwa kuwa $a \ge 0$, tunachukua mzizi wa mraba chanya tu pande zote mbili]
au, $a^3 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3$ [tukichukua ujazo pande zote mbili]
au, $a^3 = \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 - \left(3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 - 3 \cdot 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 3^{-\frac{1}{3}} \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)$
$\left[\therefore (a-b)^3 = a^3 - b^3 - 3ab(a-b)\right]$
au, $a^3 = 3 - 3^{-1} - 3 \cdot 3^0 \cdot a$
$\left[\therefore 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot 3^{-\frac{1}{3}} = 3^{\frac{1}{3}-\frac{1}{3}} = 3^0 \text{ na } 3^{\frac{1}{3}} - 3^{-\frac{1}{3}} = a\right]$
au, $a^3 = 3 - \frac{1}{3} - 3a$
au, $a^3 + 3a = \frac{8}{3}$
$\therefore 3a^3 + 9a = 8$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa $a^2 = b^3$, onyesha kwamba, $\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} + \left(\frac{b}{a}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}} = a^{\frac{1}{2}} + b^{\frac{1}{3}}$
Solution:
Hapa, $a^2 = b^3 \quad \therefore a = b^{\frac{3}{2}}$
Tena, $a^2 = b^3$
au, $b^3 = a^2$
$\therefore b = a^{\frac{2}{3}}$
Sasa, L.H.S.$= \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} + \left(\frac{b}{a}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}}$
$= \frac{a^{\frac{3}{2}}}{b^{\frac{3}{2}}} + \frac{b^{\frac{2}{3}}}{a^{\frac{2}{3}}}$
$= \frac{a^{\frac{3}{2}}}{a} + \frac{b^{\frac{2}{3}}}{b} \quad \left[\therefore a=b^{\frac{3}{2}}, b=a^{\frac{2}{3}}\right]$
$= a^{\frac{3}{2}-1} + b^{\frac{2}{3}-1}$
$= a^{\frac{1}{2}} + b^{-\frac{1}{3}}$
$=$ R.H.S..
$\therefore \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} + \left(\frac{b}{a}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}} = a^{\frac{1}{2}} + b^{-\frac{1}{3}}$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question: Ikiwa $b=1+3^{\frac{2}{3}}+3^{\frac{1}{3}}$, basi onyesha kwamba, $b^3 - 3b^2 - 6b - 4 = 0$
Solution:
Hapa, $b=1+3^{\frac{2}{3}}+3^{\frac{1}{3}}$
au, $b-1=3^{\frac{2}{3}}+3^{\frac{1}{3}}$
au, $(b-1)^3 = \left(3^{\frac{2}{3}}+3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3$ [kuchukua mpambao kwenye pande zote mbili]
au, $b^3 - 3b^2 + 3b - 1 = \left(3^{\frac{2}{3}}\right)^3 + \left(3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)^3 + 3 \cdot 3^{\frac{2}{3}} \cdot 3^{\frac{1}{3}} \left(3^{\frac{2}{3}}+3^{\frac{1}{3}}\right)$
$\left[\therefore (x+y)^3 = x^3 + y^3 + 3xy(x+y)\right]$
au, $b^3 - 3b^2 + 3b - 1 = 3^2 + 3 + 3 \cdot 3^{\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{3}} \cdot (b-1)$
$\left[\therefore 3^{\frac{2}{3}} + 3^{\frac{1}{3}} = b-1\right]$
au, $b^3 - 3b^2 + 3b - 1 = 9 + 3 + 3 \cdot 3^1(b-1)$
au, $b^3 - 3b^2 + 3b - 1 = 12 + 9b - 9$
au, $b^3 - 3b^2 + 3b - 1 - 12 - 9b + 9 = 0$
$\therefore b^3 - 3b^2 - 6b - 4 = 0$ (Imeonyeshwa)

Question:
Ikiwa $a+b+c=0$, basi onyesha kwamba,
$\frac{1}{x^b + x^{-c} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1} = 1$
Solution:
K.K.B. $= \frac{1}{x^b + x^{-c} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1}$
$= \frac{1}{x^b + \frac{1}{x^c} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{x^b \cdot x^c + 1 + x^c} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{x^{b+c} + 1 + x^c} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1} \quad [\because a+b+c=0 \quad \therefore b+c=-a]$
$= \frac{x^c}{x^{-a} + 1 + x^c} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{\frac{x^a + 1}{x^b} + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{x^b}{x^a + x^b + 1}$
$= \frac{x^c}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{x^b \cdot x^c}{x^a \cdot x^c + x^b \cdot x^c + x^c}$
$= \frac{x^c}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{x^{b+c}}{x^{a+c} + x^{b+c} + x^c}$
$= \frac{x^c+1}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} + \frac{x^{-a}}{x^{-b} + x^{-a} + x^c}$
$= \frac{x^c+1+x^{-a}}{1+x^c+x^{-a}} = 1$
$=$ K.N.B.
$\therefore \frac{1}{x^b + x^{-c} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^c + x^{-a} + 1} + \frac{1}{x^a + x^{-b} + 1} = 1$ (Imethibitishwa)

Question: Ikiwa $a^x = b$, $b^y = c$ na $c^z = 1$, basi tafuta thamani ya $xyz$.
Solution:
Kufuatana na,
$c^z = 1$
au, $(b^y)^z = 1 \quad [\because b^y = c]$
au, $\{(a^x)^y\}^z = 1 \quad [\because a^x = b]$
au, $\{a^{xy}\}^z = 1$
au, $a^{xyz} = a^0$
$\therefore xyz = 0$ (Jibu.)

Question: Ikiwa $x^a = y^b = z^c$ na $xyz = 1$, basi **pata** thamani ya $ab + bc + ca$.
Solution:
Hebu, $x^a = y^b = z^c = k$
$\therefore x^a = k$
$\therefore x = k^{\frac{1}{a}}$
Vivyo hivyo, $y = k^{\frac{1}{b}}$ na $z = k^{\frac{1}{c}}$
Sasa, $xyz = 1$
au, $k^{\frac{1}{a}} \cdot k^{\frac{1}{b}} \cdot k^{\frac{1}{c}} = 1 \quad \left[\therefore x = k^{\frac{1}{a}}, y = k^{\frac{1}{b}} \text{ na } z = k^{\frac{1}{c}}\right]$
au, $k^{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} + \frac{1}{c}} = 1$
au, $k^{\frac{bc + ca + ab}{abc}} = k^0$
au, $\frac{ab + bc + ca}{abc} = 0$
au, $ab + bc + ca = 0 \times abc$
$\therefore ab + bc + ca = 0$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Tatua:
    $3^{2x+2} + 27^{x+1} = 36$
Solution:
$3^{2x+2} + 27^{x+1} = 36$
au, $3^{2x+2} + (3^3)^{x+1} = 36$
au, $3^{2x+2} + 3^{3x+3} = 36$
au, $\{3^{(x+1)}\}^2 + \{3^{(x+1)}\}^3 = 36$
au, $a^2 + a^3 = 36 \quad [3^{(x+1)} = a, \text{ sema}]$
au, $a^3 + a^2 - 36 = 0$
au, $a^3 - 3a^2 + 4a^2 - 12a + 12a - 36 = 0$
au, $a^2(a-3) + 4a(a-3) + 12(a-3) = 0$
au, $(a-3)(a^2 + 4a + 12) = 0$
Hivyo, $a-3=0$
$\therefore a=3$
au, $3^{x+1} = 3^1$ [kwa kuingiza thamani za a]
au, $x+1=1$
$\therefore x=0$
au, $a^2 + 4a + 12 = 0$
$\therefore a = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{4^2 - 4 \cdot 1 \cdot 12}}{2 \cdot 1}$
$\therefore a = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{16-48}}{2} = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{-32}}{2}$
$\therefore a^2 + 4a + 12 \ne 0$
Kwa kuwa hakuna namba halisi ya "a" inayoridhishahesabu hiyo hapo juu
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika ni $x=0$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Tatua:
$5^x + 3^y = 8$,
$5^{x-1} + 3^{y-1} = 2$
Solution:
$5^x + 3^y = 8$ .................. (i)
$5^{x-1} + 3^{y-1} = 2$ .................. (ii)
Kutoka (ii),
$5^{x-1} + 3^{y-1} = 2$
au, $\frac{5^x}{5} + \frac{3^y}{3} = 2$
$\therefore 5^x + 5 \cdot 3^{y-1} = 10$ .................. (iii)
Kwa kutoa (i) kutoka (iii) tunapata,
$5 \cdot 3^{y-1} - 3^y = 2$
au, $5 \cdot \frac{3^y}{3} - 3^y = 2$
au, $5 \cdot 3^y - 3 \cdot 3^y = 6$
au, $2 \cdot 3^y = 6$
au, $3^y = 3$
au, $3^y = 3^1$
$\therefore y=1$
Kwa kuingiza $y=1$ katika (iii) tunapata,
$5^x + 5 \cdot 3^{1-1} = 10$
au, $5^x + 5 \cdot 3^0 = 10 \quad [\therefore 3^0 = 1]$
au, $5^x + 5 \cdot 1 = 10$
au, $5^x = 10-5$
au, $5^x = 5$
au, $5^x = 5^1$
$\therefore x=1$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika ni $(x, y) = (1, 1)$ (Jibu.)

Question:
Tatua:
    $4^{3y-2} = 16^{x+y}$,
$3^{x+2y} = 9^{2x+1}$
Solution:
$4^{3y-2} = 16^{x+y}$ ..................... (i)
$3^{x+2y} = 9^{2x+1}$ ..................... (ii)
Kutoka (i) tunapata,
$4^{3y-2} = (4^2)^{x+y}$
au, $4^{3y-2} = 4^{2x+2y}$
au, $3y - 2 = 2x + 2y$
$\therefore 2x - y + 2 = 0$ ..................... (iii)
Kutoka (ii) tunapata,
$3^{x+2y} = (3^2)^{2x+1}$
au, $3^{x+2y} = 3^{4x+2}$
au, $x + 2y = 4x + 2$
$\therefore 3x - 2y + 2 = 0$ ........................ (iv)
Zidisha (iii) kwa 3 na (iv) kwa 2 kisha toa
$6x - 3y + 6 = 0$
$6x - 4y + 4 = 0$
$-$ $\quad$ $+$ $\quad$ $-$
$\overline{\quad\quad y+2=0\quad\quad}$
$\therefore y = -2$
Tuingize thamani ya y katika (iv) tunapata,
$3x + 4 + 2 = 0$
au, $3x + 6 = 0$
au, $3x = -6$
$\therefore x = -2$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho Linalohitajika ni $(x, y) = (-2, -2)$ (Jibu)

Question:
Tatua:
    $2^{2x+1} \cdot 3^{2y+1} = 8$,
$2^{x+2} \cdot 2^{2y+2} = 16$
Solution:
$2^{2x+1} \cdot 3^{2y+1} = 8$ .....................(i)
$2^{x+2} \cdot 2^{2y+2} = 16$ .....................(ii)
Kutoka (i) tunapata,
$2^{2x+1} \cdot 2^{3y+1} = 8$
au, $2^{2x+1+3y+1} = 2^3$
au, $2^{2x+3y+2} = 2^3$
au, $2x+3y+2 = 3$
$\therefore 2x+3y-1 = 0$ .....................(iii)
Kutoka (ii) tunapata,
$2^{x+2} \cdot 2^{2y+2} = 16$
au, $2^{x+2+2y+2} = 2^4$
au, $x+2y+4 = 4$
au, $x+2y = 0$
$\therefore x = -2y$ .....................(iv)
Kuuingiza thamani za x katika equation (iii)
tunapata,
$-2y+3y-1 = 0$
$\therefore y=1$
Kubadilisha $y=1$ katika (iv) tunapata,
$\therefore x = -1$
$\therefore$ Suluhisho linalohitajika ni $(x,y) = (-1,1)$ (Jibu.)

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\log_k \left(\frac{a^n}{b^n}\right) + \log_k \left(\frac{b^n}{c^n}\right) + \log_k \left(\frac{c^n}{a^n}\right) = 0$
Solution:
L.S.$= \log_k \left(\frac{a^n}{b^n}\right) + \log_k \left(\frac{b^n}{c^n}\right) + \log_k \left(\frac{c^n}{a^n}\right)$

$= \log_k \frac{a^n}{b^n} \cdot \frac{b^n}{c^n} \cdot \frac{c^n}{a^n}$

$= \log_k 1$

$= 0$

$= \text{R.S.(Imeonyeshwa)}$

Question: Onyesha kwamba, $\log_k(\text{ab})\log_k\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) + \log_k(\text{bc})\log_k\left(\frac{b}{c}\right) + \log_k(\text{ca})\log_k\left(\frac{c}{a}\right) = 0$
Solution:
